{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}{{ product.name }} - Festudlej{% endblock %}

{% block extra_head %}
<meta http-equiv="Cache-Control" content="no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate">
<meta http-equiv="Pragma" content="no-cache">
<meta http-equiv="Expires" content="0">
<meta name="csrf-token" content="{{ csrf_token() }}">
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="bg-white">
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
        <!-- Breadcrumb -->
        <nav class="mb-8">
            <ol class="flex items-center space-x-2 text-sm text-gray-500">
                <li><a href="{{ url_for('public.index') }}" class="hover:text-indigo-600">Hjem</a></li>
                <li>/</li>
                <li><a href="{{ url_for('public.catalog') }}" class="hover:text-indigo-600">Katalog</a></li>
                <li>/</li>
                <li><a href="{{ url_for('public.catalog', category=product.category.id) }}" class="hover:text-indigo-600">{{ product.category.name }}</a></li>
                <li>/</li>
                <li class="text-gray-900">{{ product.name }}</li>
            </ol>
        </nav>
        
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12">
            <!-- Product Images -->
            <div>
                <div class="mb-4">
                    {% if product.hero_image_url %}
                    <img src="{{ product.hero_image_url | image_url }}" alt="{{ product.name }}" 
                         class="w-full h-96 object-cover rounded-lg">
                    {% else %}
                    <div class="w-full h-96 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                        <span class="text-gray-500 text-lg">Ingen billede</span>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                
                <!-- Additional Images -->
                {% if product.images %}
                <div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                    {% for image in product.images[:4] %}
                    <img src="{{ image.url }}" alt="{{ image.alt }}" 
                         class="w-full h-20 object-cover rounded cursor-pointer hover:opacity-75">
                    {% endfor %}
                </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
            
            <!-- Product Info -->
            <div>
                <div class="mb-4">
                    <span class="inline-block bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 text-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-full">
                        {{ product.category.name }}
                    </span>
                </div>
                
                <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">{{ product.name }}</h1>
                
                <div class="mb-6">
                    <div class="text-3xl font-bold text-indigo-600 mb-2">
                        {{ product.daily_price_dkk | currency }}
                        <span class="text-lg font-normal text-gray-500">/dag</span>
                    </div>
                    {% if product.weekend_price_dkk %}
                    <div class="text-lg text-gray-600">
                        Weekend: {{ product.weekend_price_dkk | currency }}/dag
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                    {% if product.deposit_dkk %}
                    <div class="text-sm text-gray-500">
                        Depositum: {{ product.deposit_dkk | currency }} (refunderbart)
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                
                <!-- Integrated Calendar -->
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden mb-6">
                    <!-- Calendar Header -->
                    <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 px-6 py-4">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-white">Vælg dine datoer</h3>
                                <p class="text-indigo-100 mt-1">Klik på start- og slutdato for at se tilgængelighed</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-right">
                                <div id="selection-info" class="text-white">
                                    <div class="text-sm opacity-75">Vælg datoer</div>
                                    <div id="selected-dates" class="font-semibold">-</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Calendar Container -->
                    <div class="p-6">
                        <div id="calendar" class="calendar-container"></div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Selection Summary & Actions -->
                    <div id="selection-summary" class="hidden bg-gray-50 px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-200">
                        <div class="space-y-4">
                            <!-- Availability Status -->
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <div class="flex items-center space-x-4">
                                    <div id="availability-status" class="flex items-center">
                                        <!-- Status icon will be inserted here -->
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <div id="availability-text" class="font-semibold text-gray-900"></div>
                                        <div id="availability-details" class="text-sm text-gray-600"></div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-right">
                                    <div id="price-display" class="text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-600">
                                        <!-- Price will be calculated here -->
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="text-sm text-gray-500" id="price-details">
                                        <!-- Price details will be shown here -->
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <!-- Action Buttons -->
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-gray-200">
                                <button id="clear-selection" 
                                        class="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors duration-200">
                                    Ryd valg
                                </button>
                                <button id="add-to-cart" 
                                        class="px-8 py-3 text-lg font-medium text-white bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 rounded-lg hover:from-indigo-700 hover:to-purple-700 transition-all duration-200 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                                        disabled>
                                    Tilføj til kurv
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Legend -->
                    <div class="bg-gray-50 px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-200">
                        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-6">
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <div class="w-4 h-4 bg-green-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-sm"></div>
                                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Tilgængelig</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <div class="w-4 h-4 bg-red-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-sm"></div>
                                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Ikke tilgængelig</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <div class="w-4 h-4 bg-gray-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-sm"></div>
                                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Sortdato</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <div class="w-4 h-4 bg-yellow-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-sm"></div>
                                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Begrænset</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Product Description -->
                {% if product.description %}
                <div class="mb-6">
                    <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-2">Beskrivelse</h3>
                    <div class="prose max-w-none text-gray-600">
                        {{ product.description | safe }}
                    </div>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
                
                <!-- Product Details -->
                <div class="border-t pt-6">
                    <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4">Produktdetaljer</h3>
                    <dl class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                        <div>
                            <dt class="font-medium text-gray-500">Kategori</dt>
                            <dd class="text-gray-900">{{ product.category.name }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <dt class="font-medium text-gray-500">Lagerantal</dt>
                            <dd class="text-gray-900">{{ product.stock_qty }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        {% if product.prep_buffer_days > 0 %}
                        <div>
                            <dt class="font-medium text-gray-500">Forberedelsesdage</dt>
                            <dd class="text-gray-900">{{ product.prep_buffer_days }} dag{{ 'er' if product.prep_buffer_days != 1 else '' }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                        {% if product.cleanup_buffer_days > 0 %}
                        <div>
                            <dt class="font-medium text-gray-500">Oprydningsdage</dt>
                            <dd class="text-gray-900">{{ product.cleanup_buffer_days }} dag{{ 'er' if product.cleanup_buffer_days != 1 else '' }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </dl>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Related Products -->
        {% if related_products %}
        <div class="mt-16">
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-8">Relaterede produkter</h2>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
                {% for related_product in related_products %}
                <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md overflow-hidden hover:shadow-lg transition duration-200">
                    <a href="{{ url_for('public.product_detail', slug=related_product.slug) }}">
                        {% if related_product.hero_image_url %}
                        <img src="{{ related_product.hero_image_url | image_url }}" alt="{{ related_product.name }}" class="w-full h-48 object-cover">
                        {% else %}
                        <div class="w-full h-48 bg-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <span class="text-gray-500">Ingen billede</span>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </a>
                    
                    <div class="p-4">
                        <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-2">
                            <a href="{{ url_for('public.product_detail', slug=related_product.slug) }}" class="hover:text-indigo-600">
                                {{ related_product.name }}
                            </a>
                        </h3>
                        
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div class="text-xl font-bold text-indigo-600">
                                {{ related_product.daily_price_dkk | currency }}
                                <span class="text-sm font-normal text-gray-500">/dag</span>
                            </div>
                            <a href="{{ url_for('public.product_detail', slug=related_product.slug) }}" 
                               class="bg-indigo-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-indigo-700 transition duration-200">
                                Se detaljer
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                {% endfor %}
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    let selectedStartDate = null;
    let selectedEndDate = null;
    let calendar = null;
    let availabilityData = {};
    
    // Initialize calendar
    const calendarEl = document.getElementById('calendar');
    calendar = new FullCalendar.Calendar(calendarEl, {
        initialView: 'dayGridMonth',
        locale: 'da',
        selectAllow: function(selectInfo) {
            // Allow selection only for future dates
            const today = new Date();
            today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
            return selectInfo.start >= today;
        },
        headerToolbar: {
            left: 'prev,next today',
            center: 'title',
            right: 'dayGridMonth,dayGridWeek,listWeek'
        },
        buttonText: {
            today: 'I dag',
            month: 'Måned',
            week: 'Uge',
            list: 'Liste'
        },
        selectable: true,
        selectMirror: true,
        selectOverlap: true,
        unselectAuto: false,
        selectLongPressDelay: 100,
        events: function(info, successCallback, failureCallback) {
            // Simple, reliable date format extraction
            let startDate, endDate;
            
            // Handle both string and Date objects
            if (typeof info.start === 'string') {
                startDate = info.start.split('T')[0];
            } else {
                startDate = info.start.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            }
            
            if (typeof info.end === 'string') {
                endDate = info.end.split('T')[0];
            } else {
                endDate = info.end.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            }
            
            console.log('📅 Fetching calendar data:', { startDate, endDate, productId: {{ product.id }} });
            
            fetch(`/api/calendar-data/{{ product.id }}?start=${startDate}&end=${endDate}&t=${Date.now()}`)
                .then(response => {
                    console.log('📅 Calendar API response:', response.status);
                    if (!response.ok) {
                        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
                    }
                    return response.json();
                })
                .then(data => {
                    console.log('📅 Calendar data received:', data.length, 'days');
                    
                    // Store availability data for later use
                    availabilityData = {};
                    data.forEach(day => {
                        availabilityData[day.date] = day;
                    });
                    
                    // Create clean, subtle visual indicators
                    const events = data.map(day => {
                        if (day.is_blacked_out) {
                            return {
                                date: day.date,
                                display: 'background',
                                backgroundColor: 'rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.2)',
                                title: 'Ikke tilgængelig',
                                classNames: 'blackout-date',
                                overlap: false
                            };
                        } else if (day.is_available && day.available_quantity > 0) {
                            // Clean color coding without overwhelming text
                            let backgroundColor;
                            if (day.available_quantity >= 3) {
                                backgroundColor = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)'; // Very light green
                            } else {
                                backgroundColor = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)'; // Very light yellow
                            }
                            
                            return {
                                date: day.date,
                                display: 'background',
                                backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
                                title: `${day.available_quantity} enheder`,
                                classNames: 'available-date',
                                overlap: true  // Allow selection over available dates
                            };
                        } else {
                            return {
                                date: day.date,
                                display: 'background',
                                backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)',
                                title: 'Ikke tilgængelig',
                                classNames: 'unavailable-date',
                                overlap: false
                            };
                        }
                    });
                    
                    console.log('📅 Calendar events created:', events.length);
                    successCallback(events);
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.error('📅 Calendar error:', error);
                    // Don't show error in calendar, just log it
                    successCallback([]);
                });
        },
        select: function(info) {
            const startDate = info.startStr;
            const endDate = info.endStr;
            const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            
            console.log('📅 SELECT TRIGGERED:', info);
            console.log('📅 Date range selected:', { startDate, endDate, today });
            
            // Validate dates
            if (startDate < today) {
                showNotification('Vælg venligst fremtidige datoer', 'warning');
                calendar.unselect();
                return;
            }
            
            // FullCalendar's endDate is exclusive, so subtract 1 day to make it inclusive
            const actualEndDate = new Date(endDate);
            actualEndDate.setDate(actualEndDate.getDate() - 1);
            const inclusiveEndDate = actualEndDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            
            selectedStartDate = startDate;
            selectedEndDate = inclusiveEndDate;
            
            updateSelectionDisplay();
            checkAvailability();
            
            const days = Math.ceil((actualEndDate - new Date(startDate)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
            showNotification(`${days} dag${days > 1 ? 'e' : ''} valgt - beregner pris...`, 'success');
        },
        selectStart: function(info) {
            console.log('🎯 SELECTION STARTED:', info);
        },
        selectEnd: function(info) {
            console.log('🎯 SELECTION ENDED:', info);
        },
        dateClick: function(info) {
            const clickedDate = info.dateStr;
            const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            
            if (clickedDate < today) {
                showNotification('Vælg venligst fremtidige datoer', 'warning');
                return;
            }
            
            console.log('Date clicked:', clickedDate, 'Current selection:', selectedStartDate, selectedEndDate);
            
            // Simple, intuitive date selection
            if (!selectedStartDate) {
                // First click - select start date
                selectedStartDate = clickedDate;
                selectedEndDate = clickedDate;
                calendar.select(clickedDate, clickedDate);
                updateSelectionDisplay();
                checkAvailability();
                showNotification('Dag valgt. Træk for at vælge flere dage eller klik "Tilføj til kurv"', 'success');
            } else if (selectedStartDate === clickedDate && selectedEndDate === clickedDate) {
                // Clicking same date - clear selection
                selectedStartDate = null;
                selectedEndDate = null;
                calendar.unselect();
                updateSelectionDisplay();
                hideSelectionSummary();
                showNotification('Valg ryddet', 'info');
            } else {
                // Click elsewhere - start new selection
                selectedStartDate = clickedDate;
                selectedEndDate = clickedDate;
                calendar.select(clickedDate, clickedDate);
                updateSelectionDisplay();
                checkAvailability();
                showNotification('Ny periode valgt', 'success');
            }
        },
        dayMaxEvents: false,
        height: 'auto',
        dayCellClassNames: function(info) {
            const today = new Date();
            const cellDate = new Date(info.date);
            
            if (cellDate < today) {
                return ['past-date'];
            }
            return [];
        }
    });
    
    calendar.render();
    
    // Update selection display
    function updateSelectionDisplay() {
        const selectedDatesEl = document.getElementById('selected-dates');
        const selectionInfoEl = document.getElementById('selection-info');
        
        if (selectedStartDate && selectedEndDate) {
            if (selectedStartDate === selectedEndDate) {
                selectedDatesEl.textContent = formatDate(selectedStartDate);
            } else {
                selectedDatesEl.textContent = `${formatDate(selectedStartDate)} - ${formatDate(selectedEndDate)}`;
            }
            selectionInfoEl.querySelector('.text-sm').textContent = 'Valgte datoer';
        } else {
            selectedDatesEl.textContent = '-';
            selectionInfoEl.querySelector('.text-sm').textContent = 'Vælg datoer';
        }
    }
    
    // Check availability for selected dates
    async function checkAvailability() {
        if (!selectedStartDate || !selectedEndDate) return;
        
        const availabilityStatusEl = document.getElementById('availability-status');
        const availabilityTextEl = document.getElementById('availability-text');
        const availabilityDetailsEl = document.getElementById('availability-details');
        const selectionSummaryEl = document.getElementById('selection-summary');
        const addToCartBtn = document.getElementById('add-to-cart');
        const priceDisplayEl = document.getElementById('price-display');
        const priceDetailsEl = document.getElementById('price-details');
        
        // Show loading state
        availabilityStatusEl.innerHTML = '<div class="animate-spin rounded-full h-6 w-6 border-b-2 border-indigo-600"></div>';
        availabilityTextEl.textContent = 'Tjekker tilgængelighed...';
        availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = '';
        priceDisplayEl.textContent = 'Beregner pris...';
        priceDetailsEl.textContent = '';
        selectionSummaryEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        addToCartBtn.disabled = true;
        
        // Check availability using the stored data
        let isAvailable = true;
        let minAvailableQuantity = Infinity;
        let hasBlackout = false;
        
        const startDate = new Date(selectedStartDate);
        const endDate = new Date(selectedEndDate);
        const currentDate = new Date(startDate);
        
        while (currentDate <= endDate) {
            const dateStr = currentDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            const dayData = availabilityData[dateStr];
            
            if (dayData) {
                if (dayData.is_blacked_out) {
                    hasBlackout = true;
                    isAvailable = false;
                    break;
                } else if (!dayData.is_available) {
                    isAvailable = false;
                    break;
                } else {
                    minAvailableQuantity = Math.min(minAvailableQuantity, dayData.available_quantity);
                }
            } else {
                isAvailable = false;
                break;
            }
            
            currentDate.setDate(currentDate.getDate() + 1);
        }
        
        // Update UI based on availability
        if (isAvailable && !hasBlackout) {
            availabilityStatusEl.innerHTML = '<svg class="w-6 h-6 text-green-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>';
            availabilityTextEl.textContent = 'Tilgængelig!';
            availabilityTextEl.className = 'font-semibold text-green-800';
            availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = `${minAvailableQuantity} enheder tilgængelige`;
            availabilityDetailsEl.className = 'text-sm text-green-600';
            
            // Calculate and display price
            calculatePrice();
        } else {
            availabilityStatusEl.innerHTML = '<svg class="w-6 h-6 text-red-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"></path></svg>';
            availabilityTextEl.textContent = 'Ikke tilgængelig';
            availabilityTextEl.className = 'font-semibold text-red-800';
            if (hasBlackout) {
                availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = 'Sortdato i den valgte periode';
            } else {
                availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = 'Ikke tilgængelig i den valgte periode';
            }
            availabilityDetailsEl.className = 'text-sm text-red-600';
            priceDisplayEl.textContent = '';
            priceDetailsEl.textContent = '';
            addToCartBtn.disabled = true;
        }
    }
    
    // Clear selection
    document.getElementById('clear-selection').addEventListener('click', function() {
        selectedStartDate = null;
        selectedEndDate = null;
        calendar.unselect();
        updateSelectionDisplay();
        hideSelectionSummary();
    });
    
    // Add to cart button
    document.getElementById('add-to-cart').addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (selectedStartDate && selectedEndDate) {
            // Add to cart with selected dates
            addToCart();
        }
    });
    
    // Hide selection summary
    function hideSelectionSummary() {
        document.getElementById('selection-summary').classList.add('hidden');
    }
    
    // Robust price calculation
    async function calculatePrice() {
        const priceDisplayEl = document.getElementById('price-display');
        const priceDetailsEl = document.getElementById('price-details');
        const addToCartBtn = document.getElementById('add-to-cart');
        
        if (!selectedStartDate || !selectedEndDate) {
            priceDisplayEl.textContent = '';
            priceDetailsEl.textContent = '';
            addToCartBtn.disabled = true;
            return;
        }
        
        // Show loading state
        priceDisplayEl.textContent = 'Beregner...';
        priceDetailsEl.textContent = '';
        addToCartBtn.disabled = true;
        
        try {
            console.log('💰 Calculating price for:', selectedStartDate, 'to', selectedEndDate);
            
            // Calculate number of days (inclusive)
            const startDate = new Date(selectedStartDate);
            const endDate = new Date(selectedEndDate);
            const daysDiff = Math.ceil((endDate - startDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
            
            const url = `/api/price-estimate/{{ product.id }}?start_date=${selectedStartDate}&end_date=${selectedEndDate}&quantity=1&delivery_type=pickup&t=${Date.now()}`;
            console.log('💰 Fetching price from:', url);
            
            const response = await fetch(url);
            console.log('💰 Price API response:', response.status);
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
            }
            
            const data = await response.json();
            console.log('💰 Price data received:', data);
            
            console.log('💰 Checking response data structure:', JSON.stringify(data));
            
            // API returns pricing data directly (no 'success' wrapper)
            console.log('💰 Checking pricing data:', data);
            console.log('💰 total:', data.total, 'type:', typeof data.total);
            
            // Parse API response - get the daily rate from the line items
            const totalPrice = data.total ? Math.round(parseFloat(data.total)) : 0;
            let dailyRate = 0;
            
            // Get the daily rate from the first line item (product rental)
            if (data.line_items && data.line_items.length > 0) {
                dailyRate = Math.round(parseFloat(data.line_items[0].unit_price));
            } else {
                // Fallback calculation if no line items
                dailyRate = Math.round(totalPrice / daysDiff);
            }
            
            console.log('💰 Parsed values:', { totalPrice, dailyRate, daysDiff });
            
            if (totalPrice > 0) {
                priceDisplayEl.textContent = `${totalPrice} kr.`;
                priceDetailsEl.textContent = `${daysDiff} dag${daysDiff > 1 ? 'e' : ''} • ${dailyRate} kr./dag`;
                addToCartBtn.disabled = false;
                
                console.log('💰 SUCCESS! Price displayed:', { totalPrice, dailyRate, daysDiff });
            } else {
                console.error('💰 No valid price found:', data);
                throw new Error('No valid price data received');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('💰 Price calculation error:', error);
            
            // Fallback: Show basic price info without API
            const daysDiff = Math.ceil((new Date(selectedEndDate) - new Date(selectedStartDate)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
            priceDisplayEl.textContent = 'Se pris i kurv';
            priceDetailsEl.textContent = `${daysDiff} dag${daysDiff > 1 ? 'e' : ''} valgt`;
            addToCartBtn.disabled = false;
        }
    }
    
    // Format date for display
    function formatDate(dateStr) {
        const date = new Date(dateStr);
        return date.toLocaleDateString('da-DK', {
            day: 'numeric',
            month: 'short',
            year: 'numeric'
        });
    }
    
    // Add to cart function
    async function addToCart() {
        if (!selectedStartDate || !selectedEndDate) {
            showNotification('Vælg venligst datoer først', 'warning');
            return;
        }
        
        try {
            console.log('🛒 Adding to cart with data:', {
                product_id: {{ product.id }},
                start_date: selectedStartDate,
                end_date: selectedEndDate,
                quantity: 1,
                delivery_type: 'pickup'
            });
            
            // Create FormData with CSRF token
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('product_id', {{ product.id }});
            formData.append('start_date', selectedStartDate);
            formData.append('end_date', selectedEndDate);
            formData.append('quantity', 1);
            formData.append('delivery_type', 'pickup');
            
            // Get CSRF token from meta tag
            const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]');
            if (csrfToken) {
                const tokenValue = csrfToken.getAttribute('content');
                formData.append('csrf_token', tokenValue);
                console.log('🛒 CSRF token found and added:', tokenValue ? 'YES' : 'NO');
            } else {
                console.error('🛒 CSRF token meta tag not found!');
            }
            
            console.log('🛒 Sending request to /shop/add-to-cart...');
            const response = await fetch('/shop/add-to-cart', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData
            });
            
            console.log('🛒 Add to cart response status:', response.status);
            
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data.success) {
                showNotification('Produkt tilføjet til kurv!', 'success');
                // Update cart count
                const app = Alpine.$data(document.querySelector('[x-data]'));
                if (app && app.updateCartCount) {
                    app.updateCartCount();
                }
            } else {
                showNotification(data.error || 'Der opstod en fejl', 'error');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error adding to cart:', error);
            showNotification('Der opstod en fejl under tilføjelse til kurv', 'error');
        }
    }
    
    // Show notification
    function showNotification(message, type = 'info') {
        // Remove existing notifications
        const existingNotifications = document.querySelectorAll('.notification');
        existingNotifications.forEach(notification => notification.remove());
        
        // Create notification element
        const notification = document.createElement('div');
        notification.className = `notification fixed top-4 right-4 z-50 px-6 py-3 rounded-lg shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 transform translate-x-full`;
        
        // Set colors based on type
        let bgColor, textColor, icon;
        switch (type) {
            case 'success':
                bgColor = 'bg-green-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>';
                break;
            case 'warning':
                bgColor = 'bg-yellow-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-2.5L13.732 4c-.77-.833-1.964-.833-2.732 0L3.732 16.5c-.77.833.192 2.5 1.732 2.5z"></path></svg>';
                break;
            case 'error':
                bgColor = 'bg-red-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"></path></svg>';
                break;
            default:
                bgColor = 'bg-blue-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 16h-1v-4h-1m1-4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>';
        }
        
        notification.className += ` ${bgColor} ${textColor}`;
        notification.innerHTML = `
            <div class="flex items-center">
                ${icon}
                <span>${message}</span>
            </div>
        `;
        
        document.body.appendChild(notification);
        
        // Animate in
        setTimeout(() => {
            notification.classList.remove('translate-x-full');
        }, 100);
        
        // Auto remove after 3 seconds
        setTimeout(() => {
            notification.classList.add('translate-x-full');
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (notification.parentNode) {
                    notification.remove();
                }
            }, 300);
        }, 3000);
    }
});
</script>

{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}{{ product.name }} - Festudlej{% endblock %}

{% block extra_head %}
<meta http-equiv="Cache-Control" content="no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate">
<meta http-equiv="Pragma" content="no-cache">
<meta http-equiv="Expires" content="0">
<meta name="csrf-token" content="{{ csrf_token() }}">
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="bg-white">
    <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
        <!-- Breadcrumb -->
        <nav class="mb-8">
            <ol class="flex items-center space-x-2 text-sm text-gray-500">
                <li><a href="{{ url_for('public.index') }}" class="hover:text-indigo-600">Hjem</a></li>
                <li>/</li>
                <li><a href="{{ url_for('public.catalog') }}" class="hover:text-indigo-600">Katalog</a></li>
                <li>/</li>
                <li><a href="{{ url_for('public.catalog', category=product.category.id) }}" class="hover:text-indigo-600">{{ product.category.name }}</a></li>
                <li>/</li>
                <li class="text-gray-900">{{ product.name }}</li>
            </ol>
        </nav>
        
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12">
            <!-- Product Images -->
            <div>
                <div class="mb-4">
                    {% if product.hero_image_url %}
                    <img src="{{ product.hero_image_url | image_url }}" alt="{{ product.name }}" 
                         class="w-full h-96 object-cover rounded-lg">
                    {% else %}
                    <div class="w-full h-96 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                        <span class="text-gray-500 text-lg">Ingen billede</span>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                
                <!-- Additional Images -->
                {% if product.images %}
                <div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                    {% for image in product.images[:4] %}
                    <img src="{{ image.url }}" alt="{{ image.alt }}" 
                         class="w-full h-20 object-cover rounded cursor-pointer hover:opacity-75">
                    {% endfor %}
                </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
            
            <!-- Product Info -->
            <div>
                <div class="mb-4">
                    <span class="inline-block bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 text-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-full">
                        {{ product.category.name }}
                    </span>
                </div>
                
                <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">{{ product.name }}</h1>
                
                <div class="mb-6">
                    <div class="text-3xl font-bold text-indigo-600 mb-2">
                        {{ product.daily_price_dkk | currency }}

                    </div>
                    {% if product.weekend_price_dkk %}
                    <div class="text-lg text-gray-600">
                        Weekend: {{ product.weekend_price_dkk | currency }}/dag
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                    {% if product.deposit_dkk %}
                    <div class="text-sm text-gray-500">
                        Depositum: {{ product.deposit_dkk | currency }} (refunderbart)
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                
                <!-- Integrated Calendar -->
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden mb-6">
                    <!-- Calendar Header -->
                    <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 px-6 py-4">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-white">Vælg dine datoer</h3>
                                <p class="text-indigo-100 mt-1">Klik på start- og slutdato for at se tilgængelighed</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-right">
                                <div id="selection-info" class="text-white">
                                    <div class="text-sm opacity-75">Vælg datoer</div>
                                    <div id="selected-dates" class="font-semibold">-</div>

                            </div>

                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Calendar Container -->
                    <div class="p-6">

                    <!-- Selection Summary & Actions -->
                    <div id="selection-summary" class="hidden bg-gray-50 px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-200">
                        <div class="space-y-4">
                            <!-- Availability Status -->
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <div class="flex items-center space-x-4">
                                    <div id="availability-status" class="flex items-center">
                                        <!-- Status icon will be inserted here -->
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <div id="availability-text" class="font-semibold text-gray-900"></div>

                            <!-- Action Buttons -->
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-gray-200">

                                    Ryd valg
                                </button>
                                <button id="add-to-cart" 
                                        class="px-8 py-3 text-lg font-medium text-white bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 rounded-lg hover:from-indigo-700 hover:to-purple-700 transition-all duration-200 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                                        disabled>
                                    Tilføj til kurv
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Legend -->
                    <div class="bg-gray-50 px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-200">
                        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-6">
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <div class="w-4 h-4 bg-green-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-sm"></div>
                                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Tilgængelig</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <div class="w-4 h-4 bg-red-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-sm"></div>
                                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Ikke tilgængelig</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <div class="w-4 h-4 bg-gray-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-sm"></div>
                                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Sortdato</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <div class="w-4 h-4 bg-yellow-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-sm"></div>
                                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Begrænset</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Product Description -->
                {% if product.description %}
                <div class="mb-6">
                    <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-2">Beskrivelse</h3>
                    <div class="prose max-w-none text-gray-600">
                        {{ product.description | safe }}
                    </div>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
                
                <!-- Product Details -->
                <div class="border-t pt-6">
                    <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4">Produktdetaljer</h3>
                    <dl class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                        <div>
                            <dt class="font-medium text-gray-500">Kategori</dt>
                            <dd class="text-gray-900">{{ product.category.name }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <dt class="font-medium text-gray-500">Lagerantal</dt>
                            <dd class="text-gray-900">{{ product.stock_qty }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        {% if product.prep_buffer_days > 0 %}

                        {% if product.cleanup_buffer_days > 0 %}
                        <div>
                            <dt class="font-medium text-gray-500">Oprydningsdage</dt>
                            <dd class="text-gray-900">{{ product.cleanup_buffer_days }} dag{{ 'er' if product.cleanup_buffer_days != 1 else '' }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </dl>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Related Products -->
        {% if related_products %}
        <div class="mt-16">
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-8">Relaterede produkter</h2>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
                {% for related_product in related_products %}
                <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md overflow-hidden hover:shadow-lg transition duration-200">
                    <a href="{{ url_for('public.product_detail', slug=related_product.slug) }}">
                        {% if related_product.hero_image_url %}
                        <img src="{{ related_product.hero_image_url | image_url }}" alt="{{ related_product.name }}" class="w-full h-48 object-cover">
                        {% else %}
                        <div class="w-full h-48 bg-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <span class="text-gray-500">Ingen billede</span>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </a>
                    
                    <div class="p-4">
                        <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-2">
                            <a href="{{ url_for('public.product_detail', slug=related_product.slug) }}" class="hover:text-indigo-600">
                                {{ related_product.name }}
                            </a>
                        </h3>
                        
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div class="text-xl font-bold text-indigo-600">
                                {{ related_product.daily_price_dkk | currency }}
                                <span class="text-sm font-normal text-gray-500">/dag</span>
                            </div>
                            <a href="{{ url_for('public.product_detail', slug=related_product.slug) }}" 
                               class="bg-indigo-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-indigo-700 transition duration-200">
                                Se detaljer
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                {% endfor %}
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    let selectedStartDate = null;
    let selectedEndDate = null;
    let calendar = null;
    let availabilityData = {};
    
    // Initialize calendar
    const calendarEl = document.getElementById('calendar');
    calendar = new FullCalendar.Calendar(calendarEl, {
        initialView: 'dayGridMonth',
        locale: 'da',
        selectAllow: function(selectInfo) {
            // Allow selection only for future dates
            const today = new Date();
            today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
            return selectInfo.start >= today;
        },
        headerToolbar: {
            left: 'prev,next today',
            center: 'title',
            right: 'dayGridMonth,dayGridWeek,listWeek'
        },
        buttonText: {
            today: 'I dag',
            month: 'Måned',
            week: 'Uge',
            list: 'Liste'
        },
        selectable: true,
        selectMirror: true,
        selectOverlap: true,
        unselectAuto: false,
        selectLongPressDelay: 100,
        events: function(info, successCallback, failureCallback) {
            // Simple, reliable date format extraction
            let startDate, endDate;
            
            // Handle both string and Date objects
            if (typeof info.start === 'string') {
                startDate = info.start.split('T')[0];
            } else {
                startDate = info.start.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            }
            
            if (typeof info.end === 'string') {
                endDate = info.end.split('T')[0];
            } else {
                endDate = info.end.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            }
            
            console.log('📅 Fetching calendar data:', { startDate, endDate, productId: {{ product.id }} });
            
            fetch(`/api/calendar-data/{{ product.id }}?start=${startDate}&end=${endDate}&t=${Date.now()}`)
                .then(response => {
                    console.log('📅 Calendar API response:', response.status);
                    if (!response.ok) {
                        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
                    }
                    return response.json();
                })
                .then(data => {
                    console.log('📅 Calendar data received:', data.length, 'days');
                    
                    // Store availability data for later use
                    availabilityData = {};
                    data.forEach(day => {
                        availabilityData[day.date] = day;
                    });
                    
                    // Create clean, subtle visual indicators
                    const events = data.map(day => {
                        if (day.is_blacked_out) {
                            return {
                                date: day.date,
                                display: 'background',
                                backgroundColor: 'rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.2)',
                                title: 'Ikke tilgængelig',
                                classNames: 'blackout-date',
                                overlap: false
                            };
                        } else if (day.is_available && day.available_quantity > 0) {
                            // Clean color coding without overwhelming text
                            let backgroundColor;
                            if (day.available_quantity >= 3) {
                                backgroundColor = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)'; // Very light green
                            } else {
                                backgroundColor = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)'; // Very light yellow
                            }
                            
                            return {
                                date: day.date,
                                display: 'background',
                                backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
                                title: `${day.available_quantity} enheder`,
                                classNames: 'available-date',
                                overlap: true  // Allow selection over available dates
                            };
                        } else {
                            return {
                                date: day.date,
                                display: 'background',
                                backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)',
                                title: 'Ikke tilgængelig',
                                classNames: 'unavailable-date',
                                overlap: false
                            };
                        }
                    });
                    
                    console.log('📅 Calendar events created:', events.length);
                    successCallback(events);
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.error('📅 Calendar error:', error);
                    // Don't show error in calendar, just log it
                    successCallback([]);
                });
        },
        select: function(info) {
            const startDate = info.startStr;
            const endDate = info.endStr;
            const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            
            console.log('📅 SELECT TRIGGERED:', info);
            console.log('📅 Date range selected:', { startDate, endDate, today });
            
            // Validate dates
            if (startDate < today) {
                showNotification('Vælg venligst fremtidige datoer', 'warning');
                calendar.unselect();
                return;
            }
            
            // FullCalendar's endDate is exclusive, so subtract 1 day to make it inclusive
            const actualEndDate = new Date(endDate);
            actualEndDate.setDate(actualEndDate.getDate() - 1);
            const inclusiveEndDate = actualEndDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            
            selectedStartDate = startDate;
            selectedEndDate = inclusiveEndDate;
            
            updateSelectionDisplay();
            checkAvailability();
            
            const days = Math.ceil((actualEndDate - new Date(startDate)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
            showNotification(`${days} dag${days > 1 ? 'e' : ''} valgt - beregner pris...`, 'success');
        },
        selectStart: function(info) {
            console.log('🎯 SELECTION STARTED:', info);
        },
        selectEnd: function(info) {
            console.log('🎯 SELECTION ENDED:', info);
        },
        dateClick: function(info) {
            const clickedDate = info.dateStr;
            const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            
            if (clickedDate < today) {
                showNotification('Vælg venligst fremtidige datoer', 'warning');
                return;
            }
            
            console.log('Date clicked:', clickedDate, 'Current selection:', selectedStartDate, selectedEndDate);
            
            // Simple, intuitive date selection
            if (!selectedStartDate) {
                // First click - select start date
                selectedStartDate = clickedDate;
                selectedEndDate = clickedDate;
                calendar.select(clickedDate, clickedDate);
                updateSelectionDisplay();
                checkAvailability();
                showNotification('Dag valgt. Træk for at vælge flere dage eller klik "Tilføj til kurv"', 'success');
            } else if (selectedStartDate === clickedDate && selectedEndDate === clickedDate) {
                // Clicking same date - clear selection
                selectedStartDate = null;
                selectedEndDate = null;
                calendar.unselect();
                updateSelectionDisplay();
                hideSelectionSummary();
                showNotification('Valg ryddet', 'info');
            } else {
                // Click elsewhere - start new selection
                selectedStartDate = clickedDate;
                selectedEndDate = clickedDate;
                calendar.select(clickedDate, clickedDate);
                updateSelectionDisplay();
                checkAvailability();
                showNotification('Ny periode valgt', 'success');
            }
        },
        dayMaxEvents: false,
        height: 'auto',
        dayCellClassNames: function(info) {
            const today = new Date();
            const cellDate = new Date(info.date);
            
            if (cellDate < today) {
                return ['past-date'];
            }
            return [];
        }
    });
    
    calendar.render();
    
    // Update selection display
    function updateSelectionDisplay() {
        const selectedDatesEl = document.getElementById('selected-dates');
        const selectionInfoEl = document.getElementById('selection-info');
        
        if (selectedStartDate && selectedEndDate) {
            if (selectedStartDate === selectedEndDate) {
                selectedDatesEl.textContent = formatDate(selectedStartDate);
            } else {
                selectedDatesEl.textContent = `${formatDate(selectedStartDate)} - ${formatDate(selectedEndDate)}`;
            }
            selectionInfoEl.querySelector('.text-sm').textContent = 'Valgte datoer';
        } else {
            selectedDatesEl.textContent = '-';
            selectionInfoEl.querySelector('.text-sm').textContent = 'Vælg datoer';
        }
    }
    
    // Check availability for selected dates
    async function checkAvailability() {
        if (!selectedStartDate || !selectedEndDate) return;
        
        const availabilityStatusEl = document.getElementById('availability-status');
        const availabilityTextEl = document.getElementById('availability-text');
        const availabilityDetailsEl = document.getElementById('availability-details');
        const selectionSummaryEl = document.getElementById('selection-summary');
        const addToCartBtn = document.getElementById('add-to-cart');
        const priceDisplayEl = document.getElementById('price-display');
        const priceDetailsEl = document.getElementById('price-details');
        
        // Show loading state
        availabilityStatusEl.innerHTML = '<div class="animate-spin rounded-full h-6 w-6 border-b-2 border-indigo-600"></div>';
        availabilityTextEl.textContent = 'Tjekker tilgængelighed...';
        availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = '';
        priceDisplayEl.textContent = 'Beregner pris...';
        priceDetailsEl.textContent = '';
        selectionSummaryEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        addToCartBtn.disabled = true;
        
        // Check availability using the stored data
        let isAvailable = true;
        let minAvailableQuantity = Infinity;
        let hasBlackout = false;
        
        const startDate = new Date(selectedStartDate);
        const endDate = new Date(selectedEndDate);
        const currentDate = new Date(startDate);
        
        while (currentDate <= endDate) {
            const dateStr = currentDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            const dayData = availabilityData[dateStr];
            
            if (dayData) {
                if (dayData.is_blacked_out) {
                    hasBlackout = true;
                    isAvailable = false;
                    break;
                } else if (!dayData.is_available) {
                    isAvailable = false;
                    break;
                } else {
                    minAvailableQuantity = Math.min(minAvailableQuantity, dayData.available_quantity);
                }
            } else {
                isAvailable = false;
                break;
            }
            
            currentDate.setDate(currentDate.getDate() + 1);
        }
        
        // Update UI based on availability
        if (isAvailable && !hasBlackout) {
            availabilityStatusEl.innerHTML = '<svg class="w-6 h-6 text-green-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>';
            availabilityTextEl.textContent = 'Tilgængelig!';
            availabilityTextEl.className = 'font-semibold text-green-800';
            availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = `${minAvailableQuantity} enheder tilgængelige`;
            availabilityDetailsEl.className = 'text-sm text-green-600';
            
            // Calculate and display price
            calculatePrice();
        } else {
            availabilityStatusEl.innerHTML = '<svg class="w-6 h-6 text-red-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"></path></svg>';
            availabilityTextEl.textContent = 'Ikke tilgængelig';
            availabilityTextEl.className = 'font-semibold text-red-800';
            if (hasBlackout) {
                availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = 'Sortdato i den valgte periode';
            } else {
                availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = 'Ikke tilgængelig i den valgte periode';
            }
            availabilityDetailsEl.className = 'text-sm text-red-600';
            priceDisplayEl.textContent = '';
            priceDetailsEl.textContent = '';
            addToCartBtn.disabled = true;
        }
    }
    
    // Clear selection
    document.getElementById('clear-selection').addEventListener('click', function() {
        selectedStartDate = null;
        selectedEndDate = null;
        calendar.unselect();
        updateSelectionDisplay();
        hideSelectionSummary();
    });
    
    // Add to cart button
    document.getElementById('add-to-cart').addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (selectedStartDate && selectedEndDate) {
            // Add to cart with selected dates
            addToCart();
        }
    });
    
    // Hide selection summary
    function hideSelectionSummary() {
        document.getElementById('selection-summary').classList.add('hidden');
    }
    
    // Robust price calculation
    async function calculatePrice() {
        const priceDisplayEl = document.getElementById('price-display');
        const priceDetailsEl = document.getElementById('price-details');
        const addToCartBtn = document.getElementById('add-to-cart');
        
        if (!selectedStartDate || !selectedEndDate) {
            priceDisplayEl.textContent = '';
            priceDetailsEl.textContent = '';
            addToCartBtn.disabled = true;
            return;
        }
        
        // Show loading state
        priceDisplayEl.textContent = 'Beregner...';
        priceDetailsEl.textContent = '';
        addToCartBtn.disabled = true;
        
        try {
            console.log('💰 Calculating price for:', selectedStartDate, 'to', selectedEndDate);
            
            // Calculate number of days (inclusive)
            const startDate = new Date(selectedStartDate);
            const endDate = new Date(selectedEndDate);
            const daysDiff = Math.ceil((endDate - startDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
            
            const url = `/api/price-estimate/{{ product.id }}?start_date=${selectedStartDate}&end_date=${selectedEndDate}&quantity=1&delivery_type=pickup&t=${Date.now()}`;
            console.log('💰 Fetching price from:', url);
            
            const response = await fetch(url);
            console.log('💰 Price API response:', response.status);
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
            }
            
            const data = await response.json();
            console.log('💰 Price data received:', data);
            
            console.log('💰 Checking response data structure:', JSON.stringify(data));
            
            // API returns pricing data directly (no 'success' wrapper)
            console.log('💰 Checking pricing data:', data);
            console.log('💰 total:', data.total, 'type:', typeof data.total);
            
            // Parse API response - get the daily rate from the line items
            const totalPrice = data.total ? Math.round(parseFloat(data.total)) : 0;
            let dailyRate = 0;
            
            // Get the daily rate from the first line item (product rental)
            if (data.line_items && data.line_items.length > 0) {
                dailyRate = Math.round(parseFloat(data.line_items[0].unit_price));
            } else {
                // Fallback calculation if no line items
                dailyRate = Math.round(totalPrice / daysDiff);
            }
            
            console.log('💰 Line items:', data.line_items);
            console.log('💰 Parsed values:', { totalPrice, dailyRate, daysDiff, unitPrice: data.line_items?.[0]?.unit_price });
            
            if (totalPrice > 0) {
                priceDisplayEl.textContent = `${totalPrice} kr.`;
                priceDetailsEl.textContent = `${daysDiff} dag${daysDiff > 1 ? 'e' : ''} • ${dailyRate} kr./dag`;
                addToCartBtn.disabled = false;
                
                console.log('💰 SUCCESS! Price displayed:', { totalPrice, dailyRate, daysDiff });
            } else {
                console.error('💰 No valid price found:', data);
                throw new Error('No valid price data received');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('💰 Price calculation error:', error);
            
            // Fallback: Show basic price info without API
            const daysDiff = Math.ceil((new Date(selectedEndDate) - new Date(selectedStartDate)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
            priceDisplayEl.textContent = 'Se pris i kurv';
            priceDetailsEl.textContent = `${daysDiff} dag${daysDiff > 1 ? 'e' : ''} valgt`;
            addToCartBtn.disabled = false;
        }
    }
    
    // Format date for display
    function formatDate(dateStr) {
        const date = new Date(dateStr);
        return date.toLocaleDateString('da-DK', {
            day: 'numeric',
            month: 'short',
            year: 'numeric'
        });
    }
    
    // Add to cart function
    async function addToCart() {
        if (!selectedStartDate || !selectedEndDate) {
            showNotification('Vælg venligst datoer først', 'warning');
            return;
        }
        
        try {
            console.log('🛒 Adding to cart with data:', {
                product_id: {{ product.id }},
                start_date: selectedStartDate,
                end_date: selectedEndDate,
                quantity: 1,
                delivery_type: 'pickup'
            });
            
            // Create FormData with CSRF token
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('product_id', {{ product.id }});
            formData.append('start_date', selectedStartDate);
            formData.append('end_date', selectedEndDate);
            formData.append('quantity', 1);
            formData.append('delivery_type', 'pickup');
            
            // Get CSRF token from meta tag
            const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]');
            if (csrfToken) {
                const tokenValue = csrfToken.getAttribute('content');
                formData.append('csrf_token', tokenValue);
                console.log('🛒 CSRF token found and added:', tokenValue ? 'YES' : 'NO');
            } else {
                console.error('🛒 CSRF token meta tag not found!');
            }
            
            console.log('🛒 Sending request to /shop/add-to-cart...');
            const response = await fetch('/shop/add-to-cart', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData
            });
            
            console.log('🛒 Add to cart response status:', response.status);
            
            const data = await response.json();
            
            if (data.success) {
                showNotification('Produkt tilføjet til kurv!', 'success');
                // Update cart count
                const app = Alpine.$data(document.querySelector('[x-data]'));
                if (app && app.updateCartCount) {
                    app.updateCartCount();
                }
            } else {
                showNotification(data.error || 'Der opstod en fejl', 'error');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error adding to cart:', error);
            showNotification('Der opstod en fejl under tilføjelse til kurv', 'error');
        }
    }
    
    // Show notification
    function showNotification(message, type = 'info') {
        // Remove existing notifications
        const existingNotifications = document.querySelectorAll('.notification');
        existingNotifications.forEach(notification => notification.remove());
        
        // Create notification element
        const notification = document.createElement('div');
        notification.className = `notification fixed top-4 right-4 z-50 px-6 py-3 rounded-lg shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 transform translate-x-full`;
        
        // Set colors based on type
        let bgColor, textColor, icon;
        switch (type) {
            case 'success':
                bgColor = 'bg-green-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>';
                break;
            case 'warning':
                bgColor = 'bg-yellow-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-2.5L13.732 4c-.77-.833-1.964-.833-2.732 0L3.732 16.5c-.77.833.192 2.5 1.732 2.5z"></path></svg>';
                break;
            case 'error':
                bgColor = 'bg-red-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"></path></svg>';
                break;
            default:
                bgColor = 'bg-blue-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 16h-1v-4h-1m1-4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>';
        }
        
        notification.className += ` ${bgColor} ${textColor}`;
        notification.innerHTML = `
            <div class="flex items-center">
                ${icon}
                <span>${message}</span>
            </div>
        `;
        
        document.body.appendChild(notification);
        
        // Animate in
        setTimeout(() => {
            notification.classList.remove('translate-x-full');
        }, 100);
        
        // Auto remove after 3 seconds
        setTimeout(() => {
            notification.classList.add('translate-x-full');
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (notification.parentNode) {
                    notification.remove();
                }
            }, 300);
        }, 3000);
    }
});
</script>

The `base_price` is the **total price for all days** (daily_price × rental_days), but the `unit_price` should be the **daily price**.
