    }
    
    /* Mobile calendar adjustments */
    .calendar-container {
        min-height: 400px !important;
    }
    
    .fc {
        font-size: 0.875rem !important;
    }
}

/* Image gallery styles */
.thumbnail-btn {
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.thumbnail-btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

/* Enhanced animations */
@keyframes slideInUp {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(30px);
    }
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.animate-slide-in-up {
    animation: slideInUp 0.6s ease-out;
}

@keyframes fadeInScale {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.9);
    }
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: scale(1);
    }
}

.animate-fade-in-scale {
    animation: fadeInScale 0.4s ease-out;
}

/* Price display animation */
.price-display {
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* Smooth scroll behavior */
html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* Loading states */
.loading-shimmer {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f0f0f0 25%, #e0e0e0 50%, #f0f0f0 75%);
    background-size: 200% 100%;
    animation: shimmer 2s infinite;
}

@keyframes shimmer {
    0% {
        background-position: -200% 0;
    }
    100% {
        background-position: 200% 0;
    }
}

/* Floating animation for trust signals */
@keyframes float {
    0%, 100% {
        transform: translateY(0px);
    }
    50% {
        transform: translateY(-10px);
    }
}

.float-animation {
    animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.float-animation:nth-child(2) {
    animation-delay: 2s;
}

.float-animation:nth-child(3) {
    animation-delay: 4s;
}

.past-date {
    opacity: 0.5;
    background-color: #f9fafb;
}

/* Modern Toolbar Styling */
.fc-toolbar {
    padding: 1rem 1.5rem !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fafc 0%, #f1f5f9 100%) !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0 !important;
    margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
}

.fc-toolbar-title {
    font-size: 1.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    color: #0f172a !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

.fc-button {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6 0%, #6366f1 100%) !important;
    border: none !important;
    color: white !important;
    border-radius: 0.875rem !important;
    padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2) !important;
    transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}

.fc-button:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb 0%, #4f46e5 100%) !important;
    transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 12px -2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3) !important;
}

.fc-button:focus {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2) !important;
    outline: none !important;
}

.fc-button-active {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #3730a3 100%) !important;
}

/* Modern Day Cell Styling */
.fc-daygrid-day {
    border: none !important;
    margin: 0.25rem !important;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    position: relative;
    overflow: visible;
    background: white;
    border-radius: 1rem !important;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    min-height: 4rem !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day:hover:not(.fc-day-selected):not(.past-date) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fafc 0%, #f1f5f9 100%) !important;
    transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px -4px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2) !important;
}

/* Prevent hover effects on selected dates */
.fc-daygrid-day.fc-day-selected:hover {
    transform: none;
    background-color: #3b82f6 !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day-number {
    width: 100% !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    min-height: 3.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    font-size: 1.125rem !important;
    color: #374151 !important;
    transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day.past-date {
    opacity: 0.4;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.fc-event {
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 0.375rem;
    margin: 0.0625rem;
}

/* Clean calendar grid */
.fc-daygrid-day-frame {
    min-height: 60px;
}

/* Modern Calendar Grid */
.fc-scrollgrid {
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 1.5rem !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.fc-scrollgrid-sync-table {
    width: 100% !important;
}

/* Modern Column Headers */
.fc-col-header-cell {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fafc 0%, #f1f5f9 100%) !important;
    border: none !important;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0 !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    color: #1e293b !important;
    padding: 1rem 0.5rem !important;
    text-transform: uppercase !important;
    font-size: 0.75rem !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em !important;
}

/* Generous day cell sizing */
.fc-daygrid-day {
    width: calc(14.28571429% - 0.5rem) !important; /* Generous spacing */
    min-width: 0 !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day-top {
    width: 100% !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day-frame {
    min-height: 4rem !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-body {
    border: none;
}

/* Selection highlighting */
.fc-highlight {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1, #8b5cf6) !important;
    opacity: 0.25;
    border-radius: 0.375rem;
    animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% {
        opacity: 0.25;
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 0.35;
    }
}

/* Modern Today Styling */
.fc-day-today {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3f4f6, #e5e7eb) !important;
    color: #374151 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
    border: 2px solid #9ca3af !important;
    transform: none !important;
    opacity: 0.7 !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
}

.fc-day-today .fc-daygrid-day-number {
    color: #6b7280 !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    font-size: 1rem !important;
}

/* Modern Selection Styling - Multi-day (Green) */
.fc-daygrid-day.fc-day-selected {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #059669, #10b981) !important;
    color: white !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4) !important;
    border: none !important;
    transform: scale(1.03) !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day.fc-day-selected .fc-daygrid-day-number {
    color: white !important;
    font-weight: 800 !important;
}

/* Single Day Selection - Blue */
.fc-daygrid-day.single-day-selected {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #6366f1) !important;
    color: white !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4) !important;
    border: none !important;
    transform: scale(1.03) !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day.single-day-selected .fc-daygrid-day-number {
    color: white !important;
    font-weight: 800 !important;
}

/* Remove duplicate single-day selection styling */

/* Smooth transitions for all interactive elements */
.fc-daygrid-day,
.fc-daygrid-day-number,
.status-indicator {
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

/* Enhanced status indicators */
.status-indicator {
    pointer-events: all;
    user-select: none;
    position: relative;
}

.status-indicator::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    border-radius: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.status-indicator:hover::after {
    width: 120%;
    height: 120%;
}

/* Accessibility improvements */
.status-indicator:focus {
    outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
    outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* High contrast mode support */
@media (prefers-contrast: high) {
    .status-indicator {
        border-width: 2px;
    }
    
    .fc-daygrid-day {
        border-width: 2px;
    }
}

/* Reduced motion support */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .status-indicator,
    .fc-daygrid-day,
    .thumbnail-btn,
    .price-display {
        transition: none;
        animation: none;
    }
    
    .float-animation {
        animation: none;
    }
}

.available-date {
    position: relative;
}

.available-date::after {
    content: '✓';
    position: absolute;
    top: 2px;
    right: 2px;
    color: white;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.unavailable-date {
    position: relative;
}

.unavailable-date::after {
    content: '✗';
    position: absolute;
    top: 2px;
    right: 2px;
    color: white;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.limited-date {
    position: relative;
}

.limited-date::after {
    content: '!';
    position: absolute;
    top: 2px;
    right: 2px;
    color: white;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.blackout-date {
    position: relative;
}

.blackout-date::after {
    content: '●';
    position: absolute;
    top: 2px;
    right: 2px;
    color: white;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: bold;
}

/* Additional utility classes */
.aspect-w-16 {
    position: relative;
    padding-bottom: 75%; /* 16:12 aspect ratio */
}

.aspect-w-16 > * {
    position: absolute;
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
}

/* Focus states for better accessibility */
button:focus,
a:focus,
.thumbnail-btn:focus {
    outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
    outline-offset: 2px;
    border-radius: 0.375rem;
}

/* Touch-friendly improvements */
@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
    .fc-daygrid-day {
        min-height: 3rem;
    }
    
    .thumbnail-btn {
        min-width: 5rem;
        min-height: 5rem;
    }
    
    button {
        min-height: 3rem;
        min-width: 3rem;
    }
}
</style>
{% endblock %}

{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}{{ product.name }} - Festudlej{% endblock %}

{% block extra_head %}
<meta http-equiv="Cache-Control" content="no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate">
