```html
            const url = `/api/price-estimate/{{ product.id }}?start_date=${selectedStartDate}&end_date=${selectedEndDate}&quantity=1&delivery_type=pickup&t=${Date.now()}`;
            console.log('💰 Fetching price from:', url);
            
            const response = await fetch(url);
            console.log('💰 Price API response:', response.status);
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
            }
            
            const data = await response.json();
            console.log('💰 Price data received:', data);
            
            console.log('💰 Checking response data structure:', JSON.stringify(data));
            
            // API returns pricing data directly (no 'success' wrapper)
            console.log('💰 Checking pricing data:', data);
            console.log('💰 total:', data.total, 'type:', typeof data.total);
            
            // Parse API response - get the daily rate from the line items
            const totalPrice = data.total ? Math.round(parseFloat(data.total)) : 0;
            let dailyRate = 0;
            
            // Get the daily rate from the first line item (product rental)
            if (data.line_items && data.line_items.length > 0) {
                dailyRate = Math.round(parseFloat(data.line_items[0].unit_price));
            } else {
                // Fallback calculation if no line items
                dailyRate = Math.round(totalPrice / daysDiff);
            }
            
            console.log('💰 Line items:', data.line_items);
            console.log('💰 Parsed values:', { totalPrice, dailyRate, daysDiff, unitPrice: data.line_items?.[0]?.unit_price });
            
            if (totalPrice > 0) {
                priceDisplayEl.textContent = `${totalPrice} kr.`;
                
                // Build price details with deposit info
                let detailsText = `${daysDiff} dag${daysDiff > 1 ? 'e' : ''} • ${dailyRate} kr./dag`;
                
                // Add deposit information if present
                const depositAmount = data.deposit_amount ? Math.round(parseFloat(data.deposit_amount)) : 0;
                if (depositAmount > 0) {
                    detailsText += `\nDeposit: ${depositAmount} kr. (refunderbart)`;
                }
                
                priceDetailsEl.innerHTML = detailsText.replace('\n', '<br>');
                addToCartBtn.disabled = false;
                
                console.log('💰 SUCCESS! Price displayed:', { totalPrice, dailyRate, daysDiff, depositAmount });
                
                // Add subtle animation to price display
                priceDisplayEl.style.transform = 'scale(1.05)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    priceDisplayEl.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                }, 200);
            } else {
                console.error('💰 No valid price found:', data);
                throw new Error('No valid price data received');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('💰 Price calculation error:', error);
            
            // Fallback: Show basic price info without API
            const daysDiff = Math.ceil((new Date(selectedEndDate) - new Date(selectedStartDate)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
            priceDisplayEl.textContent = 'Se pris i kurv';
            priceDetailsEl.textContent = `${daysDiff} dag${daysDiff > 1 ? 'e' : ''} valgt`;
            addToCartBtn.disabled = false;
            
            // Add error state styling
            priceDisplayEl.classList.add('text-yellow-600');
            setTimeout(() => {
                priceDisplayEl.classList.remove('text-yellow-600');
            }, 3000);
        }
    }
    
    // Format date for display
    function formatDate(dateStr) {
        const date = new Date(dateStr);
        return date.toLocaleDateString('da-DK', {
            day: 'numeric',
            month: 'short',
            year: 'numeric'
        });
    }
    
    // Add to cart function
    async function addToCart() {
        if (!selectedStartDate || !selectedEndDate) {
            showNotification('Vælg venligst datoer først', 'warning');
            return;
        }
        
        try {
            console.log('🛒 Adding to cart with data:', {
                product_id: {{ product.id }},
                start_date: selectedStartDate,
                end_date: selectedEndDate,
                quantity: 1,
                delivery_type: 'pickup'
            });
            
            // Create FormData with CSRF token
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('product_id', {{ product.id }});
            formData.append('start_date', selectedStartDate);
            formData.append('end_date', selectedEndDate);
            formData.append('quantity', 1);
            formData.append('delivery_type', 'pickup');
            
            // Get CSRF token from meta tag
            const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]');
            if (csrfToken) {
                const tokenValue = csrfToken.getAttribute('content');
                formData.append('csrf_token', tokenValue);
                console.log('🛒 CSRF token found and added:', tokenValue ? 'YES' : 'NO');
            } else {
                console.error('🛒 CSRF token meta tag not found!');
            }
            
            console.log('🛒 Sending request to /shop/add-to-cart...');
            const response = await fetch('/shop/add-to-cart', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData
            });
            
            console.log('🛒 Add to cart response status:', response.status);
            console.log('🛒 Response headers:', response.headers.get('content-type'));
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                const errorText = await response.text();
                console.error('🛒 Server error response:', errorText);
                throw new Error(`Server error: ${response.status} - ${errorText}`);
            }
            
            const data = await response.json();
            console.log('🛒 Response data:', data);
            
            if (data.success) {
                showNotification('Produkt tilføjet til kurv!', 'success');
                
                // Update cart count directly from server response
                if (data.cart_count !== undefined) {
                    const cartCountEl = document.getElementById('cart-count');
                    const cartCountMobileEl = document.getElementById('cart-count-mobile');
                    if (cartCountEl) cartCountEl.textContent = data.cart_count;
                    if (cartCountMobileEl) cartCountMobileEl.textContent = data.cart_count;
                    console.log('🛒 Cart count updated to:', data.cart_count);
                }
            } else {
                console.error('🛒 Server returned error:', data.error);
                showNotification(data.error || 'Der opstod en fejl', 'error');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error adding to cart:', error);
            showNotification('Der opstod en fejl under tilføjelse til kurv', 'error');
        }
    }
    
    // Show notification
    function showNotification(message, type = 'info') {
        // Remove existing notifications
        const existingNotifications = document.querySelectorAll('.notification');
        existingNotifications.forEach(notification => notification.remove());
        
        // Create notification element
        const notification = document.createElement('div');
        notification.className = `notification fixed top-4 right-4 z-50 px-6 py-3 rounded-lg shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 transform translate-x-full`;
        
        // Set colors based on type
        let bgColor, textColor, icon;
        switch (type) {
            case 'success':
                bgColor = 'bg-green-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>';
                break;
            case 'warning':
                bgColor = 'bg-yellow-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-2.5L13.732 4c-.77-.833-1.964-.833-2.732 0L3.732 16.5c-.77.833.192 2.5 1.732 2.5z"></path></svg>';
                break;
            case 'error':
                bgColor = 'bg-red-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"></path></svg>';
                break;
            default:
                bgColor = 'bg-blue-500';
                textColor = 'text-white';
                icon = '<svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 16h-1v-4h-1m1-4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>';
        }
        
        notification.className += ` ${bgColor} ${textColor}`;
        notification.innerHTML = `
            <div class="flex items-center">
                ${icon}
                <span>${message}</span>
            </div>
        `;
        
        document.body.appendChild(notification);
        
        // Animate in
        setTimeout(() => {
            notification.classList.remove('translate-x-full');
        }, 100);
        
        // Auto remove after 3 seconds
        setTimeout(() => {
            notification.classList.add('translate-x-full');
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (notification.parentNode) {
                    notification.remove();
                }
            }, 300);
        }, 3000);
    }
});
</script>

<style>
/* Modern Calendar Container */
.modern-calendar {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    border-radius: 1.5rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

/* Modern Calendar Styling */
.fc {
    width: 100% !important;
    font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
    background: white;
    border-radius: 1.5rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.fc-view-harness {
    width: 100% !important;
    background: white;
}

.fc-daygrid {
    width: 100% !important;
}

/* Enhanced Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .fc-toolbar {
        flex-direction: row !important;
        flex-wrap: wrap !important;
        gap: 0.5rem !important;
        padding: 0.5rem !important;
    }
    
    .fc-toolbar-chunk {
        display: flex !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
    }
    
    .fc-toolbar-title {
        font-size: 1rem !important;
        order: -1 !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        text-align: center !important;
        margin-bottom: 0.5rem !important;
    }
    
    .fc-button {
        padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem !important;
        font-size: 0.75rem !important;
        margin: 0 0.0625rem !important;
    }
    
    .fc-daygrid-day {
        min-height: 3rem !important;
    }
    
    .fc-daygrid-day-frame {
        min-height: 3rem !important;
    }
    
    .fc-daygrid-day-number {
        font-size: 0.875rem !important;
        min-height: 2rem !important;
    }
    
    .status-indicator {
        width: 8px !important;
        height: 8px !important;
        top: 2px !important;
        left: 2px !important;
    }
    
    /* Mobile calendar adjustments */
    .modern-calendar {
        font-size: 0.875rem !important;
    }
}

/* Image gallery styles */
.thumbnail-btn {
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.thumbnail-btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

/* Enhanced animations */
@keyframes slideInUp {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(30px);
    }
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

.animate-slide-in-up {
    animation: slideInUp 0.6s ease-out;
}

@keyframes fadeInScale {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.9);
    }
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: scale(1);
    }
}

.animate-fade-in-scale {
    animation: fadeInScale 0.4s ease-out;
}

/* Price display animation */
.price-display {
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* Smooth scroll behavior */
html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* Loading states */
.loading-shimmer {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f0f0f0 25%, #e0e0e0 50%, #f0f0f0 75%);
    background-size: 200% 100%;
    animation: shimmer 2s infinite;
}

@keyframes shimmer {
    0% {
        background-position: -200% 0;
    }
    100% {
        background-position: 200% 0;
    }
}

/* Floating animation for trust signals */
@keyframes float {
    0%, 100% {
        transform: translateY(0px);
    }
    50% {
        transform: translateY(-10px);
    }
}

.float-animation {
    animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.float-animation:nth-child(2) {
    animation-delay: 2s;
}

.float-animation:nth-child(3) {
    animation-delay: 4s;
}

.past-date {
    opacity: 0.5;
    background-color: #f9fafb;
}

/* Compact Modern Toolbar */
.fc-toolbar {
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem !important;
    background: white !important;
    border: none !important;
    margin-bottom: 1rem !important;
    border-radius: 0.75rem !important;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
}

.fc-toolbar-title {
    font-size: 1.125rem !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    color: #374151 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

.fc-button {
    background: #f3f4f6 !important;
    border: 1px solid #d1d5db !important;
    color: #374151 !important;
    border-radius: 0.5rem !important;
    padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    transition: all 0.15s ease !important;
    margin: 0 0.125rem !important;
}

.fc-button:hover {
    background: #e5e7eb !important;
    border-color: #9ca3af !important;
    transform: none !important;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) !important;
}

.fc-button:focus {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2) !important;
    outline: none !important;
    border-color: #3b82f6 !important;
}

.fc-button-active {
    background: #3b82f6 !important;
    border-color: #3b82f6 !important;
    color: white !important;
}

.fc-button-active:hover {
    background: #2563eb !important;
    border-color: #2563eb !important;
}

/* Modern Day Cell Styling */
.fc-daygrid-day {
    border: none !important;
    margin: 0.25rem !important;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    position: relative;
    overflow: visible;
    background: white;
    border-radius: 1rem !important;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    min-height: 4rem !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day:hover:not(.fc-day-selected):not(.past-date) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fafc 0%, #f1f5f9 100%) !important;
    transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px -4px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2) !important;
}

/* Prevent hover effects on selected dates */
.fc-daygrid-day.fc-day-selected:hover {
    transform: none;
    background-color: #3b82f6 !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day-number {
    width: 100% !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    min-height: 3.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    font-size: 1.125rem !important;
    color: #374151 !important;
    transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day.past-date {
    opacity: 0.4;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.fc-event {
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 0.375rem;
    margin: 0.0625rem;
}

/* Clean calendar grid */
.fc-daygrid-day-frame {
    min-height: 60px;
}

/* Modern Calendar Grid */
.fc-scrollgrid {
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 1.5rem !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.fc-scrollgrid-sync-table {
    width: 100% !important;
}

/* Modern Column Headers */
.fc-col-header-cell {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fafc 0%, #f1f5f9 100%) !important;
    border: none !important;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0 !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    color: #1e293b !important;
    padding: 1rem 0.5rem !important;
    text-transform: uppercase !important;
    font-size: 0.75rem !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em !important;
}

/* Generous day cell sizing */
.fc-daygrid-day {
    width: calc(14.28571429% - 0.5rem) !important; /* Generous spacing */
    min-width: 0 !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day-top {
    width: 100% !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day-frame {
    min-height: 4rem !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-body {
    border: none;
}

/* Selection highlighting */
.fc-highlight {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1, #8b5cf6) !important;
    opacity: 0.25;
    border-radius: 0.375rem;
    animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% {
        opacity: 0.25;
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 0.35;
    }
}

/* Modern Today Styling */
.fc-day-today {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3f4f6, #e5e7eb) !important;
    color: #374151 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
    border: 2px solid #9ca3af !important;
    transform: none !important;
    opacity: 0.7 !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
}

.fc-day-today .fc-daygrid-day-number {
    color: #6b7280 !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    font-size: 1rem !important;
}

/* Modern Selection Styling - Multi-day (Green) */
.fc-daygrid-day.fc-day-selected {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #059669, #10b981) !important;
    color: white !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4) !important;
    border: none !important;
    transform: scale(1.03) !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day.fc-day-selected .fc-daygrid-day-number {
    color: white !important;
    font-weight: 800 !important;
}

/* Single Day Selection - Blue */
.fc-daygrid-day.single-day-selected {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #6366f1) !important;
    color: white !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4) !important;
    border: none !important;
    transform: scale(1.03) !important;
}

.fc-daygrid-day.single-day-selected .fc-daygrid-day-number {
    color: white !important;
    font-weight: 800 !important;
}

/* Remove duplicate single-day selection styling */

/* Smooth transitions for all interactive elements */
.fc-daygrid-day,
.fc-daygrid-day-number,
.status-indicator {
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

/* Enhanced status indicators */
.status-indicator {
    pointer-events: all;
    user-select: none;
    position: relative;
}

.status-indicator::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    border-radius: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.status-indicator:hover::after {
    width: 120%;
    height: 120%;
}

/* Accessibility improvements */
.status-indicator:focus {
    outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
    outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* High contrast mode support */
@media (prefers-contrast: high) {
    .status-indicator {
        border-width: 2px;
    }
    
    .fc-daygrid-day {
        border-width: 2px;
    }
}

/* Reduced motion support */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .status-indicator,
    .fc-daygrid-day,
    .thumbnail-btn,
    .price-display {
        transition: none;
        animation: none;
    }
    
    .float-animation {
        animation: none;
    }
}

.available-date {
    position: relative;
}

.available-date::after {
    content: '✓';
    position: absolute;
    top: 2px;
    right: 2px;
    color: white;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.unavailable-date {
    position: relative;
}

.unavailable-date::after {
    content: '✗';
    position: absolute;
    top: 2px;
    right: 2px;
    color: white;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.limited-date {
    position: relative;
}

.limited-date::after {
    content: '!';
    position: absolute;
    top: 2px;
    right: 2px;
    color: white;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.blackout-date {
    position: relative;
}

.blackout-date::after {
    content: '●';
    position: absolute;
    top: 2px;
    right: 2px;
    color: white;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: bold;
}

/* Additional utility classes */
.aspect-w-16 {
    position: relative;
    padding-bottom: 75%; /* 16:12 aspect ratio */
}

.aspect-w-16 > * {
    position: absolute;
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
}

/* Focus states for better accessibility */
button:focus,
a:focus,
.thumbnail-btn:focus {
    outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
    outline-offset: 2px;
    border-radius: 0.375rem;
}

/* Touch-friendly improvements */
@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
    .fc-daygrid-day {
        min-height: 3rem;
    }
    
    .thumbnail-btn {
        min-width: 5rem;
        min-height: 5rem;
    }
    
    button {
        min-height: 3rem;
        min-width: 3rem;
    }
}
</style>
{% endblock %}

```

Now let me modify the pricing section to include the stock status as a small popup and remove the separate stock status section:

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}{{ product.name }} - Festudlej{% endblock %}

{% block extra_head %}
<meta http-equiv="Cache-Control" content="no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate">
<meta http-equiv="Pragma" content="no-cache">
<meta http-equiv="Expires" content="0">
<meta name="csrf-token" content="{{ csrf_token() }}">
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<!-- Hero Section with Gradient Background -->
<div class="bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 via-white to-blue-50 relative overflow-hidden">
    <!-- Background Pattern -->
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-[url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width="60" height="60" viewBox="0 0 60 60" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"%3E%3Cg fill="none" fill-rule="evenodd"%3E%3Cg fill="%230ea5e9" fill-opacity="0.03"%3E%3Ccircle cx="30" cy="30" r="2"/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E')] opacity-50"></div>
    
    <div class="relative max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-4 lg:py-8">
        <!-- Enhanced Breadcrumb -->
        <nav class="mb-6 lg:mb-8" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
            <ol class="flex items-center space-x-2 text-sm">
                <li><a href="{{ url_for('public.index') }}" class="text-gray-500 hover:text-primary-600 transition-colors duration-200 flex items-center">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M3 12l2-2m0 0l7-7 7 7M5 10v10a1 1 0 001 1h3m10-11l2 2m-2-2v10a1 1 0 01-1 1h-3m-6 0a1 1 0 001-1v-4a1 1 0 011-1h2a1 1 0 011 1v4a1 1 0 001 1m-6 0h6"></path>
                    </svg>
                    Hjem
                </a></li>
                <li class="text-gray-300">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                        <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M7.293 14.707a1 1 0 010-1.414L10.586 10 7.293 6.707a1 1 0 111.414-1.414l4 4a1 1 0 010 1.414l-4 4a1 1 0 01-1.414 0z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                    </svg>
                </li>
                <li><a href="{{ url_for('public.catalog') }}" class="text-gray-500 hover:text-primary-600 transition-colors duration-200">Katalog</a></li>
                <li class="text-gray-300">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                        <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M7.293 14.707a1 1 0 010-1.414L10.586 10 7.293 6.707a1 1 0 111.414-1.414l4 4a1 1 0 010 1.414l-4 4a1 1 0 01-1.414 0z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                    </svg>
                </li>
                <li><a href="{{ url_for('public.catalog', category=product.category.id) }}" class="text-gray-500 hover:text-primary-600 transition-colors duration-200">{{ product.category.name }}</a></li>
                <li class="text-gray-300">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                        <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M7.293 14.707a1 1 0 010-1.414L10.586 10 7.293 6.707a1 1 0 111.414-1.414l4 4a1 1 0 010 1.414l-4 4a1 1 0 01-1.414 0z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                    </svg>
                </li>
                <li class="text-gray-900 font-medium">{{ product.name }}</li>
            </ol>
        </nav>
        
        <!-- Main Product Section -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-8 lg:gap-12">
            <!-- Enhanced Product Gallery -->
            <div class="xl:col-span-3">
                <!-- Main Product Image -->
                <div class="relative group mb-6">
                    <div class="aspect-w-16 aspect-h-12 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden border border-gray-100">
                        {% if product.hero_image_url %}
                        <img id="main-product-image" 
                             src="{{ product.hero_image_url | image_url }}" 
                             alt="{{ product.name }}" 
                             class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105">
                        <!-- Image Zoom Overlay -->
                        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-0 group-hover:bg-opacity-10 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <div class="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300">
                                <div class="bg-white bg-opacity-90 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-full p-3 shadow-lg">
                                    <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-gray-700" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0zM10 7v3m0 0v3m0-3h3m-3 0H7"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% else %}
                        <div class="w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-100 to-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <div class="text-center">
                                <svg class="w-16 h-16 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1" d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                                </svg>
                                <span class="text-gray-500 text-lg font-medium">Intet billede tilgængeligt</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Image Badges -->
                    <div class="absolute top-4 left-4 flex flex-col space-y-2">
                        <div class="bg-green-500 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold shadow-lg flex items-center">
                            <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                            </svg>
                            Tilgængelig
                        </div>
                        {% if product.weekend_price_dkk %}
                        <div class="bg-accent-500 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold shadow-lg">
                            Weekend-special
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Thumbnail Gallery -->
                <div class="flex space-x-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
                    {% if product.hero_image_url %}
                    <button class="thumbnail-btn flex-shrink-0 w-20 h-20 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 border-primary-500 shadow-md" 
                            data-image="{{ product.hero_image_url | image_url }}">
                        <img src="{{ product.hero_image_url | image_url }}" alt="{{ product.name }}" 
                             class="w-full h-full object-cover">
                    </button>
                    {% endif %}
                    {% if product.images %}
                        {% for image in product.images[:6] %}
                        <button class="thumbnail-btn flex-shrink-0 w-20 h-20 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 border-gray-200 hover:border-primary-500 transition-all duration-200 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg" 
                                data-image="{{ image.url }}">
                            <img src="{{ image.url }}" alt="{{ image.alt or product.name }}" 
                                 class="w-full h-full object-cover hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-200">
                        </button>
                        {% endfor %}
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                
                <!-- Trust Signals -->
                <div class="mt-8 grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                    <div class="text-center p-4 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md border border-gray-100">
                        <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-green-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-2">
                            <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-green-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z"></path>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Forsikret</p>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Fuldt dækket</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-center p-4 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md border border-gray-100">
                        <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-blue-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-2">
                            <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11h-7z"></path>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Hurtig levering</p>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Samme dag</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-center p-4 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md border border-gray-100">
                        <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-purple-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-2">
                            <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-purple-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M18.364 5.636l-3.536 3.536m0 5.656l3.536 3.536M9.172 9.172L5.636 5.636m3.536 9.192L5.636 18.364M12 2.5v19M2.5 12h19"></path>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Support 24/7</p>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Altid hjælp</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <!-- Enhanced Product Info -->
            <div class="xl:col-span-2">
                
                <!-- Product Title -->
                <h1 class="text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-6 leading-tight">
                    {{ product.name }}
                </h1>
                
                <!-- Pricing Section -->
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 p-6 mb-8">
                    <!-- Main Price -->
                    <div class="mb-4 relative">
                        <div class="flex items-baseline space-x-3 mb-2">
                            <div class="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold text-primary-600">
                                {{ product.daily_price_dkk | currency }}
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-xl text-gray-500 font-medium">/dag</div>
                            
                            <!-- Stock Status Popup -->
                            {% if product.stock_qty <= 5 and product.stock_qty > 0 %}
                            <div class="relative inline-block">
                                <button class="stock-status-trigger bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded-full hover:bg-yellow-200 transition-colors duration-200 cursor-pointer">
                                    Få tilbage
                                </button>
                                <div class="stock-status-popup absolute bottom-full left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg px-3 py-2 whitespace-nowrap opacity-0 invisible transition-all duration-200 z-10">
                                    Kun {{ product.stock_qty }} enheder tilbage!
                                    <div class="absolute top-full left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 border-4 border-transparent border-t-gray-900"></div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                        <div class="text-sm text-gray-600 font-medium">
                            <span class="inline-flex items-center">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-1 text-green-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Inklusiv moms og forsikring
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Weekend Pricing -->
                    {% if product.weekend_price_dkk %}
                    <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-accent-50 to-primary-50 rounded-xl p-4 mb-4 border border-accent-200">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <div class="text-lg font-bold text-accent-700">
                                    {{ product.weekend_price_dkk | currency }}/dag
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-sm text-accent-600">Weekend pris (lør-søn)</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-accent-500 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold">
                                Special
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                    
                    <!-- Deposit Info -->
                    {% if product.deposit_dkk %}
                    <div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-gray-200">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <div class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
                                    {{ product.deposit_dkk | currency }}
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-sm text-gray-600">Depositum (refunderbart)</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-green-600">
                                <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path>
                                </svg>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                
                <!-- Stock Status -->
                <div class="mb-6">
                    {% if product.stock_qty > 5 %}
                    <div class="flex items-center text-green-600 font-semibold">
                        <div class="w-3 h-3 bg-green-500 rounded-full mr-2 animate-pulse"></div>
                        På lager - {{ product.stock_qty }} enheder tilgængelige
                    </div>
                    {% elif product.stock_qty > 0 %}
                    <div class="flex items-center text-yellow-600 font-semibold">
                        <div class="w-3 h-3 bg-yellow-500 rounded-full mr-2 animate-pulse"></div>
                        Få tilbage - kun {{ product.stock_qty }} enheder tilbage!
                    </div>
                    {% else %}
                    <div class="flex items-center text-red-600 font-semibold">
                        <div class="w-3 h-3 bg-red-500 rounded-full mr-2"></div>
                        Udsolgt - kontakt os for alternativer
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                
                <!-- Modern Calendar Section -->
                <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden mb-8">
                    <!-- Modern Calendar Header -->
                    <div class="bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 px-8 py-8 relative overflow-hidden">
                        <!-- Animated Background -->
                        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600/20 to-purple-600/20"></div>
                        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-[url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width=\"60\" height=\"60\" viewBox=\"0 0 60 60\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"%3E%3Cg fill=\"none\" fill-rule=\"evenodd\"%3E%3Cg fill=\"%23ffffff\" fill-opacity=\"0.05\"%3E%3Ccircle cx=\"30\" cy=\"30\" r=\"1.5\"/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E')] animate-pulse"></div>
                        
                        <div class="relative">
                            <!-- Main Content (Centered naturally) -->
                            <div class="text-center lg:text-left">
                                <div class="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-2xl mb-4 mx-auto lg:mx-0">
                                    <svg class="w-8 h-8 text-white" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                </div>
                                <h3 class="text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold text-white mb-3 tracking-tight">
                                    Vælg dine datoer
                                </h3>
                                <p class="text-white/80 text-lg mb-6 max-w-md mx-auto lg:mx-0">
                                    Klik på en dato for enkelt dag eller vælg flere datoer for en periode
                                </p>
                                
                                <!-- Quick Info Cards -->
                                <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center lg:justify-start">
                                    <div class="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-white/90 text-sm font-medium">
                                        <svg class="w-4 h-4 inline mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                        Øjeblikkelig booking
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-white/90 text-sm font-medium">
                                        <svg class="w-4 h-4 inline mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                        Fleksible datoer
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <!-- Fixed Selection Display (Desktop) -->
                            <div id="selection-info" class="hidden lg:block absolute top-0 right-0">
                                <div class="bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-md rounded-lg px-3 py-2 border border-white/20 text-center w-44 h-16 flex flex-col justify-center">
                                    <div class="text-white/70 text-xs font-medium mb-1 uppercase tracking-wide">Valgte periode</div>
                                    <div id="selected-dates" class="font-semibold text-xs text-white leading-tight">
                                        Ingen valgt
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Modern Calendar Container -->
                    <div class="p-8 lg:p-12 bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-50 to-white">
                        <div id="calendar" class="modern-calendar w-full"></div>
                        
                        <!-- Mobile Selection Info -->
                        <div id="mobile-selection-info" class="lg:hidden mt-8 p-6 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg border border-gray-100">
                            <div class="text-center">
                                <div class="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2">Valgte periode</div>
                                <div id="selected-dates-mobile" class="font-bold text-lg text-gray-900 px-4 py-2 bg-gray-100 rounded-xl">Ingen valgt</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Enhanced Selection Summary & Actions -->
                    <div id="selection-summary" class="hidden bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-50 to-white px-6 py-6 border-t border-gray-200">
                        <div class="space-y-6">
                            <!-- Availability Status -->
                            <div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between space-y-4 lg:space-y-0">
                                <div class="flex items-center space-x-4">
                                    <div id="availability-status" class="flex items-center">
                                        <!-- Status icon will be inserted here -->
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <div id="availability-text" class="font-bold text-lg text-gray-900"></div>
                                        <div id="availability-details" class="text-sm text-gray-600"></div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-center lg:text-right">
                                    <div id="price-display" class="text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold text-primary-600 mb-1">
                                        <!-- Price will be calculated here -->
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="text-sm text-gray-600 font-medium" id="price-details">
                                        <!-- Price details will be shown here -->
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <!-- Action Buttons -->
                            <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-3 sm:space-y-0 sm:space-x-4 pt-4 border-t border-gray-200">
                                <button id="clear-selection" 
                                        class="w-full sm:w-auto px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 bg-white border-2 border-gray-300 rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-50 hover:border-gray-400 transition-all duration-200 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg">
                                    <svg class="w-4 h-4 inline mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                    Ryd valg
                                </button>
                                <button id="add-to-cart" 
                                        class="w-full sm:w-auto px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold text-white bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-600 via-primary-700 to-accent-600 rounded-xl hover:from-primary-700 hover:via-primary-800 hover:to-accent-700 transition-all duration-200 shadow-xl hover:shadow-2xl transform hover:scale-105 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:transform-none disabled:hover:scale-100 group"
                                        disabled>
                                    <svg class="w-5 h-5 inline mr-2 group-hover:animate-bounce" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4m0 0L7 13m0 0l-2.5 5M7 13l2.5 5m6-5v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H9a2 2 0 01-2-2v-6m8 0V9a2 2 0 00-2-2H9a2 2 0 00-2 2v4.01"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                    Tilføj til kurv
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Enhanced Legend -->
                    <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-50 via-white to-gray-50 px-6 py-6 border-t border-gray-200">
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start group p-3 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200">
                                <div class="w-5 h-5 bg-green-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-lg border-2 border-white transform group-hover:scale-125 transition-transform duration-200"></div>
                                <div>
                                    <span class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800">Tilgængelig</span>
                                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Klar til booking</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start group p-3 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200">
                                <div class="w-5 h-5 bg-red-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-lg border-2 border-white transform group-hover:scale-125 transition-transform duration-200"></div>
                                <div>
                                    <span class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800">Optaget</span>
                                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Ikke tilgængelig</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start group p-3 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200">
                                <div class="w-5 h-5 bg-gray-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-lg border-2 border-white transform group-hover:scale-125 transition-transform duration-200"></div>
                                <div>
                                    <span class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800">Sortdato</span>
                                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Lukket dag</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Tips Section -->
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-50 to-accent-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-primary-200">
                            <div class="flex items-start space-x-3">
                                <div class="flex-shrink-0">
                                    <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-primary-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9.663 17h4.673M12 3v1m6.364 1.636l-.707.707M21 12h-1M4 12H3m3.343-5.657l-.707-.707m2.828 9.9a5 5 0 117.072 0l-.548.547A3.374 3.374 0 0014 18.469V19a2 2 0 11-4 0v-.531c0-.895-.356-1.754-.988-2.386l-.548-.547z"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <h4 class="font-bold text-primary-800 mb-2">Booking tips</h4>
                                    <ul class="text-sm text-primary-700 space-y-1">
                                        <li class="flex items-center"><span class="w-1 h-1 bg-primary-500 rounded-full mr-2"></span>Hold musen over farvede prikker for detaljer</li>
                                        <li class="flex items-center"><span class="w-1 h-1 bg-primary-500 rounded-full mr-2"></span>Klik start/slut-dato for at forkorte periode</li>
                                        <li class="flex items-center"><span class="w-1 h-1 bg-primary-500 rounded-full mr-2"></span>Minimum lejepriod: 1 dag</li>
                                    </ul>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Enhanced Product Description -->
                {% if product.description %}
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 p-6 mb-8">
                    <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4 flex items-center">
                        <svg class="w-6 h-6 mr-3 text-primary-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        Produktbeskrivelse
                    </h3>
                    <div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none text-gray-700 leading-relaxed">
                        {{ product.description | safe }}
                    </div>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
                
                <!-- Enhanced Product Specifications -->
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 p-6">
                    <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-6 flex items-center">
                        <svg class="w-6 h-6 mr-3 text-primary-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 5H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h8a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2M9 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2m-3 7h3m-3 4h3m-6-4h.01M9 16h.01"></path>
                        </svg>
                        Specifikationer
                    </h3>
                    
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                        <!-- Category -->
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-50 to-accent-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-primary-200">
                            <dt class="text-sm font-bold text-primary-800 mb-2 flex items-center">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M7 7h.01M7 3h5c.512 0 1.024.195 1.414.586l7 7a2 2 0 010 2.828l-7 7a2 2 0 01-2.828 0l-7-7A1.994 1.994 0 013 12V7a4 4 0 014-4z"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Kategori
                            </dt>
                            <dd class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">{{ product.category.name }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Stock -->
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-green-50 to-blue-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-green-200">
                            <dt class="text-sm font-bold text-green-800 mb-2 flex items-center">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M20 7l-8-4-8 4m16 0l-8 4m8-4v10l-8 4m0-10L4 7m8 4v10M4 7v10l8 4"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Lagerantal
                            </dt>
                            <dd class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">{{ product.stock_qty }} enheder</dd>
                        </div>
                        
                        {% if product.prep_buffer_days > 0 %}
                        <!-- Preparation Days -->
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-50 to-orange-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-yellow-200">
                            <dt class="text-sm font-bold text-yellow-800 mb-2 flex items-center">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Forberedelse
                            </dt>
                            <dd class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">{{ product.prep_buffer_days }} dag{{ 'er' if product.prep_buffer_days != 1 else '' }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                        
                        {% if product.cleanup_buffer_days > 0 %}
                        <!-- Cleanup Days -->
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-50 to-pink-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-purple-200">
                            <dt class="text-sm font-bold text-purple-800 mb-2 flex items-center">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Oprydning
                            </dt>
                            <dd class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">{{ product.cleanup_buffer_days }} dag{{ 'er' if product.cleanup_buffer_days != 1 else '' }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Features Section -->
                    <div class="mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-200">
                        <h4 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">Inkluderet i lejen</h4>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                            <div class="flex items-center text-green-700">
                                <svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-3 text-green-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                                </svg>
                                <span class="font-medium">Professionel rengøring</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center text-green-700">
                                <svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-3 text-green-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                                </svg>
                                <span class="font-medium">Teknisk support</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center text-green-700">
                                <svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-3 text-green-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                                </svg>
                                <span class="font-medium">Brugsanvisning</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center text-green-700">
                                <svg class="w-5 h-5 mr-3 text-green-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                                </svg>
                                <span class="font-medium">Kvalitetsgaranti</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Related Products Section -->
{% if related_products %}
<div class="bg-gradient-to-br from-white via-gray-50 to-blue-50 py-16 relative overflow-hidden">
    <!-- Background Pattern -->
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-[url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width="60" height="60" viewBox="0 0 60 60" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"%3E%3Cg fill="none" fill-rule="evenodd"%3E%3Cg fill="%230ea5e9" fill-opacity="0.03"%3E%3Ccircle cx="30" cy="30" r="2"/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E')] opacity-50"></div>
    
    <div class="relative max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <!-- Section Header -->
        <div class="text-center mb-12">
            <h2 class="text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">
                Relaterede produkter
            </h2>
            <p class="text-xl text-gray-600 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
                Udforsk andre populære produkter der kunne passe til din fest
            </p>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Products Grid -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8">
            {% for related_product in related_products %}
            <div class="group bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 border border-gray-100">
                <!-- Product Image -->
                <div class="relative overflow-hidden">
                    <a href="{{ url_for('public.product_detail', slug=related_product.slug) }}" class="block">
                        {% if related_product.hero_image_url %}
                        <div class="aspect-w-16 aspect-h-12">
                            <img src="{{ related_product.hero_image_url | image_url }}" 
                                 alt="{{ related_product.name }}" 
                                 class="w-full h-48 object-cover group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-500">
                        </div>
                        {% else %}
                        <div class="w-full h-48 bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-100 to-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <div class="text-center">
                                <svg class="w-12 h-12 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1" d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                                </svg>
                                <span class="text-gray-500 text-sm">Intet billede</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </a>
                    
                    <!-- Availability Badge -->
                    <div class="absolute top-3 left-3">
                        <div class="bg-green-500 text-white px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold shadow-lg">
                            Tilgængelig
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Product Info -->
                <div class="p-6">
                    <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3 group-hover:text-primary-600 transition-colors duration-200">
                        <a href="{{ url_for('public.product_detail', slug=related_product.slug) }}">
                            {{ related_product.name }}
                        </a>
                    </h3>
                    
                    <!-- Price and CTA -->
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div>
                            <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-primary-600">
                                {{ related_product.daily_price_dkk | currency }}
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium">/dag</div>
                        </div>
                        <a href="{{ url_for('public.product_detail', slug=related_product.slug) }}" 
                           class="bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-600 to-accent-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold hover:from-primary-700 hover:to-accent-700 transition-all duration-200 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transform hover:scale-105 group">
                            <span class="group-hover:hidden">Se mere</span>
                            <span class="hidden group-hover:inline-flex items-center">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Udforsk
                            </span>
                        </a>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
        
        <!-- View All CTA -->
        <div class="text-center mt-12">
            <a href="{{ url_for('public.catalog') }}" 
               class="inline-flex items-center bg-white text-primary-600 px-8 py-4 rounded-xl text-lg font-bold hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200 shadow-xl hover:shadow-2xl transform hover:scale-105 border-2 border-primary-200 hover:border-primary-300">
                <svg class="w-6 h-6 mr-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 11H5m14 0a2 2 0 012 2v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-6a2 2 0 012-2m14 0V9a2 2 0 00-2-2M5 11V9a2 2 0 012-2m0 0V5a2 2 0 012-2h6a2 2 0 012 2v2M7 7h10"></path>
                </svg>
                Se hele kataloget
                <svg class="w-5 h-5 ml-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6"></path>
                </svg>
            </a>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    let selectedStartDate = null;
    let selectedEndDate = null;
    let calendar = null;
    let availabilityData = {};
    
    // Initialize calendar
    const calendarEl = document.getElementById('calendar');
    calendar = new FullCalendar.Calendar(calendarEl, {
        initialView: 'dayGridMonth',
        locale: 'da',
        selectAllow: function(selectInfo) {
            // Allow selection only for future dates
            const today = new Date();
            today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
            return selectInfo.start >= today;
        },
        headerToolbar: {
            left: 'prev,next today',
            center: 'title',
            right: 'dayGridMonth'
        },
        buttonText: {
            today: 'I dag',
            month: 'Måned',
            week: 'Uge',
            list: 'Liste'
        },
        selectable: false,
        selectMirror: false,
        selectOverlap: true,
        unselectAuto: false,
        selectLongPressDelay: 300,
        dayMaxEventRows: false,
        events: function(info, successCallback, failureCallback) {
            // Simple, reliable date format extraction
            let startDate, endDate;
            
            // Handle both string and Date objects
            if (typeof info.start === 'string') {
                startDate = info.start.split('T')[0];
            } else {
                startDate = info.start.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            }
            
            if (typeof info.end === 'string') {
                endDate = info.end.split('T')[0];
            } else {
                endDate = info.end.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            }
            
            console.log('📅 Fetching calendar data:', { startDate, endDate, productId: {{ product.id }} });
            
            fetch(`/api/calendar-data/{{ product.id }}?start=${startDate}&end=${endDate}&t=${Date.now()}`)
                .then(response => {
                    console.log('📅 Calendar API response:', response.status);
                    if (!response.ok) {
                        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
                    }
                    return response.json();
                })
                .then(data => {
                    console.log('📅 Calendar data received:', data.length, 'days');
                    
                    // Store availability data for later use
                    availabilityData = {};
                    data.forEach(day => {
                        availabilityData[day.date] = day;
                    });
                    
                    // Store globally for view changes
                    window.currentAvailabilityData = data;
                    
                    // Create clean visual indicators without background colors or text
                    const events = data.map(day => {
                        // We'll add corner indicators via CSS instead of background events
                        // Return empty events array to avoid background coloring
                        return null;
                    }).filter(Boolean);
                    
                    console.log('📅 Calendar events created:', events.length);
                    successCallback(events);
                    
                    // Add corner indicators after calendar renders
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        addStatusIndicators(data);
                    }, 100);
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.error('📅 Calendar error:', error);
                    // Don't show error in calendar, just log it
                    successCallback([]);
                });
        },
        dateClick: function(info) {
            const clickedDate = info.dateStr;
            const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            
            if (clickedDate <= today) {
                showNotification('Vælg venligst fremtidige datoer', 'warning');
                return;
            }
            
            console.log('Date clicked:', clickedDate, 'Current selection:', selectedStartDate, selectedEndDate);
            
            // Intuitive click logic - no delays, no complications
            if (!selectedStartDate) {
                // First click - select single date
                selectedStartDate = clickedDate;
                selectedEndDate = clickedDate;
                highlightSingleDate(clickedDate);
                updateSelectionDisplay();
                checkAvailability();
                showNotification('✅ Enkelt dag valgt - klik anden dato for periode', 'success');
            } else if (selectedStartDate === clickedDate && selectedEndDate === clickedDate) {
                // Clicking same single date - clear selection
                selectedStartDate = null;
                selectedEndDate = null;
                clearDateHighlights();
                updateSelectionDisplay();
                hideSelectionSummary();
                showNotification('🗑️ Valg ryddet', 'info');
            } else if (selectedStartDate === clickedDate) {
                // Clicking start date of a range - trim from start
                const nextDay = new Date(selectedStartDate);
                nextDay.setDate(nextDay.getDate() + 1);
                selectedStartDate = nextDay.toISOString().split('T')[0];
                
                if (selectedStartDate === selectedEndDate) {
                    // Range reduced to single day
                    highlightSingleDate(selectedStartDate);
                    showNotification('✂️ Reduceret til enkelt dag', 'info');
                } else {
                    // Still a range, just smaller
                    highlightDateRange();
                    const days = Math.ceil((new Date(selectedEndDate) - new Date(selectedStartDate)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
                    showNotification(`✂️ Periode forkortet til ${days} dage`, 'info');
                }
                updateSelectionDisplay();
                checkAvailability();
            } else if (selectedEndDate === clickedDate) {
                // Clicking end date of a range - trim from end
                const prevDay = new Date(selectedEndDate);
                prevDay.setDate(prevDay.getDate() - 1);
                selectedEndDate = prevDay.toISOString().split('T')[0];
                
                if (selectedStartDate === selectedEndDate) {
                    // Range reduced to single day
                    highlightSingleDate(selectedStartDate);
                    showNotification('✂️ Reduceret til enkelt dag', 'info');
                } else {
                    // Still a range, just smaller
                    highlightDateRange();
                    const days = Math.ceil((new Date(selectedEndDate) - new Date(selectedStartDate)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
                    showNotification(`✂️ Periode forkortet til ${days} dage`, 'info');
                }
                updateSelectionDisplay();
                checkAvailability();
            } else {
                // Click on a different date - create or modify range
                const startDate = new Date(selectedStartDate);
                const endDate = new Date(clickedDate);
                
                if (startDate <= endDate) {
                    // Clicked date is after start - extend range forward
                    selectedEndDate = clickedDate;
                } else {
                    // Clicked date is before start - extend range backward
                    selectedEndDate = selectedStartDate;
                    selectedStartDate = clickedDate;
                }
                
                highlightDateRange();
                updateSelectionDisplay();
                checkAvailability();
                
                const days = Math.ceil((new Date(selectedEndDate) - new Date(selectedStartDate)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
                showNotification(`✅ ${days} dage valgt i periode`, 'success');
            }
        },
        dayMaxEvents: false,
        height: 'auto',
        aspectRatio: 1.2,
        expandRows: true,
        dayMaxEventRows: false,
        fixedWeekCount: false,
        dayCellClassNames: function(info) {
            const today = new Date();
            const cellDate = new Date(info.date);
            
            if (cellDate <= today) {
                return ['past-date'];
            }
            return [];
        }
    });
    
    calendar.render();
    
    // Update selection display
    function updateSelectionDisplay() {
        const selectedDatesEl = document.getElementById('selected-dates');
        const selectedDatesMobileEl = document.getElementById('selected-dates-mobile');
        const selectionInfoEl = document.getElementById('selection-info');
        
        let displayText = 'Ingen valgt';
        
        if (selectedStartDate && selectedEndDate) {
            if (selectedStartDate === selectedEndDate) {
                displayText = formatDate(selectedStartDate);
            } else {
                displayText = `${formatDate(selectedStartDate)} - ${formatDate(selectedEndDate)}`;
            }
            if (selectionInfoEl && selectionInfoEl.querySelector('.text-sm')) {
                selectionInfoEl.querySelector('.text-sm').textContent = 'Valgte datoer';
            }
        } else {
            if (selectionInfoEl && selectionInfoEl.querySelector('.text-sm')) {
                selectionInfoEl.querySelector('.text-sm').textContent = 'Valgte datoer';
            }
        }
        
        if (selectedDatesEl) selectedDatesEl.textContent = displayText;
        if (selectedDatesMobileEl) selectedDatesMobileEl.textContent = displayText;
    }
    
    // Check availability for selected dates
    async function checkAvailability() {
        if (!selectedStartDate || !selectedEndDate) return;
        
        const availabilityStatusEl = document.getElementById('availability-status');
        const availabilityTextEl = document.getElementById('availability-text');
        const availabilityDetailsEl = document.getElementById('availability-details');
        const selectionSummaryEl = document.getElementById('selection-summary');
        const addToCartBtn = document.getElementById('add-to-cart');
        const priceDisplayEl = document.getElementById('price-display');
        const priceDetailsEl = document.getElementById('price-details');
        
        // Show loading state
        availabilityStatusEl.innerHTML = '<div class="animate-spin rounded-full h-6 w-6 border-b-2 border-indigo-600"></div>';
        availabilityTextEl.textContent = 'Tjekker tilgængelighed...';
        availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = '';
        priceDisplayEl.textContent = 'Beregner pris...';
        priceDetailsEl.textContent = '';
        selectionSummaryEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        addToCartBtn.disabled = true;
        
        // Check availability using the stored data
        let isAvailable = true;
        let minAvailableQuantity = Infinity;
        let hasBlackout = false;
        
        const startDate = new Date(selectedStartDate);
        const endDate = new Date(selectedEndDate);
        const currentDate = new Date(startDate);
        
        while (currentDate <= endDate) {
            const dateStr = currentDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            const dayData = availabilityData[dateStr];
            
            if (dayData) {
                if (dayData.is_blacked_out) {
                    hasBlackout = true;
                    isAvailable = false;
                    break;
                } else if (!dayData.is_available) {
                    isAvailable = false;
                    break;
                } else {
                    minAvailableQuantity = Math.min(minAvailableQuantity, dayData.available_quantity);
                }
            } else {
                isAvailable = false;
                break;
            }
            
            currentDate.setDate(currentDate.getDate() + 1);
        }
        
        // Update UI based on availability
        if (isAvailable && !hasBlackout) {
            availabilityStatusEl.innerHTML = '<svg class="w-6 h-6 text-green-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>';
            availabilityTextEl.textContent = 'Tilgængelig!';
            availabilityTextEl.className = 'font-semibold text-green-800';
            availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = `${minAvailableQuantity} enheder tilgængelige`;
            availabilityDetailsEl.className = 'text-sm text-green-600';
            
            // Calculate and display price
            calculatePrice();
        } else {
            availabilityStatusEl.innerHTML = '<svg class="w-6 h-6 text-red-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"></path></svg>';
            availabilityTextEl.textContent = 'Ikke tilgængelig';
            availabilityTextEl.className = 'font-semibold text-red-800';
            if (hasBlackout) {
                availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = 'Sortdato i den valgte periode';
            } else {
                availabilityDetailsEl.textContent = 'Ikke tilgængelig i den valgte periode';
```
