```html
                                    {% if page_num != upsell_products.page %}
                                    <li class="page-item">
                                        <a class="page-link" href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products', page=page_num) }}">{{ page_num }}</a>
                                    </li>
                                    {% else %}
                                    <li class="page-item active">
                                        <span class="page-link">{{ page_num }}</span>
                                    </li>
                                    {% endif %}
                                {% else %}
                                <li class="page-item disabled">
                                    <span class="page-link">…</span>
                                </li>
                                {% endif %}
                            {% endfor %}
                            
                            {% if upsell_products.has_next %}
                            <li class="page-item">
                                <a class="page-link" href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products', page=upsell_products.next_num) }}">Næste</a>
                            </li>
                            {% endif %}
                        </ul>
                    </nav>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
            {% else %}
            <div class="card">
                <div class="card-body text-center py-5">
                    <i class="fas fa-box-open fa-3x text-muted mb-3"></i>
                    <h5>Ingen mersalgs produkter fundet</h5>
                    <p class="text-muted">Opret dit første mersalgs produkt for at komme i gang.</p>
                    <a href="{{ url_for('admin.create_upsell_product') }}" class="btn btn-primary">
                        <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Opret Mersalgs Produkt
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Delete confirmation modal -->
<div class="modal fade" id="deleteModal" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="deleteModalLabel" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-dialog" role="document">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <h5 class="modal-title" id="deleteModalLabel">Bekræft sletning</h5>
                <button type="button" class="close" data-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close">
                    <span aria-hidden="true">&times;</span>
                </button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
                <p>Er du sikker på, at du vil slette mersalgs produktet <strong id="deleteProductName"></strong>?</p>
                <p class="text-danger">Denne handling kan ikke fortrydes.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-dismiss="modal">Annuller</button>
                <form id="deleteForm" method="POST" style="display: inline;">
                    <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="{{ csrf_token() }}"/>
                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-danger">Slet</button>
                </form>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
function confirmDelete(productName, productId) {
    document.getElementById('deleteProductName').textContent = productName;
    document.getElementById('deleteForm').action = '{{ url_for("admin.delete_upsell_product", upsell_product_id=0) }}'.replace('0', productId);
    $('#deleteModal').modal('show');
}
</script>

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "admin/base.html" %}

{% block title %}{% if upsell_product %}Rediger{% else %}Opret{% endif %} Mersalgs Produkt - Admin{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid">
    <div class="row">
        <div class="col-12">
            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
                <h1 class="h3 mb-0">
                    {% if upsell_product %}Rediger{% else %}Opret{% endif %} Mersalgs Produkt
                </h1>
                <a href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products') }}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">
                    <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> Tilbage til liste
                </a>
            </div>

            <div class="row">
                <div class="col-lg-8">
                    <div class="card">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">Produkt information</h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            <form method="POST" enctype="multipart/form-data">
                                {{ form.hidden_tag() }}
                                
                                <div class="row">
                                    <div class="col-md-8">
                                        <div class="form-group">
                                            {{ form.name.label(class="form-label") }}
                                            {{ form.name(class="form-control" + (" is-invalid" if form.name.errors else "")) }}
                                            {% if form.name.errors %}
                                                <div class="invalid-feedback">
                                                    {% for error in form.name.errors %}
                                                        {{ error }}
                                                    {% endfor %}
                                                </div>
                                            {% endif %}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="col-md-4">
                                        <div class="form-group">
                                            {{ form.price_dkk.label(class="form-label") }}
                                            <div class="input-group">
                                                {{ form.price_dkk(class="form-control" + (" is-invalid" if form.price_dkk.errors else "")) }}
                                                <div class="input-group-append">
                                                    <span class="input-group-text">DKK</span>
                                                </div>
                                                {% if form.price_dkk.errors %}
                                                    <div class="invalid-feedback">
                                                        {% for error in form.price_dkk.errors %}
                                                            {{ error }}
                                                        {% endfor %}
                                                    </div>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="form-group">
                                    {{ form.description.label(class="form-label") }}
                                    {{ form.description(class="form-control" + (" is-invalid" if form.description.errors else "")) }}
                                    {% if form.description.errors %}
                                        <div class="invalid-feedback">
                                            {% for error in form.description.errors %}
                                                {{ error }}
                                            {% endfor %}
                                        </div>
                                    {% endif %}
                                    <small class="form-text text-muted">Beskriv mersalgs produktet og dets fordele.</small>
                                </div>

                                <div class="row">
                                    <div class="col-md-6">
                                        <div class="form-group">
                                            {{ form.stock_qty.label(class="form-label") }}
                                            {{ form.stock_qty(class="form-control" + (" is-invalid" if form.stock_qty.errors else "")) }}
                                            {% if form.stock_qty.errors %}
                                                <div class="invalid-feedback">
                                                    {% for error in form.stock_qty.errors %}
                                                        {{ error }}
                                                    {% endfor %}
                                                </div>
                                            {% endif %}
                                            <small class="form-text text-muted">Antal enheder på lager. Sæt til 0 hvis udsolgt.</small>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="col-md-6">
                                        <div class="form-group">
                                            <label class="form-label">Status</label>
                                            <div class="form-check">
                                                {{ form.is_active(class="form-check-input") }}
                                                {{ form.is_active.label(class="form-check-label") }}
                                            </div>
                                            <small class="form-text text-muted">Kun aktive produkter vises til kunder.</small>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="form-group">
                                    {{ form.image.label(class="form-label") }}
                                    {{ form.image(class="form-control-file" + (" is-invalid" if form.image.errors else "")) }}
                                    {% if form.image.errors %}
                                        <div class="invalid-feedback">
                                            {% for error in form.image.errors %}
                                                {{ error }}
                                            {% endfor %}
                                        </div>
                                    {% endif %}
                                    <small class="form-text text-muted">Upload et billede af mersalgs produktet. Understøttede formater: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP.</small>
                                </div>

                                <div class="form-group mt-4">
                                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
                                        <i class="fas fa-save"></i> 
                                        {% if upsell_product %}Opdater{% else %}Opret{% endif %} Mersalgs Produkt
                                    </button>
                                    <a href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products') }}" class="btn btn-secondary ml-2">
                                        Annuller
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                            </form>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="col-lg-4">
                    {% if upsell_product and upsell_product.image_url %}
                    <div class="card">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">Nuværende billede</h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            <img src="{{ url_for('static', filename=upsell_product.image_url) }}" 
                                 alt="{{ upsell_product.name }}" 
                                 class="img-fluid rounded">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}

                    <div class="card mt-3">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">Hjælp</h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            <h6>Mersalgs produkter</h6>
                            <p class="small text-muted">
                                Mersalgs produkter er tilkøbs produkter som kunder kan tilføje til deres lejeperiode. 
                                For eksempel: popcorn pakker til popcorn maskiner, ekstra udstyr, etc.
                            </p>
                            
                            <h6>Prissætning</h6>
                            <p class="small text-muted">
                                Mersalgs produkter har en fast pris uanset lejeperiode. Prisen er pr. styk/pakke.
                            </p>
                            
                            <h6>Lagerstyring</h6>
                            <p class="small text-muted">
                                Hold øje med lagerantallet. Når det når 0, vises produktet som udsolgt til kunder.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "admin/base.html" %}

{% block title %}Mersalgs for {{ product.name }} - Admin{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid">
    <div class="row">
        <div class="col-12">
            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
                <h1 class="h4 mb-0">
                    Mersalgs for <strong>{{ product.name }}</strong>
                </h1>
                <div>
                    <a href="{{ url_for('admin.products') }}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">
                        <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> Tilbage til produkter
                    </a>
                    <a href="{{ url_for('admin.edit_product', product_id=product.id) }}" class="btn btn-outline-primary">
                        <i class="fas fa-edit"></i> Rediger produkt
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="row">
                <!-- Current Upsells -->
                <div class="col-lg-8">
                    <div class="card">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">
                                Tilknyttede Mersalgs Produkter
                                <span class="badge badge-secondary">{{ current_upsells|length }}</span>
                            </h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            {% if current_upsells %}
                            <div class="table-responsive">
                                <table class="table table-sm">
                                    <thead>
                                        <tr>
                                            <th>Billede</th>
                                            <th>Navn</th>
                                            <th>Pris</th>
                                            <th>Lager</th>
                                            <th>Rækkefølge</th>
                                            <th>Handlinger</th>
                                        </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody>
                                        {% for upsell_assoc, upsell_product in current_upsells %}
                                        <tr>
                                            <td>
                                                {% if upsell_product.image_url %}
                                                <img src="{{ url_for('static', filename=upsell_product.image_url) }}" 
                                                     alt="{{ upsell_product.name }}" 
                                                     class="img-thumbnail" 
                                                     style="width: 40px; height: 40px; object-fit: cover;">
                                                {% else %}
                                                <div class="bg-light d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center" 
                                                     style="width: 40px; height: 40px;">
                                                    <i class="fas fa-image text-muted"></i>
                                                </div>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </td>
                                            <td>
                                                <strong>{{ upsell_product.name }}</strong>
                                                {% if upsell_product.description %}
                                                <br><small class="text-muted">{{ upsell_product.description[:60] }}{% if upsell_product.description|length > 60 %}...{% endif %}</small>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </td>
                                            <td>{{ upsell_product.price_dkk }} DKK</td>
                                            <td>
                                                {% if upsell_product.stock_qty > 10 %}
                                                <span class="badge badge-success">{{ upsell_product.stock_qty }}</span>
                                                {% elif upsell_product.stock_qty > 0 %}
                                                <span class="badge badge-warning">{{ upsell_product.stock_qty }}</span>
                                                {% else %}
                                                <span class="badge badge-danger">0</span>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </td>
                                            <td>{{ upsell_assoc.sort_order }}</td>
                                            <td>
                                                <form method="POST" 
                                                      action="{{ url_for('admin.remove_product_upsell', product_id=product.id, upsell_id=upsell_product.id) }}" 
                                                      style="display: inline;"
                                                      onsubmit="return confirm('Er du sikker på at du vil fjerne dette mersalgs produkt?');">
                                                    <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="{{ csrf_token() }}"/>
                                                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" title="Fjern">
                                                        <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                                                    </button>
                                                </form>
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                        {% endfor %}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>
                            </div>
                            {% else %}
                            <div class="text-center py-4">
                                <i class="fas fa-box-open fa-3x text-muted mb-3"></i>
                                <h6>Ingen mersalgs produkter tilknyttet</h6>
                                <p class="text-muted">Tilføj mersalgs produkter fra listen til højre.</p>
                            </div>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Available Upsells -->
                <div class="col-lg-4">
                    <div class="card">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">
                                Tilgængelige Mersalgs Produkter
                                <span class="badge badge-secondary">{{ available_upsells|length }}</span>
                            </h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            {% if available_upsells %}
                            <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('admin.add_product_upsell', product_id=product.id) }}">
                                <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="{{ csrf_token() }}"/>
                                <div class="form-group">
                                    <label for="upsell_product_id" class="form-label">Vælg mersalgs produkt:</label>
                                    <select name="upsell_product_id" id="upsell_product_id" class="form-control" required>
                                        <option value="">-- Vælg produkt --</option>
                                        {% for upsell in available_upsells %}
                                        <option value="{{ upsell.id }}">
                                            {{ upsell.name }} ({{ upsell.price_dkk }} DKK)
                                        </option>
                                        {% endfor %}
                                    </select>
                                </div>
                                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">
                                    <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Tilføj
                                </button>
                            </form>

                            <hr>

                            <div class="list-group">
                                {% for upsell in available_upsells %}
                                <div class="list-group-item">
                                    <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                                        {% if upsell.image_url %}
                                        <img src="{{ url_for('static', filename=upsell.image_url) }}" 
                                             alt="{{ upsell.name }}" 
                                             class="img-thumbnail me-3" 
                                             style="width: 40px; height: 40px; object-fit: cover;">
                                        {% else %}
                                        <div class="bg-light d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center me-3" 
                                             style="width: 40px; height: 40px;">
                                            <i class="fas fa-image text-muted"></i>
                                        </div>
                                        {% endif %}
                                        <div class="flex-grow-1">
                                            <h6 class="mb-1">{{ upsell.name }}</h6>
                                            <p class="mb-1 small text-muted">{{ upsell.price_dkk }} DKK</p>
                                            {% if upsell.description %}
                                            <small class="text-muted">{{ upsell.description[:50] }}{% if upsell.description|length > 50 %}...{% endif %}</small>
                                            {% endif %}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                {% endfor %}
                            </div>
                            {% else %}
                            <div class="text-center py-4">
                                <i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle fa-2x text-muted mb-3"></i>
                                <h6>Ingen tilgængelige mersalgs produkter</h6>
                                <p class="text-muted small">Alle mersalgs produkter er allerede tilknyttet dette produkt, eller der er ingen oprettet.</p>
                                <a href="{{ url_for('admin.create_upsell_product') }}" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm">
                                    <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Opret nyt
                                </a>
                            </div>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Quick Actions -->
                    <div class="card mt-3">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">Hurtige handlinger</h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            <div class="d-grid gap-2">
                                <a href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products') }}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm">
                                    <i class="fas fa-list"></i> Alle mersalgs produkter
                                </a>
                                <a href="{{ url_for('admin.create_upsell_product') }}" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm">
                                    <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Opret nyt mersalgs produkt
                                </a>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
        <main class="flex-1">

            {% with messages = get_flashed_messages(with_categories=true) %}
                {% if messages %}
                    <div class="px-4 py-3">
                        {% for category, message in messages %}
                            <div class="mb-3 p-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm border {% if category == 'error' %}bg-red-50 border-red-200 text-red-700{% elif category == 'success' %}bg-green-50 border-green-200 text-green-700{% elif category == 'warning' %}bg-yellow-50 border-yellow-200 text-yellow-700{% else %}bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 text-blue-700{% endif %}">
                                <div class="flex">
                                    <div class="flex-shrink-0">
                                        {% if category == 'error' %}
                                            <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-red-400" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                                <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zM8.707 7.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414L8.586 10l-1.293 1.293a1 1 0 101.414 1.414L10 11.414l1.293 1.293a1 1 0 001.414-1.414L11.414 10l1.293-1.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L10 8.586 8.707 7.293z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                            </svg>
                                        {% elif category == 'success' %}
                                            <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-green-400" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                                <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                            </svg>
                                        {% elif category == 'warning' %}
                                            <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-yellow-400" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                                <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M8.257 3.099c.765-1.36 2.722-1.36 3.486 0l5.58 9.92c.75 1.334-.213 2.98-1.742 2.98H4.42c-1.53 0-2.493-1.646-1.743-2.98l5.58-9.92zM11 13a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zm-1-8a1 1 0 00-1 1v3a1 1 0 002 0V6a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                            </svg>
                                        {% else %}
                                            <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-blue-400" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                                <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7-4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zM9 9a1 1 0 000 2v3a1 1 0 001 1h1a1 1 0 100-2v-3a1 1 0 00-1-1H9z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                            </svg>
                                        {% endif %}
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="ml-3">
                                        <p class="text-sm font-medium">{{ message }}</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                {% endif %}
            {% endwith %}

            <!-- Main Content Area -->
            <div class="px-4 py-6">
                {% block content %}{% endblock %}
            </div>
        </main>
    </div>
    
    <!-- JavaScript -->
    <script>
        // Initialize Alpine.js data
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('app', () => ({
                sidebarOpen: false,
                mobileMenuOpen: false,
                productCount: 0,
                pendingBookings: 0,
                
                init() {
                    this.loadStats();
                    this.updateCurrentDate();
                },
                
                async loadStats() {
                    try {
                        // Load product count
                        const productResponse = await fetch('/api/stats/products');
                        if (productResponse.ok) {
                            const data = await productResponse.json();
                            this.productCount = data.count;
                        }
                        
                        // Load pending bookings count
                        const bookingResponse = await fetch('/api/stats/pending-bookings');
                        if (bookingResponse.ok) {
                            const data = await bookingResponse.json();
                            this.pendingBookings = data.count;
                        }
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.log('Stats not available');
                    }
                },
                
                updateCurrentDate() {
                    const now = new Date();
                    const options = { 
                        weekday: 'long', 
                        year: 'numeric', 
                        month: 'long', 
                        day: 'numeric' 
                    };
                    const dateString = now.toLocaleDateString('da-DK', options);
                    const dateElement = document.getElementById('current-date');
                    if (dateElement) {
                        dateElement.textContent = dateString;
                    }
                }
            }));
        });
    </script>
    
    {% block extra_js %}{% endblock %}
</body>
</html>
```

```html
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 10v6m0 0l-3-3m3 3l3-3m2 8H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    Eksporter
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">

            <div class="md:col-span-2">
                <label for="search" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Søg produkter</label>

                    <div class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                        <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z"></path>
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <input type="text" id="search" name="search" class="block w-full pl-10 pr-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500" placeholder="Søg efter navn, kategori..." value="{{ search or '' }}">
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Category Filter -->
            <div>
                <label for="category" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Kategori</label>
                <select id="category" name="category" class="block w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500">
                    <option value="">Alle kategorier</option>
                    {% for category in categories %}
                    <option value="{{ category.id }}" {% if current_category == category.id %}selected{% endif %}>{{ category.name }}</option>
                    {% endfor %}
                </select>
            </div>

            <!-- Status Filter -->
            <div>
                <label for="status" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Status</label>
                <select id="status" name="status" class="block w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500">
                    <option value="">Alle statuser</option>
                    <option value="active">Aktive</option>
                    <option value="inactive">Inaktive</option>

                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M7 16V4m0 0L3 8m4-4l4 4m6 0v12m0 0l4-4m-4 4l-4-4"></path>
                                </svg>
                            </div>
                        </th>
                        <th class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Handlinger</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">

                                    </svg>

                        </td>

                                <div class="w-2 h-2 bg-red-400 rounded-full mr-2"></div>

                            {% endif %}

                                    <button type="submit" class="text-red-600 hover:text-red-900 transition-colors duration-200">
                                        Slet
                                    </button>
                                </form>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                    {% endfor %}
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>

        <!-- Pagination -->

        <div class="bg-white px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-gray-200 sm:px-6">
            <div class="flex-1 flex justify-between sm:hidden">
                {% if products.has_prev %}
                <a href="{{ url_for('admin.products', page=products.prev_num, search=search, category=current_category) }}" class="relative inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 text-sm font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50">
                    Forrige
                </a>
                {% endif %}
                {% if products.has_next %}

                </a>
                {% endif %}

                    </p>

                    <nav class="relative z-0 inline-flex rounded-md shadow-sm -space-x-px" aria-label="Pagination">

                            </span>

                        {% if products.has_next %}

                </a>

        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>

<script>
// Bulk selection functionality
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const selectAllCheckbox = document.getElementById('select-all');
    const productCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.product-checkbox');
    const bulkActions = document.getElementById('bulk-actions');
    const selectedCount = document.getElementById('selected-count');

    function updateBulkActions() {
        const checkedBoxes = document.querySelectorAll('.product-checkbox:checked');
        const count = checkedBoxes.length;
        
        selectedCount.textContent = count;
        bulkActions.style.display = count > 0 ? 'block' : 'none';
        
        // Update select all checkbox state
        if (count === 0) {
            selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = false;
            selectAllCheckbox.checked = false;
        } else if (count === productCheckboxes.length) {
            selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = false;
            selectAllCheckbox.checked = true;
        } else {
            selectAllCheckbox.indeterminate = true;
        }
    }

    selectAllCheckbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
        productCheckboxes.forEach(checkbox => {
            checkbox.checked = this.checked;
        });
        updateBulkActions();
    });

    productCheckboxes.forEach(checkbox => {
        checkbox.addEventListener('change', updateBulkActions);
    });
});

function clearSelection() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.product-checkbox').forEach(checkbox => {
        checkbox.checked = false;
    });
    document.getElementById('select-all').checked = false;
    document.getElementById('bulk-actions').style.display = 'none';
}

function duplicateProduct(productId) {
    if (confirm('Vil du kopiere dette produkt?')) {
        // Implement duplicate functionality
        console.log('Duplicating product:', productId);
    }
}

function sortTable(column) {
    console.log('Sorting by:', column);
    // Implement sorting functionality
}

function applyFilters() {
    const search = document.getElementById('search').value;
    const category = document.getElementById('category').value;
    const status = document.getElementById('status').value;
    
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (search) params.append('search', search);
    if (category) params.append('category', category);
    if (status) params.append('status', status);
    
    window.location.href = '{{ url_for("admin.products") }}?' + params.toString();
}

function clearFilters() {
    document.getElementById('search').value = '';
    document.getElementById('category').value = '';
    document.getElementById('status').value = '';
    window.location.href = '{{ url_for("admin.products") }}';
}

function bulkAction(action) {
    const checkedBoxes = document.querySelectorAll('.product-checkbox:checked');
    const productIds = Array.from(checkedBoxes).map(cb => cb.value);
    
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
        alert('Vælg mindst ét produkt');
        return;
    }
    
    if (action === 'delete') {
        if (!confirm(`Er du sikker på at du vil slette ${productIds.length} produkter?`)) {
            return;
        }
    }
    
    // Implement bulk actions
    console.log('Bulk action:', action, 'on products:', productIds);
}
```

```python
"""Public blueprint for main website pages."""

from flask import Blueprint, render_template, request, jsonify, current_app
from sqlalchemy import desc, and_
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Product, Category, CMSBlock, UpsellProduct, ProductUpsell
from app.services.availability import AvailabilityService
from app.services.pricing import PricingService, BookingItemDTO, DeliveryType

bp = Blueprint('public', __name__)


@bp.route('/')
def index():
    """Homepage with featured products and CMS content."""
    # Get featured products
    featured_products = Product.query.filter(
        Product.is_active == True
    ).order_by(desc(Product.created_at)).limit(6).all()
    
    # Get categories
    categories = Category.query.filter(
        Category.is_active == True
    ).order_by(Category.sort_order, Category.name).all()
    
    # Get CMS blocks
    hero_block = CMSBlock.query.filter_by(key='homepage_hero', is_active=True).first()
    about_block = CMSBlock.query.filter_by(key='about_us', is_active=True).first()
    
    return render_template('public/index.html',
                         featured_products=featured_products,
                         categories=categories,
                         hero_block=hero_block,
                         about_block=about_block)


@bp.route('/catalog')
def catalog():
    """Product catalog with filtering."""
    page = request.args.get('page', 1, type=int)
    category_id = request.args.get('category', type=int)
    search = request.args.get('search', '')
    sort_by = request.args.get('sort', 'name')
    
    # Build query
    query = Product.query.filter(Product.is_active == True)
    
    # Filter by category
    if category_id:
        query = query.filter(Product.category_id == category_id)
    
    # Search filter
    if search:
        query = query.filter(
            Product.name.contains(search) | 
            Product.description.contains(search)
        )
    
    # Sorting
    if sort_by == 'price_low':
        query = query.order_by(Product.daily_price_dkk.asc())
    elif sort_by == 'price_high':
        query = query.order_by(Product.daily_price_dkk.desc())
    elif sort_by == 'newest':
        query = query.order_by(desc(Product.created_at))
    else:  # name
        query = query.order_by(Product.name.asc())
    
    # Pagination
    products = query.paginate(
        page=page, per_page=12, error_out=False
    )
    
    # Get categories for filter
    categories = Category.query.filter(
        Category.is_active == True
    ).order_by(Category.name).all()
    
    return render_template('public/catalog.html',
                         products=products,
                         categories=categories,
                         current_category=category_id,
                         search=search,
                         sort_by=sort_by)


@bp.route('/product/<slug>')
def product_detail(slug):
    """Product detail page with availability checker."""
    product = Product.query.filter_by(slug=slug, is_active=True).first_or_404()
    
    # Get related products from same category
    related_products = Product.query.filter(
        Product.category_id == product.category_id,
        Product.id != product.id,
        Product.is_active == True
    ).limit(4).all()
    
    return render_template('public/product_detail.html',
                         product=product,
                         related_products=related_products)

# API endpoints for HTMX
@bp.route('/api/availability/<int:product_id>')
def check_availability_public(product_id):
    """Check product availability for given dates."""
    start_date_str = request.args.get('start_date')
    end_date_str = request.args.get('end_date')
    
    if not start_date_str or not end_date_str:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Start and end dates required'}), 400
    
    try:
        from datetime import datetime
        start_date = datetime.strptime(start_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
        end_date = datetime.strptime(end_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
    except ValueError:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid date format'}), 400
    
    # Check availability
    db_session = current_app.extensions['sqlalchemy'].session
    availability_service = AvailabilityService(db_session)
    
    available_qty = availability_service.available_quantity(
        product_id, start_date, end_date
    )
    
    return jsonify({
        'available_quantity': available_qty,
        'is_available': available_qty > 0
    })


@bp.route('/api/price-estimate/<int:product_id>')
def get_price_estimate(product_id):
    """Get price estimate for product and dates."""
    start_date_str = request.args.get('start_date')
    end_date_str = request.args.get('end_date')
    quantity = request.args.get('quantity', 1, type=int)
    delivery_type = request.args.get('delivery_type', 'pickup')
    
    if not start_date_str or not end_date_str:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Start and end dates required'}), 400
    
    try:
        from datetime import datetime
        start_date = datetime.strptime(start_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
        end_date = datetime.strptime(end_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
    except ValueError:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid date format'}), 400
    
    # Get product
    product = Product.query.filter_by(id=product_id, is_active=True).first()
    if not product:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Product not found'}), 404
    
    # Calculate pricing
    db_session = current_app.extensions['sqlalchemy'].session
    pricing_service = PricingService(db_session, current_app.config['VAT_PERCENT'])
    
    delivery_type_enum = DeliveryType.PICKUP if delivery_type == 'pickup' else DeliveryType.DELIVERY
    
    price_estimate = pricing_service.get_price_estimate(
        product_id, start_date, end_date, quantity, delivery_type_enum
    )
    
    return jsonify(price_estimate)
```

```python
        page=page, per_page=12, error_out=False
    )
    
    # Get categories for filter
    categories = Category.query.filter(
        Category.is_active == True
    ).order_by(Category.name).all()
    
    return render_template('public/catalog.html',
                         products=products,
                         categories=categories,
                         current_category=category_id,
                         search=search,
                         sort_by=sort_by)


@bp.route('/product/<slug>')
def product_detail(slug):
    """Product detail page with availability checker."""
    product = Product.query.filter_by(slug=slug, is_active=True).first_or_404()
    
    # Get related products from same category
    related_products = Product.query.filter(
        Product.category_id == product.category_id,
        Product.id != product.id,
        Product.is_active == True
    ).limit(4).all()
    
    # Get upsell products
    upsell_products = current_app.extensions['sqlalchemy'].session.query(UpsellProduct).join(
        ProductUpsell, UpsellProduct.id == ProductUpsell.upsell_product_id
    ).filter(
        ProductUpsell.product_id == product.id,
        ProductUpsell.is_active == True,
        UpsellProduct.is_active == True,
        UpsellProduct.stock_qty > 0
    ).order_by(ProductUpsell.sort_order).all()
    
    return render_template('public/product_detail.html',
                         product=product,
                         related_products=related_products,
                         upsell_products=upsell_products)


@bp.route('/calendar')
def calendar():
    """General availability calendar."""
    products = Product.query.filter_by(is_active=True).all()
    return render_template('public/general_calendar.html', products=products)

@bp.route('/calendar/<slug>')
def product_calendar(slug):
    """Product availability calendar."""
    product = Product.query.filter_by(slug=slug, is_active=True).first_or_404()
    return render_template('public/calendar.html', product=product, products=[product])

# API endpoints for HTMX
@bp.route('/api/availability/<int:product_id>')
def check_availability_public(product_id):
    """Check product availability for given dates."""
    start_date_str = request.args.get('start_date')
    end_date_str = request.args.get('end_date')
    
    if not start_date_str or not end_date_str:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Start and end dates required'}), 400
    
    try:
        from datetime import datetime
        start_date = datetime.strptime(start_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
        end_date = datetime.strptime(end_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
    except ValueError:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid date format'}), 400
    
    # Check availability
    db_session = current_app.extensions['sqlalchemy'].session
    availability_service = AvailabilityService(db_session)
    
    available_qty = availability_service.available_quantity(
        product_id, start_date, end_date
    )
    
    return jsonify({
        'available_quantity': available_qty,
        'is_available': available_qty > 0
    })


@bp.route('/api/price-estimate/<int:product_id>')
def get_price_estimate(product_id):
    """Get price estimate for product and dates."""
    start_date_str = request.args.get('start_date')
    end_date_str = request.args.get('end_date')
    quantity = request.args.get('quantity', 1, type=int)
    delivery_type = request.args.get('delivery_type', 'pickup')
    
    if not start_date_str or not end_date_str:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Start and end dates required'}), 400
    
    try:
        from datetime import datetime
        start_date = datetime.strptime(start_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
        end_date = datetime.strptime(end_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
    except ValueError:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid date format'}), 400
    
    # Get product
    product = Product.query.filter_by(id=product_id, is_active=True).first()
    if not product:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Product not found'}), 404
    
    # Calculate pricing
    db_session = current_app.extensions['sqlalchemy'].session
    pricing_service = PricingService(db_session, current_app.config['VAT_PERCENT'])
    
    delivery_type_enum = DeliveryType.PICKUP if delivery_type == 'pickup' else DeliveryType.DELIVERY
    
    price_estimate = pricing_service.get_price_estimate(
        product_id, start_date, end_date, quantity, delivery_type_enum
    )
    
    return jsonify(price_estimate)
```

```html
                                                       class="w-16 px-2 py-1 text-center border-none focus:ring-0 text-sm font-medium"
                                                       onchange="updateUpsellTotal()">
                                                <button type="button" 
                                                        class="px-3 py-1 text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-50"
                                                        onclick="updateUpsellQuantity({{ upsell.id }}, 1)">
                                                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 6v6m0 0v6m0-6h6m-6 0H6"></path>
                                                    </svg>
                                                </button>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    
                                    {% if upsell.stock_qty <= 5 %}
                                    <div class="mt-2">
                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800">
                                            Kun {{ upsell.stock_qty }} tilbage
                                        </span>
                                    </div>
                                    {% endif %}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Upsell Total Display -->
                    <div id="upsell-total" class="mt-6 p-4 bg-primary-50 rounded-xl border border-primary-200" style="display: none;">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <h4 class="font-semibold text-primary-900">Tilkøb i alt:</h4>
                                <p class="text-sm text-primary-700">Tilføjes til din samlede pris</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-xl font-bold text-primary-600" id="upsell-total-amount">0 DKK</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
            
            <!-- Enhanced Product Info -->
            <div class="xl:col-span-2">
                
                <!-- Pricing Section -->
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 p-6 mb-8">
                    <!-- Main Price -->
                    <div class="mb-4 relative">
                        <!-- Stock Status Popup (Top Right) -->
                        {% if product.stock_qty <= 5 and product.stock_qty > 0 %}
                        <div class="absolute top-0 right-0">
                            <button class="stock-status-trigger bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded-full hover:bg-yellow-200 transition-colors duration-200 cursor-pointer">
                                Få tilbage
                            </button>
                            <div class="stock-status-popup absolute bottom-full right-0 mb-2 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg px-3 py-2 whitespace-nowrap opacity-0 invisible transition-all duration-200 z-10">
                                Kun {{ product.stock_qty }} enheder tilbage!
                                <div class="absolute top-full right-4 border-4 border-transparent border-t-gray-900"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                        
                        <div class="flex items-baseline space-x-1 mb-2">
                            <div class="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold text-primary-600">
                                {{ product.daily_price_dkk | currency }}
                            </div>

                        </div>
                        <div class="text-sm text-gray-600 font-medium">

                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                                </svg>

                            </span>

                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Weekend Pricing -->

                </div>
            </div>
```
