@bp.route('/upsell-products/<int:upsell_product_id>/delete', methods=['POST'])
@login_required
def delete_upsell_product(upsell_product_id):
    """Delete upsell product."""
    try:
        validate_csrf(request.form.get('csrf_token'))
    except BadRequest:
        flash('Ugyldig CSRF token', 'error')
        return redirect(url_for('admin.upsell_products'))
    
    upsell_product = UpsellProduct.query.get_or_404(upsell_product_id)
    
    # Check if upsell product is linked to any products
    linked_products = ProductUpsell.query.filter_by(upsell_product_id=upsell_product_id).count()
    if linked_products > 0:
        flash(f'Kan ikke slette "{upsell_product.name}" da det er tilknyttet {linked_products} produkt(er)', 'error')
        return redirect(url_for('admin.upsell_products'))
    
    db.session.delete(upsell_product)
    db.session.commit()
    
    flash(f'Mersalgs produkt "{upsell_product.name}" er slettet', 'success')
    return redirect(url_for('admin.upsell_products'))


@bp.route('/products/<int:product_id>/upsells')
@login_required
def product_upsells(product_id):
    """Manage upsells for a specific product."""
    product = Product.query.get_or_404(product_id)
    
    # Get current upsells
    current_upsells = db.session.query(ProductUpsell, UpsellProduct).join(
        UpsellProduct, ProductUpsell.upsell_product_id == UpsellProduct.id
    ).filter(ProductUpsell.product_id == product_id, ProductUpsell.is_active == True).order_by(ProductUpsell.sort_order).all()
    
    # Get available upsells (not already linked)
    linked_upsell_ids = [upsell.ProductUpsell.upsell_product_id for upsell in current_upsells]
    available_upsells = UpsellProduct.query.filter(
        UpsellProduct.is_active == True,
        ~UpsellProduct.id.in_(linked_upsell_ids) if linked_upsell_ids else True
    ).all()
    
    return render_template('admin/product_upsells.html', 
                         product=product, 
                         current_upsells=current_upsells,
                         available_upsells=available_upsells)


@bp.route('/products/<int:product_id>/upsells/add', methods=['POST'])
@login_required
def add_product_upsell(product_id):
    """Add upsell to product."""
    try:
        validate_csrf(request.form.get('csrf_token'))
    except BadRequest:
        flash('Ugyldig CSRF token', 'error')
        return redirect(url_for('admin.product_upsells', product_id=product_id))
    
    product = Product.query.get_or_404(product_id)
    upsell_product_id = request.form.get('upsell_product_id', type=int)
    
    if not upsell_product_id:
        flash('Vælg et mersalgs produkt', 'error')
        return redirect(url_for('admin.product_upsells', product_id=product_id))
    
    # Check if association already exists
    existing = ProductUpsell.query.filter_by(
        product_id=product_id, 
        upsell_product_id=upsell_product_id
    ).first()
    
    if existing:
        if existing.is_active:
            flash('Dette mersalgs produkt er allerede tilknyttet', 'warning')
        else:
            existing.is_active = True
            db.session.commit()
            flash('Mersalgs produkt er genaktiveret', 'success')
    else:
        # Get next sort order
        max_order = db.session.query(func.max(ProductUpsell.sort_order)).filter_by(product_id=product_id).scalar() or 0
        
        product_upsell = ProductUpsell(
            product_id=product_id,
            upsell_product_id=upsell_product_id,
            sort_order=max_order + 1,
            is_active=True
        )
        
        db.session.add(product_upsell)
        db.session.commit()
        
        flash('Mersalgs produkt er tilknyttet', 'success')
    
    return redirect(url_for('admin.product_upsells', product_id=product_id))

@bp.route('/overview-calendar')
@login_required
def overview_calendar():
    """Overview calendar showing all bookings."""
    # Get all products for filtering
    products = Product.query.filter_by(is_active=True).order_by(Product.name).all()
    
    return render_template('admin/overview_calendar.html', products=products)


@bp.route('/api/overview-calendar-data')
@login_required
def api_overview_calendar_data():
    """API endpoint for overview calendar data."""
    start_date_str = request.args.get('start')
    end_date_str = request.args.get('end')
    product_id = request.args.get('product_id', type=int)
    
    if not start_date_str or not end_date_str:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Missing start or end date'}), 400
    
    try:
        from datetime import datetime
        start_date = datetime.fromisoformat(start_date_str.replace('Z', '')).date()
        end_date = datetime.fromisoformat(end_date_str.replace('Z', '')).date()
    except ValueError:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid date format'}), 400
    
    # Build query for bookings
    query = db.session.query(Booking).join(BookingItem).join(Product).filter(
        and_(
            Booking.start_date <= end_date,
            Booking.end_date >= start_date,
            Booking.status != BookingStatus.CANCELLED
        )
    )
    
    # Filter by product if specified
    if product_id:
        query = query.filter(BookingItem.product_id == product_id)
    
    bookings = query.distinct().all()
    
    events = []
    for booking in bookings:
        # Get all products for this booking
        product_names = [item.product.name for item in booking.items if item.product]
        
        # Determine color based on status
        if booking.status == BookingStatus.PENDING:
            color = '#f59e0b'  # Amber
        elif booking.status == BookingStatus.PAID:
            color = '#10b981'  # Green
        elif booking.status == BookingStatus.FULFILLED:
            color = '#3b82f6'  # Blue
        else:
            color = '#6b7280'  # Gray
        
        events.append({
            'id': booking.id,
            'title': f"{booking.customer_name} - {', '.join(product_names[:2])}{'...' if len(product_names) > 2 else ''}",
            'start': booking.start_date.isoformat(),
            'end': (booking.end_date + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat(),  # FullCalendar end is exclusive
            'color': color,
            'extendedProps': {
                'booking_no': booking.booking_no,
                'customer_name': booking.customer_name,
                'customer_email': booking.email,
                'customer_phone': booking.phone,
                'status': booking.status.value,
                'total': float(booking.total_dkk),
                'products': product_names,
                'item_count': len(booking.items)
            }
        })
    
    return jsonify(events)

function closeModal() {
    document.getElementById('booking-modal').style.display = 'none';
}

function getStatusBadgeClass(status) {
    switch(status) {
        case 'pending': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';
        case 'paid': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';
        case 'fulfilled': return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800';
        default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';
    }
}

function getStatusText(status) {
    switch(status) {
        case 'pending': return 'Afventer betaling';
        case 'paid': return 'Betalt';
        case 'fulfilled': return 'Afsluttet';
        case 'cancelled': return 'Annulleret';
        default: return status;
    }
}

function formatDate(date) {
    return date.toLocaleDateString('da-DK', {
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'long',
        day: 'numeric'
    });
}

function showNotification(message, type = 'info') {
    // Simple notification - you can enhance this
    alert(message);
}
</script>

                                <div class="flex">
                                    <div class="flex-shrink-0">

                                                <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zM8.707 7.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414L8.586 10l-1.293 1.293a1 1 0 101.414 1.414L10 11.414l1.293 1.293a1 1 0 001.414-1.414L11.414 10l1.293-1.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L10 8.586 8.707 7.293z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                            </svg>
                                        {% elif category == 'success' %}
                                            <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-green-400" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                                <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                            </svg>
                                        {% elif category == 'warning' %}
                                            <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-yellow-400" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                                <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M8.257 3.099c.765-1.36 2.722-1.36 3.486 0l5.58 9.92c.75 1.334-.213 2.98-1.742 2.98H4.42c-1.53 0-2.493-1.646-1.743-2.98l5.58-9.92zM11 13a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zm-1-8a1 1 0 00-1 1v3a1 1 0 002 0V6a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                            </svg>
                                        {% else %}
                                            <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-blue-400" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                                <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7-4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zM9 9a1 1 0 000 2v3a1 1 0 001 1h1a1 1 0 100-2v-3a1 1 0 00-1-1H9z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                            </svg>
                                        {% endif %}
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="ml-3">
                                        <p class="text-sm font-medium">{{ message }}</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                {% endif %}
            {% endwith %}

            <!-- Main Content Area -->
            <div class="px-4 py-6">
                {% block content %}{% endblock %}
            </div>
        </main>
    </div>
    
    <!-- JavaScript -->
    <script>
        // Initialize Alpine.js data
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('app', () => ({
                sidebarOpen: false,
                mobileMenuOpen: false,
                productCount: 0,
                pendingBookings: 0,
                
                init() {
                    this.loadStats();
                    this.updateCurrentDate();
                },
                
                async loadStats() {
                    try {
                        // Load product count
                        const productResponse = await fetch('/api/stats/products');
                        if (productResponse.ok) {
                            const data = await productResponse.json();
                            this.productCount = data.count;
                        }
                        
                        // Load pending bookings count
                        const bookingResponse = await fetch('/api/stats/pending-bookings');
                        if (bookingResponse.ok) {
                            const data = await bookingResponse.json();
                            this.pendingBookings = data.count;
                        }
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.log('Stats not available');
                    }
                },
                
                updateCurrentDate() {
                    const now = new Date();
                    const options = { 
                        weekday: 'long', 
                        year: 'numeric', 
                        month: 'long', 
                        day: 'numeric' 
                    };
                    const dateString = now.toLocaleDateString('da-DK', options);
                    const dateElement = document.getElementById('current-date');
                    if (dateElement) {
                        dateElement.textContent = dateString;
                    }
                }
            }));
        });
    </script>
    
    {% block extra_js %}{% endblock %}
</body>
</html>

                    <div class="aspect-w-16 aspect-h-12 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden border border-gray-100">
                        {% if product.hero_image_url %}
                        <img id="main-product-image" 
                             src="{{ product.hero_image_url | image_url }}" 
                             alt="{{ product.name }}" 
                             class="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105">
                        <!-- Image Zoom Overlay -->
                        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-0 group-hover:bg-opacity-10 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <div class="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300">
                                <div class="bg-white bg-opacity-90 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-full p-3 shadow-lg">
                                    <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-gray-700" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0zM10 7v3m0 0v3m0-3h3m-3 0H7"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% else %}
                        <div class="w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-100 to-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <div class="text-center">
                                <svg class="w-16 h-16 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1" d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                                </svg>
                                <span class="text-gray-500 text-lg font-medium">Intet billede tilgængeligt</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Image Badges -->
                    <div class="absolute top-4 left-4 flex flex-col space-y-2">
                        <div class="bg-green-500 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold shadow-lg flex items-center">
                            <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                            </svg>
                            Tilgængelig
                        </div>
                        {% if product.weekend_price_dkk %}
                        <div class="bg-accent-500 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold shadow-lg">
                            Weekend-special
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Thumbnail Gallery -->
                <div class="flex space-x-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
                    {% if product.hero_image_url %}
                    <button class="thumbnail-btn flex-shrink-0 w-20 h-20 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 border-primary-500 shadow-md" 
                            data-image="{{ product.hero_image_url | image_url }}">
                        <img src="{{ product.hero_image_url | image_url }}" alt="{{ product.name }}" 
                             class="w-full h-full object-cover">
                    </button>
                    {% endif %}
                    {% if product.images %}
                        {% for image in product.images[:6] %}
                        <button class="thumbnail-btn flex-shrink-0 w-20 h-20 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 border-gray-200 hover:border-primary-500 transition-all duration-200 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg" 
                                data-image="{{ image.url }}">
                            <img src="{{ image.url }}" alt="{{ image.alt or product.name }}" 
                                 class="w-full h-full object-cover hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-200">
                        </button>
                        {% endfor %}
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                
                <!-- Trust Signals -->
                <div class="mt-8 grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                    <div class="text-center p-4 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md border border-gray-100">
                        <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-green-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-2">
                            <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-green-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z"></path>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Forsikret</p>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Fuldt dækket</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-center p-4 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md border border-gray-100">
                        <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-blue-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-2">
                            <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11h-7z"></path>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Hurtig levering</p>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Samme dag</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-center p-4 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md border border-gray-100">
                        <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-purple-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-2">
                            <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-purple-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M18.364 5.636l-3.536 3.536m0 5.656l3.536 3.536M9.172 9.172L5.636 5.636m3.536 9.192L5.636 18.364M12 2.5v19M2.5 12h19"></path>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Support 24/7</p>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Altid hjælp</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Enhanced Product Description -->
                {% if product.description %}
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 p-6 mb-8 mt-8">
                    <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4 flex items-center">
                        <svg class="w-6 h-6 mr-3 text-primary-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        Produktbeskrivelse
                    </h3>
                    <div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none text-gray-700 leading-relaxed">
                        {{ product.description | safe }}
                    </div>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
                
                <!-- Enhanced Product Specifications -->
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 p-6">
                    <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-6 flex items-center">
                        <svg class="w-6 h-6 mr-3 text-primary-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 5H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h8a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2M9 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2m-3 7h3m-3 4h3m-6-4h.01M9 16h.01"></path>
                        </svg>
                        Specifikationer
                    </h3>
                    
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                        <!-- Category -->
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-50 to-accent-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-primary-200">
                            <dt class="text-sm font-bold text-primary-800 mb-2 flex items-center">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M7 7h.01M7 3h5c.512 0 1.024.195 1.414.586l7 7a2 2 0 010 2.828l-7 7a2 2 0 01-2.828 0l-7-7A1.994 1.994 0 013 12V7a4 4 0 014-4z"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Kategori
                            </dt>
                            <dd class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">{{ product.category.name }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Stock -->
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-green-50 to-blue-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-green-200">
                            <dt class="text-sm font-bold text-green-800 mb-2 flex items-center">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M20 7l-8-4-8 4m16 0l-8 4m8-4v10l-8 4m0-10L4 7m8 4v10M9 12l8-4"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Lager status
                            </dt>
                            <dd class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
                                {% if product.stock_qty > 5 %}
                                    På lager ({{ product.stock_qty }} stk.)
                                {% elif product.stock_qty > 0 %}
                                    Få tilbage ({{ product.stock_qty }} stk.)
                                {% else %}
                                    Udsolgt
                                {% endif %}
                            </dd>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Dimensions if available -->
                        {% if product.dimensions %}
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50 to-purple-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-blue-200">
                            <dt class="text-sm font-bold text-blue-800 mb-2 flex items-center">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4 8V4a2 2 0 012-2h2M4 16v4a2 2 0 002 2h2m8-18h2a2 2 0 012 2v4m0 8v4a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Dimensioner
                            </dt>
                            <dd class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">{{ product.dimensions }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                        
                        <!-- Deposit -->
                        {% if product.deposit_dkk %}
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-50 to-orange-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-yellow-200">
                            <dt class="text-sm font-bold text-yellow-800 mb-2 flex items-center">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17 9V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2h2m2 4h10a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H9a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Depositum
                            </dt>
                            <dd class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">{{ product.deposit_dkk | currency }}</dd>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Upsell Products Section -->
                {% if upsell_products %}
                <div class="mt-8 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 p-6">
                    <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-6 flex items-center">
                        <svg class="w-6 h-6 mr-3 text-primary-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 6v6m0 0v6m0-6h6m-6 0H6"></path>
                        </svg>
                        Tilkøb til din leje
                    </h3>
                    
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                        {% for upsell in upsell_products %}
                        <div class="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 hover:border-primary-300 group">
                            <div class="flex items-center space-x-4">
                                {% if upsell.image_url %}
                                <img src="{{ url_for('static', filename=upsell.image_url) }}" 
                                     alt="{{ upsell.name }}" 
                                     class="w-16 h-16 rounded-lg object-cover flex-shrink-0 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200">
                                {% else %}
                                <div class="w-16 h-16 bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-100 to-gray-200 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                                    <svg class="w-8 h-8 text-gray-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M20 7l-8-4-8 4m16 0l-8 4m8-4v10l-8 4m0-10L4 7m8 4v10"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                </div>
                                {% endif %}
                                
                                <div class="flex-1">
                                    <h4 class="font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-1 group-hover:text-primary-600 transition-colors duration-200">
                                        {{ upsell.name }}
                                    </h4>
                                    {% if upsell.description %}
                                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-2">
                                        {{ upsell.description[:80] }}{% if upsell.description|length > 80 %}...{% endif %}
                                    </p>
                                    {% endif %}
                                    
                                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                        <span class="text-lg font-bold text-primary-600">{{ upsell.price_dkk }} DKK</span>
                                        
                                        <div class="flex items-center space-x-2">
                                            <div class="flex items-center border border-gray-300 rounded-lg">
                                                <button type="button" 
                                                        class="px-3 py-1 text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-50"
                                                        onclick="updateUpsellQuantity({{ upsell.id }}, -1)">
                                                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M20 12H4"></path>
                                                    </svg>
                                                </button>
                                                <input type="number" 
                                                       id="upsell-qty-{{ upsell.id }}"
                                                       min="0" 
                                                       max="{{ upsell.stock_qty }}" 
                                                       value="0"
                                                       class="w-16 px-2 py-1 text-center border-none focus:ring-0 text-sm font-medium"
                                                       onchange="updateUpsellTotal()">
                                                <button type="button" 
                                                        class="px-3 py-1 text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-50"
                                                        onclick="updateUpsellQuantity({{ upsell.id }}, 1)">
                                                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 6v6m0 0v6m0-6h6m-6 0H6"></path>
                                                    </svg>
                                                </button>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    
                                    {% if upsell.stock_qty <= 5 %}
                                    <div class="mt-2">
                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800">
                                            Kun {{ upsell.stock_qty }} tilbage
                                        </span>
                                    </div>
                                    {% endif %}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Upsell Total Display -->
                    <div id="upsell-total" class="mt-6 p-4 bg-primary-50 rounded-xl border border-primary-200" style="display: none;">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <h4 class="font-semibold text-primary-900">Tilkøb i alt:</h4>
                                <p class="text-sm text-primary-700">Tilføjes til din samlede pris</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-xl font-bold text-primary-600" id="upsell-total-amount">0 DKK</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
            
            <!-- Enhanced Product Info -->
            <div class="xl:col-span-2">
                
                <!-- Pricing Section -->
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-gray-100 p-6 mb-8">
                    <!-- Main Price -->
                    <div class="mb-4 relative">
                        <!-- Stock Status Popup (Top Right) -->
                        {% if product.stock_qty <= 5 and product.stock_qty > 0 %}
                        <div class="absolute top-0 right-0">
                            <button class="stock-status-trigger bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded-full hover:bg-yellow-200 transition-colors duration-200 cursor-pointer">
                                Få tilbage
                            </button>
                            <div class="stock-status-popup absolute bottom-full right-0 mb-2 bg-gray-900 text-white text-xs rounded-lg px-3 py-2 whitespace-nowrap opacity-0 invisible transition-all duration-200 z-10">
                                Kun {{ product.stock_qty }} enheder tilbage!
                                <div class="absolute top-full right-4 border-4 border-transparent border-t-gray-900"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                        
                        <div class="flex items-baseline space-x-1 mb-2">
                            <div class="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold text-primary-600">
                                {{ product.daily_price_dkk | currency }}
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-xl text-gray-500 font-medium">/dag</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="text-sm text-gray-600 font-medium">
                            <span class="inline-flex items-center">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-1 text-green-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Inklusiv moms og forsikring
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Weekend Pricing -->
                    {% if product.weekend_price_dkk %}
                    <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-accent-50 to-primary-50 rounded-xl p-4 mb-4 border border-accent-200">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <div class="text-lg font-bold text-accent-700">
                                    {{ product.weekend_price_dkk | currency }}/dag
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-sm text-accent-600">Weekend pris (lør-søn)</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="bg-accent-500 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold">
                                Special
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                    
                    <!-- Deposit Info -->
                    {% if product.deposit_dkk %}
                    <div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-gray-200">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div>
                                <div class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
                                    {{ product.deposit_dkk | currency }}
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-sm text-gray-600">Depositum (refunderbart)</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-green-600">
                                <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path>
                                </svg>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                
                
                <!-- Modern Calendar Section -->
                <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden mb-8">
                    <!-- Modern Calendar Header -->
                    <div class="bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 px-8 py-8 relative overflow-hidden">
                        <!-- Animated Background -->
                        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600/20 to-purple-600/20"></div>
                        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-[url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width=\"60\" height=\"60\" viewBox=\"0 0 60 60\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"%3E%3Cg fill=\"none\" fill-rule=\"evenodd\"%3E%3Cg fill=\"%23ffffff\" fill-opacity=\"0.05\"%3E%3Ccircle cx=\"30\" cy=\"30\" r=\"1.5\"/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E')] animate-pulse"></div>
                        
                        <div class="relative">
                            <!-- Main Content (Centered naturally) -->
                            <div class="text-center lg:text-left">
                                <div class="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-2xl mb-4 mx-auto lg:mx-0">
                                    <svg class="w-8 h-8 text-white" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                </div>
                                <h3 class="text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold text-white mb-3 tracking-tight">
                                    Vælg dine datoer
                                </h3>
                                <p class="text-white/80 text-lg mb-6 max-w-md mx-auto lg:mx-0">
                                    Klik på en dato for enkelt dag eller vælg flere datoer for en periode
                                </p>
                                
                                <!-- Quick Info Cards -->
                                <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center lg:justify-start">
                                    <div class="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-white/90 text-sm font-medium">
                                        <svg class="w-4 h-4 inline mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                        Øjeblikkelig booking
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-white/90 text-sm font-medium">
                                        <svg class="w-4 h-4 inline mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                        Fleksible datoer
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <!-- Fixed Selection Display (Desktop) -->
                            <div id="selection-info" class="hidden lg:block absolute top-0 right-0">
                                <div class="bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-md rounded-lg px-3 py-2 border border-white/20 text-center w-44 h-16 flex flex-col justify-center">
                                    <div class="text-white/70 text-xs font-medium mb-1 uppercase tracking-wide">Valgte periode</div>
                                    <div id="selected-dates" class="font-semibold text-xs text-white leading-tight">
                                        Ingen valgt
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Modern Calendar Container -->
                    <div class="p-8 lg:p-12 bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-50 to-white">
                        <div id="calendar" class="modern-calendar w-full"></div>
                        
                        <!-- Mobile Selection Info -->
                        <div id="mobile-selection-info" class="lg:hidden mt-8 p-6 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg border border-gray-100">
                            <div class="text-center">
                                <div class="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2">Valgte periode</div>
                                <div id="selected-dates-mobile" class="font-bold text-lg text-gray-900 px-4 py-2 bg-gray-100 rounded-xl">Ingen valgt</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Enhanced Selection Summary & Actions -->
                    <div id="selection-summary" class="hidden bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-50 to-white px-6 py-6 border-t border-gray-200">
                        <div class="space-y-6">
                            <!-- Availability Status -->
                            <div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between space-y-4 lg:space-y-0">
                                <div class="flex items-center space-x-4">
                                    <div id="availability-status" class="flex items-center">
                                        <!-- Status icon will be inserted here -->
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <div id="availability-text" class="font-bold text-lg text-gray-900"></div>
                                        <div id="availability-details" class="text-sm text-gray-600"></div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-center lg:text-right">
                                    <div id="price-display" class="text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold text-primary-600 mb-1">
                                        <!-- Price will be calculated here -->
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="text-sm text-gray-600 font-medium" id="price-details">
                                        <!-- Price details will be shown here -->
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <!-- Action Buttons -->
                            <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-3 sm:space-y-0 sm:space-x-4 pt-4 border-t border-gray-200">
                                <button id="clear-selection" 
                                        class="w-full sm:w-auto px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 bg-white border-2 border-gray-300 rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-50 hover:border-gray-400 transition-all duration-200 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg">
                                    <svg class="w-4 h-4 inline mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                    Ryd valg
                                </button>
                                <button id="add-to-cart" 
                                        class="w-full sm:w-auto px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold text-white bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-600 via-primary-700 to-accent-600 rounded-xl hover:from-primary-700 hover:via-primary-800 hover:to-accent-700 transition-all duration-200 shadow-xl hover:shadow-2xl transform hover:scale-105 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:transform-none disabled:hover:scale-100 group"
                                        disabled>
                                    <svg class="w-5 h-5 inline mr-2 group-hover:animate-bounce" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4m0 0L7 13m0 0l-2.5 5M7 13l2.5 5m6-5v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H9a2 2 0 01-2-2v-6m8 0V9a2 2 0 00-2-2H9a2 2 0 00-2 2v4.01"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                    Tilføj til kurv
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Enhanced Legend -->
                    <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-50 via-white to-gray-50 px-6 py-6 border-t border-gray-200">
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start group p-3 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200">
                                <div class="w-5 h-5 bg-green-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-lg border-2 border-white transform group-hover:scale-125 transition-transform duration-200"></div>
                                <div>
                                    <span class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800">Tilgængelig</span>
                                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Klar til booking</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start group p-3 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200">
                                <div class="w-5 h-5 bg-red-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-lg border-2 border-white transform group-hover:scale-125 transition-transform duration-200"></div>
                                <div>
                                    <span class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800">Optaget</span>
                                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Ikke tilgængelig</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start group p-3 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200">
                                <div class="w-5 h-5 bg-gray-500 rounded-full mr-3 shadow-lg border-2 border-white transform group-hover:scale-125 transition-transform duration-200"></div>
                                <div>
                                    <span class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800">Sortdato</span>
                                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Lukket dag</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Tips Section -->
                        <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-50 to-accent-50 rounded-xl p-4 border border-primary-200">
                            <div class="flex items-start space-x-3">
                                <div class="flex-shrink-0">
                                    <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-primary-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9.663 17h4.673M12 3v1m6.364 1.636l-.707.707M21 12h-1M4 12H3m3.343-5.657l-.707-.707m2.828 9.9a5 5 0 117.072 0l-.548.547A3.374 3.374 0 0014 18.469V19a2 2 0 11-4 0v-.531c0-.895-.356-1.754-.988-2.386l-.548-.547z"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <h4 class="font-bold text-primary-800 mb-2">Booking tips</h4>
                                    <ul class="text-sm text-primary-700 space-y-1">
                                        <li class="flex items-center"><span class="w-1 h-1 bg-primary-500 rounded-full mr-2"></span>Hold musen over farvede prikker for detaljer</li>
                                        <li class="flex items-center"><span class="w-1 h-1 bg-primary-500 rounded-full mr-2"></span>Klik start/slut-dato for at forkorte periode</li>
                                        <li class="flex items-center"><span class="w-1 h-1 bg-primary-500 rounded-full mr-2"></span>Minimum lejepriod: 1 dag</li>
                                    </ul>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Related Products Section -->
{% if related_products %}
<div class="bg-gradient-to-br from-white via-gray-50 to-blue-50 py-16 relative overflow-hidden">
    <!-- Background Pattern -->
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-[url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width="60" height="60" viewBox="0 0 60 60" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"%3E%3Cg fill="none" fill-rule="evenodd"%3E%3Cg fill="%230ea5e9" fill-opacity="0.03"%3E%3Ccircle cx="30" cy="30" r="2"/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E')] opacity-50"></div>
    
    <div class="relative max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <!-- Section Header -->

                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1" d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>

                <!-- Product Info -->

                    <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3 group-hover:text-primary-600 transition-colors duration-200">
                        <a href="{{ url_for('public.product_detail', slug=related_product.slug) }}">
                            {{ related_product.name }}
                        </a>
                    </h3>
                    
                    <!-- Price and CTA -->
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div>
                            <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-primary-600">
                                {{ related_product.daily_price_dkk | currency }}

                        <a href="{{ url_for('public.product_detail', slug=related_product.slug) }}" 
                           class="bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-600 to-accent-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold hover:from-primary-700 hover:to-accent-700 transition-all duration-200 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transform hover:scale-105 group">
                            <span class="group-hover:hidden">Se mere</span>

                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6"></path>

        <!-- View All CTA -->
        <div class="text-center mt-12">
            <a href="{{ url_for('public.catalog') }}" 
               class="inline-flex items-center bg-white text-primary-600 px-8 py-4 rounded-xl text-lg font-bold hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200 shadow-xl hover:shadow-2xl transform hover:scale-105 border-2 border-primary-200 hover:border-primary-300">
                <svg class="w-6 h-6 mr-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 11H5m14 0a2 2 0 012 2v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-6a2 2 0 012-2m14 0V9a2 2 0 00-2-2M5 11V9a2 2 0 012-2m0 0V5a2 2 0 012-2h6a2 2 0 012 2v2M7 7h10"></path>
                </svg>
                Se hele kataloget
                <svg class="w-5 h-5 ml-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6"></path>
                </svg>
