```html
                                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                                </tr>
                                {% endfor %}
                            </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        {% if upsell_products.pages > 1 %}
        <div class="px-6 py-3 border-t border-gray-200">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                            Viser <span class="font-medium">{{ ((upsell_products.page - 1) * upsell_products.per_page) + 1 }}</span> til

                                    <a href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products', page=page_num) }}"
```

```html
                            <th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Oprettet</th>
                            <th class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Handlinger</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                        {% for upsell_product in upsell_products.items %}
                        <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors duration-200">
                            <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                {% if upsell_product.image_url %}
                                <img src="{{ url_for('static', filename=upsell_product.image_url) }}" 
                                     alt="{{ upsell_product.name }}" 
                                     class="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg object-cover border border-gray-200">
                                {% else %}
                                <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-gray-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                                    <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-gray-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                </div>
                                {% endif %}
                            </td>
                            <td class="px-6 py-4">
                                <div>
                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">{{ upsell_product.name }}</div>
                                    {% if upsell_product.description %}
                                    <div class="text-sm text-gray-500">{{ upsell_product.description[:100] }}{% if upsell_product.description|length > 100 %}...{% endif %}</div>
                                    {% endif %}
                                </div>
                            </td>
                            <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{{ upsell_product.price_dkk }} DKK</div>
                            </td>
                            <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                {% if upsell_product.stock_qty > 10 %}
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-green-100 text-green-800">{{ upsell_product.stock_qty }}</span>
                                {% elif upsell_product.stock_qty > 0 %}
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800">{{ upsell_product.stock_qty }}</span>
                                {% else %}
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-red-100 text-red-800">Udsolgt</span>
                                {% endif %}
                            </td>
                            <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                {% if upsell_product.is_active %}
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-green-100 text-green-800">Aktiv</span>
                                {% else %}
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-gray-100 text-gray-800">Inaktiv</span>
                                {% endif %}
                            </td>
                            <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-gray-500">
                                {{ upsell_product.created_at.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') }}
                            </td>
                            <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-sm font-medium">
                                <div class="flex justify-end space-x-2">
                                    <a href="{{ url_for('admin.edit_upsell_product', upsell_product_id=upsell_product.id) }}" 
                                       class="text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-900 transition-colors duration-200" title="Rediger">
                                        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                    </a>
                                    <button type="button" 
                                            class="text-red-600 hover:text-red-900 transition-colors duration-200" 
                                            onclick="confirmDelete('{{ upsell_product.name }}', {{ upsell_product.id }})"
                                            title="Slet">
                                        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                                </tr>
                                {% endfor %}
                            </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        {% if upsell_products.pages > 1 %}
        <div class="px-6 py-3 border-t border-gray-200">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                            Viser <span class="font-medium">{{ ((upsell_products.page - 1) * upsell_products.per_page) + 1 }}</span> til 
                            <span class="font-medium">{{ upsell_products.page * upsell_products.per_page if upsell_products.page * upsell_products.per_page < upsell_products.total else upsell_products.total }}</span> af 
                            <span class="font-medium">{{ upsell_products.total }}</span> resultater
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <nav class="relative z-0 inline-flex rounded-md shadow-sm -space-x-px" aria-label="Pagination">
                            {% if upsell_products.has_prev %}
                            <a href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products', page=upsell_products.prev_num) }}" 
                               class="relative inline-flex items-center px-2 py-2 rounded-l-md border border-gray-300 bg-white text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50">
                                <span class="sr-only">Forrige</span>
                                <svg class="h-5 w-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                    <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M12.707 5.293a1 1 0 010 1.414L9.414 10l3.293 3.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414l-4-4a1 1 0 010-1.414l4-4a1 1 0 011.414 0z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                </svg>
                            </a>
                            {% endif %}
                            
                            {% for page_num in upsell_products.iter_pages() %}
                                {% if page_num %}
                                    {% if page_num != upsell_products.page %}
                                    <a href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products', page=page_num) }}" 
                                       class="relative inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 bg-white text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50">
                                        {{ page_num }}
                                    </a>
                                    {% else %}
                                    <span class="relative inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 text-sm font-medium text-indigo-600">
                                        {{ page_num }}
                                    </span>
                                    {% endif %}
                                {% else %}
                                <span class="relative inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 bg-white text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    …
                                </span>
                                {% endif %}
                            {% endfor %}
                            
                            {% if upsell_products.has_next %}
                            <a href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products', page=upsell_products.next_num) }}" 
                               class="relative inline-flex items-center px-2 py-2 rounded-r-md border border-gray-300 bg-white text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50">
                                <span class="sr-only">Næste</span>
                                <svg class="h-5 w-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                    <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M7.293 14.707a1 1 0 010-1.414L10.586 10 7.293 6.707a1 1 0 011.414-1.414l4 4a1 1 0 010 1.414l-4 4a1 1 0 01-1.414 0z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                </svg>
                            </a>
                            {% endif %}
                        </nav>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </nav>
        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
    {% else %}
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
        <div class="px-6 py-16 text-center">
            <svg class="w-16 h-16 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1" d="M20 7l-8-4-8 4m16 0l-8 4m8-4v10l-8 4m0-10L4 7m8 4v10"></path>
            </svg>
            <h3 class="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 mb-2">Ingen mersalgs produkter fundet</h3>
            <p class="text-gray-500 mb-6">Opret dit første mersalgs produkt for at komme i gang.</p>
            <a href="{{ url_for('admin.create_upsell_product') }}" class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-transparent rounded-lg shadow-sm text-sm font-medium text-white bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-colors duration-200">
                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 6v6m0 0v6m0-6h6m-6 0H6"></path>
                </svg>
                Opret Mersalgs Produkt
            </a>
        </div>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Delete confirmation modal -->
<div id="deleteModal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-600 bg-opacity-50 overflow-y-auto h-full w-full z-50" style="display: none;">
    <div class="relative top-20 mx-auto p-5 border w-96 shadow-lg rounded-lg bg-white">
        <div class="mt-3">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">Bekræft sletning</h3>
                <button type="button" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600" onclick="closeDeleteModal()">
                    <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"></path>
                    </svg>
                </button>
            </div>
            
            <div class="mt-2 px-7 py-3">
                <p class="text-sm text-gray-500">
                    Er du sikker på, at du vil slette mersalgs produktet <strong id="deleteProductName"></strong>?
                </p>
                <p class="text-sm text-red-600 mt-2">Denne handling kan ikke fortrydes.</p>
            </div>
            
            <div class="flex items-center justify-end space-x-3 mt-6 px-6 py-3">
                <button type="button" onclick="closeDeleteModal()" class="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-300 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-400 transition-colors">
                    Annuller
                </button>
                <form id="deleteForm" method="POST" style="display: inline;">
                    <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="{{ csrf_token() }}"/>
                    <button type="submit" class="px-4 py-2 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors">
                        Slet
                    </button>
                </form>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
function confirmDelete(productName, productId) {
    document.getElementById('deleteProductName').textContent = productName;
    document.getElementById('deleteForm').action = '{{ url_for("admin.delete_upsell_product", upsell_product_id=0) }}'.replace('0', productId);
    document.getElementById('deleteModal').style.display = 'block';
}

function closeDeleteModal() {
    document.getElementById('deleteModal').style.display = 'none';
}

// Close modal when clicking outside
document.getElementById('deleteModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === this) {
        closeDeleteModal();
    }
});
</script>

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "admin/base.html" %}

{% block title %}{% if upsell_product %}Rediger{% else %}Opret{% endif %} Mersalgs Produkt - Admin{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="mb-8">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">
                    {% if upsell_product %}Rediger{% else %}Opret{% endif %} Mersalgs Produkt
                </h1>
                <p class="text-lg text-gray-600">{% if upsell_product %}Opdater{% else %}Tilføj nyt{% endif %} mersalgs produkt til systemet</p>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                <a href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products') }}" class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg shadow-sm text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors duration-200">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M10 19l-7-7m0 0l7-7m0 7h18"></path>
                    </svg>
                    Tilbage til liste
                </a>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

            <div class="row">
                <div class="col-lg-8">
                    <div class="card">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">Produkt information</h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            <form method="POST" enctype="multipart/form-data">
                                {{ form.hidden_tag() }}
                                
                                <div class="row">
                                    <div class="col-md-8">
                                        <div class="form-group">
                                            {{ form.name.label(class="form-label") }}
                                            {{ form.name(class="form-control" + (" is-invalid" if form.name.errors else "")) }}
                                            {% if form.name.errors %}
                                                <div class="invalid-feedback">
                                                    {% for error in form.name.errors %}
                                                        {{ error }}
                                                    {% endfor %}
                                                </div>
                                            {% endif %}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="col-md-4">
                                        <div class="form-group">
                                            {{ form.price_dkk.label(class="form-label") }}
                                            <div class="input-group">
                                                {{ form.price_dkk(class="form-control" + (" is-invalid" if form.price_dkk.errors else "")) }}
                                                <div class="input-group-append">
                                                    <span class="input-group-text">DKK</span>
                                                </div>
                                                {% if form.price_dkk.errors %}
                                                    <div class="invalid-feedback">
                                                        {% for error in form.price_dkk.errors %}
                                                            {{ error }}
                                                        {% endfor %}
                                                    </div>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="form-group">
                                    {{ form.description.label(class="form-label") }}
                                    {{ form.description(class="form-control" + (" is-invalid" if form.description.errors else "")) }}
                                    {% if form.description.errors %}
                                        <div class="invalid-feedback">
                                            {% for error in form.description.errors %}
                                                {{ error }}
                                            {% endfor %}
                                        </div>
                                    {% endif %}
                                    <small class="form-text text-muted">Beskriv mersalgs produktet og dets fordele.</small>
                                </div>

                                <div class="row">
                                    <div class="col-md-6">
                                        <div class="form-group">
                                            {{ form.stock_qty.label(class="form-label") }}
                                            {{ form.stock_qty(class="form-control" + (" is-invalid" if form.stock_qty.errors else "")) }}
                                            {% if form.stock_qty.errors %}
                                                <div class="invalid-feedback">
                                                    {% for error in form.stock_qty.errors %}
                                                        {{ error }}
                                                    {% endfor %}
                                                </div>
                                            {% endif %}
                                            <small class="form-text text-muted">Antal enheder på lager. Sæt til 0 hvis udsolgt.</small>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="col-md-6">
                                        <div class="form-group">
                                            <label class="form-label">Status</label>
                                            <div class="form-check">
                                                {{ form.is_active(class="form-check-input") }}
                                                {{ form.is_active.label(class="form-check-label") }}
                                            </div>
                                            <small class="form-text text-muted">Kun aktive produkter vises til kunder.</small>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="form-group">
                                    {{ form.image.label(class="form-label") }}
                                    {{ form.image(class="form-control-file" + (" is-invalid" if form.image.errors else "")) }}
                                    {% if form.image.errors %}
                                        <div class="invalid-feedback">
                                            {% for error in form.image.errors %}
                                                {{ error }}
                                            {% endfor %}
                                        </div>
                                    {% endif %}
                                    <small class="form-text text-muted">Upload et billede af mersalgs produktet. Understøttede formater: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP.</small>
                                </div>

                                <div class="form-group mt-4">
                                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
                                        <i class="fas fa-save"></i> 
                                        {% if upsell_product %}Opdater{% else %}Opret{% endif %} Mersalgs Produkt
                                    </button>
                                    <a href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products') }}" class="btn btn-secondary ml-2">
                                        Annuller
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                            </form>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="col-lg-4">
                    {% if upsell_product and upsell_product.image_url %}
                    <div class="card">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">Nuværende billede</h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            <img src="{{ url_for('static', filename=upsell_product.image_url) }}" 
                                 alt="{{ upsell_product.name }}" 
                                 class="img-fluid rounded">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}

                    <div class="card mt-3">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">Hjælp</h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            <h6>Mersalgs produkter</h6>
                            <p class="small text-muted">
                                Mersalgs produkter er tilkøbs produkter som kunder kan tilføje til deres lejeperiode. 
                                For eksempel: popcorn pakker til popcorn maskiner, ekstra udstyr, etc.
                            </p>
                            
                            <h6>Prissætning</h6>
                            <p class="small text-muted">
                                Mersalgs produkter har en fast pris uanset lejeperiode. Prisen er pr. styk/pakke.
                            </p>
                            
                            <h6>Lagerstyring</h6>
                            <p class="small text-muted">
                                Hold øje med lagerantallet. Når det når 0, vises produktet som udsolgt til kunder.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
                                    {{ form.stock_qty(class="block w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500" + (" border-red-300" if form.stock_qty.errors else "")) }}
                                    {% if form.stock_qty.errors %}

                                                {{ error }}
```

```html
                                        {{ form.is_active.label(class="ml-2 block text-sm text-gray-900") }}
                                    </div>
                                    <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">Kun aktive produkter vises til kunder.</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="mb-6">
                            {{ form.image.label(class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2") }}
                            {{ form.image(class="block w-full text-sm text-gray-500 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-medium file:bg-indigo-50 file:text-indigo-700 hover:file:bg-indigo-100" + (" border-red-300" if form.image.errors else "")) }}
                            {% if form.image.errors %}
                                <div class="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600">
                                    {% for error in form.image.errors %}
                                        {{ error }}
                                    {% endfor %}
                                </div>
                            {% endif %}
                            <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">Upload et billede af mersalgs produktet. Understøttede formater: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP.</p>
                        </div>

                        <div class="flex items-center justify-end space-x-3 pt-6 border-t border-gray-200">
                            <a href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products') }}" class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg shadow-sm text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors duration-200">
                                Annuller

                            <button type="submit" class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-transparent rounded-lg shadow-sm text-sm font-medium text-white bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-colors duration-200">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path>
                                </svg>
                                {% if upsell_product %}Opdater{% else %}Opret{% endif %} Mersalgs Produkt
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </form>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

                <div class="col-lg-4">
                    {% if upsell_product and upsell_product.image_url %}
                    <div class="card">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">Nuværende billede</h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            <img src="{{ url_for('static', filename=upsell_product.image_url) }}" 
                                 alt="{{ upsell_product.name }}" 
                                 class="img-fluid rounded">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}

                    <div class="card mt-3">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">Hjælp</h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            <h6>Mersalgs produkter</h6>
                            <p class="small text-muted">
                                Mersalgs produkter er tilkøbs produkter som kunder kan tilføje til deres lejeperiode. 
                                For eksempel: popcorn pakker til popcorn maskiner, ekstra udstyr, etc.
                            </p>
                            
                            <h6>Prissætning</h6>
                            <p class="small text-muted">
                                Mersalgs produkter har en fast pris uanset lejeperiode. Prisen er pr. styk/pakke.
                            </p>
                            
                            <h6>Lagerstyring</h6>
                            <p class="small text-muted">
                                Hold øje med lagerantallet. Når det når 0, vises produktet som udsolgt til kunder.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "admin/base.html" %}

{% block title %}Mersalgs for {{ product.name }} - Admin{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="mb-8">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">
                    Mersalgs for <strong>{{ product.name }}</strong>
                </h1>
                <p class="text-lg text-gray-600">Administrer tilkøbsprodukter for dette produkt</p>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center space-x-3">
                <a href="{{ url_for('admin.products') }}" class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg shadow-sm text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors duration-200">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M10 19l-7-7m0 0l7-7m0 7h18"></path>
                    </svg>
                    Tilbage til produkter
                </a>
                <a href="{{ url_for('admin.edit_product', id=product.id) }}" class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-transparent rounded-lg shadow-sm text-sm font-medium text-white bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-colors duration-200">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4 mr-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    Rediger produkt
                </a>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

            <div class="row">
                <!-- Current Upsells -->
                <div class="col-lg-8">
                    <div class="card">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">
                                Tilknyttede Mersalgs Produkter
                                <span class="badge badge-secondary">{{ current_upsells|length }}</span>
                            </h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            {% if current_upsells %}
                            <div class="table-responsive">
                                <table class="table table-sm">
                                    <thead>
                                        <tr>
                                            <th>Billede</th>
                                            <th>Navn</th>
                                            <th>Pris</th>
                                            <th>Lager</th>
                                            <th>Rækkefølge</th>
                                            <th>Handlinger</th>
                                        </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody>
                                        {% for upsell_assoc, upsell_product in current_upsells %}
                                        <tr>
                                            <td>
                                                {% if upsell_product.image_url %}
                                                <img src="{{ url_for('static', filename=upsell_product.image_url) }}" 
                                                     alt="{{ upsell_product.name }}" 
                                                     class="img-thumbnail" 
                                                     style="width: 40px; height: 40px; object-fit: cover;">
                                                {% else %}
                                                <div class="bg-light d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center" 
                                                     style="width: 40px; height: 40px;">
                                                    <i class="fas fa-image text-muted"></i>
                                                </div>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </td>
                                            <td>
                                                <strong>{{ upsell_product.name }}</strong>
                                                {% if upsell_product.description %}
                                                <br><small class="text-muted">{{ upsell_product.description[:60] }}{% if upsell_product.description|length > 60 %}...{% endif %}</small>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </td>
                                            <td>{{ upsell_product.price_dkk }} DKK</td>
                                            <td>
                                                {% if upsell_product.stock_qty > 10 %}
                                                <span class="badge badge-success">{{ upsell_product.stock_qty }}</span>
                                                {% elif upsell_product.stock_qty > 0 %}
                                                <span class="badge badge-warning">{{ upsell_product.stock_qty }}</span>
                                                {% else %}
                                                <span class="badge badge-danger">0</span>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </td>
                                            <td>{{ upsell_assoc.sort_order }}</td>
                                            <td>
                                                <form method="POST" 
                                                      action="{{ url_for('admin.remove_product_upsell', product_id=product.id, upsell_id=upsell_product.id) }}" 
                                                      style="display: inline;"
                                                      onsubmit="return confirm('Er du sikker på at du vil fjerne dette mersalgs produkt?');">
                                                    <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="{{ csrf_token() }}"/>
                                                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" title="Fjern">
                                                        <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
                                                    </button>
                                                </form>
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                        {% endfor %}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>
                            </div>
                            {% else %}
                            <div class="text-center py-4">
                                <i class="fas fa-box-open fa-3x text-muted mb-3"></i>
                                <h6>Ingen mersalgs produkter tilknyttet</h6>
                                <p class="text-muted">Tilføj mersalgs produkter fra listen til højre.</p>
                            </div>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Available Upsells -->
                <div class="col-lg-4">
                    <div class="card">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">
                                Tilgængelige Mersalgs Produkter
                                <span class="badge badge-secondary">{{ available_upsells|length }}</span>
                            </h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            {% if available_upsells %}
                            <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('admin.add_product_upsell', product_id=product.id) }}">
                                <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="{{ csrf_token() }}"/>
                                <div class="form-group">
                                    <label for="upsell_product_id" class="form-label">Vælg mersalgs produkt:</label>
                                    <select name="upsell_product_id" id="upsell_product_id" class="form-control" required>
                                        <option value="">-- Vælg produkt --</option>
                                        {% for upsell in available_upsells %}
                                        <option value="{{ upsell.id }}">
                                            {{ upsell.name }} ({{ upsell.price_dkk }} DKK)
                                        </option>
                                        {% endfor %}
                                    </select>
                                </div>
                                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">
                                    <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Tilføj
                                </button>
                            </form>

                            <hr>

                            <div class="list-group">
                                {% for upsell in available_upsells %}
                                <div class="list-group-item">
                                    <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                                        {% if upsell.image_url %}
                                        <img src="{{ url_for('static', filename=upsell.image_url) }}" 
                                             alt="{{ upsell.name }}" 
                                             class="img-thumbnail me-3" 
                                             style="width: 40px; height: 40px; object-fit: cover;">
                                        {% else %}
                                        <div class="bg-light d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center me-3" 
                                             style="width: 40px; height: 40px;">
                                            <i class="fas fa-image text-muted"></i>
                                        </div>
                                        {% endif %}
                                        <div class="flex-grow-1">
                                            <h6 class="mb-1">{{ upsell.name }}</h6>
                                            <p class="mb-1 small text-muted">{{ upsell.price_dkk }} DKK</p>
                                            {% if upsell.description %}
                                            <small class="text-muted">{{ upsell.description[:50] }}{% if upsell.description|length > 50 %}...{% endif %}</small>
                                            {% endif %}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                {% endfor %}
                            </div>
                            {% else %}
                            <div class="text-center py-4">
                                <i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle fa-2x text-muted mb-3"></i>
                                <h6>Ingen tilgængelige mersalgs produkter</h6>
                                <p class="text-muted small">Alle mersalgs produkter er allerede tilknyttet dette produkt, eller der er ingen oprettet.</p>
                                <a href="{{ url_for('admin.create_upsell_product') }}" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm">
                                    <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Opret nyt
                                </a>
                            </div>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Quick Actions -->
                    <div class="card mt-3">
                        <div class="card-header">
                            <h5 class="card-title mb-0">Hurtige handlinger</h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            <div class="d-grid gap-2">
                                <a href="{{ url_for('admin.upsell_products') }}" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm">
                                    <i class="fas fa-list"></i> Alle mersalgs produkter
                                </a>
                                <a href="{{ url_for('admin.create_upsell_product') }}" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm">
                                    <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Opret nyt mersalgs produkt
                                </a>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}

```

```python
"""Shop blueprint for booking and checkout functionality."""

from flask import Blueprint, render_template, request, jsonify, redirect, url_for, flash, session, current_app
from flask_wtf.csrf import validate_csrf
from werkzeug.exceptions import BadRequest
from datetime import datetime, date
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import List, Dict, Any

from app.models import Product, Booking, BookingItem, BookingStatus, DeliveryType
from app.services.availability import AvailabilityService
from app.services.pricing import PricingService, BookingItemDTO
from app.forms import CheckoutForm

try:
    import stripe
except ImportError:
    stripe = None

bp = Blueprint('shop', __name__)


@bp.route('/cart')
def cart():
    """Shopping cart/booking cart page."""
    cart_items = session.get('cart', [])
    
    # Get product details for cart items
    cart_products = []
    total_estimate = Decimal('0')
    
    for item in cart_items:
        product = Product.query.filter_by(id=item['product_id'], is_active=True).first()
        if product:
            # Calculate pricing for this item
            db_session = current_app.extensions['sqlalchemy'].session
            pricing_service = PricingService(db_session, current_app.config['VAT_PERCENT'])
            
            try:
                start_date = datetime.strptime(item['start_date'], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
                end_date = datetime.strptime(item['end_date'], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
                delivery_type = DeliveryType.PICKUP if item.get('delivery_type') == 'pickup' else DeliveryType.DELIVERY
                
                price_estimate = pricing_service.get_price_estimate(
                    product.id, start_date, end_date, item['quantity'], delivery_type
                )
                
                cart_products.append({
                    'product': product,
                    'quantity': item['quantity'],
                    'start_date': start_date,
                    'end_date': end_date,
                    'delivery_type': delivery_type,
                    'price_estimate': price_estimate
                })
                
                total_estimate += Decimal(str(price_estimate.get('total', 0)))
                
            except (ValueError, KeyError) as e:
                flash(f'Fejl i vare: {product.name}', 'error')
                continue
    
    return render_template('shop/cart.html', 
                         cart_products=cart_products,
                         total_estimate=total_estimate)


@bp.route('/add-to-cart', methods=['POST'])
def add_to_cart():
    """Add product to cart."""
    try:
        validate_csrf(request.form.get('csrf_token'))
    except BadRequest:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid CSRF token'}), 400
    
    product_id = request.form.get('product_id', type=int)
    quantity = request.form.get('quantity', 1, type=int)
    start_date_str = request.form.get('start_date')
    end_date_str = request.form.get('end_date')
    delivery_type = request.form.get('delivery_type', 'pickup')
    
    if not all([product_id, start_date_str, end_date_str]):
        return jsonify({'error': 'Missing required fields'}), 400
    
    try:
        start_date = datetime.strptime(start_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
        end_date = datetime.strptime(end_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
    except ValueError:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid date format'}), 400
    
    # Check availability
    db_session = current_app.extensions['sqlalchemy'].session
    availability_service = AvailabilityService(db_session)
    
    if not availability_service.is_available(product_id, start_date, end_date, quantity):
        return jsonify({'error': 'Produktet er ikke tilgængeligt for de valgte datoer'}), 400
    
    # Add to cart
    cart = session.get('cart', [])
    
    # Check if item already exists in cart
    for item in cart:
        if (item['product_id'] == product_id and 
            item['start_date'] == start_date_str and 
            item['end_date'] == end_date_str and
            item.get('delivery_type') == delivery_type):
            item['quantity'] += quantity
            break
    else:
        cart.append({
            'product_id': product_id,
            'quantity': quantity,
            'start_date': start_date_str,
            'end_date': end_date_str,
            'delivery_type': delivery_type
        })
    
    session['cart'] = cart
    
    return jsonify({
        'success': True, 
        'message': 'Vare tilføjet til kurv',
        'cart_count': len(session.get('cart', []))
    })


@bp.route('/cart-count', methods=['GET'])
def get_cart_count():
    """Get current cart item count."""
    cart = session.get('cart', [])
    # Calculate total quantity of all items in cart
    total_count = sum(item.get('quantity', 1) for item in cart)
    return jsonify({'cart_count': total_count})


@bp.route('/remove-from-cart', methods=['POST'])
def remove_from_cart():
    """Remove item from cart."""
    try:
        validate_csrf(request.form.get('csrf_token'))
    except BadRequest:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid CSRF token'}), 400
    
    product_id = request.form.get('product_id', type=int)
    start_date_str = request.form.get('start_date')
    end_date_str = request.form.get('end_date')
    delivery_type = request.form.get('delivery_type', 'pickup')
    
    cart = session.get('cart', [])
    cart = [item for item in cart if not (
        item['product_id'] == product_id and 
        item['start_date'] == start_date_str and 
        item['end_date'] == end_date_str and
        item.get('delivery_type') == delivery_type
    )]
    
    session['cart'] = cart
    
    return jsonify({'success': True, 'message': 'Vare fjernet fra kurv'})


@bp.route('/update-cart-quantity', methods=['POST'])
def update_cart_quantity():
    """Update quantity of item in cart."""
    try:
        validate_csrf(request.form.get('csrf_token'))
    except BadRequest:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid CSRF token'}), 400
    
    product_id = request.form.get('product_id', type=int)
    quantity = request.form.get('quantity', 1, type=int)
    start_date_str = request.form.get('start_date')
    end_date_str = request.form.get('end_date')
    delivery_type = request.form.get('delivery_type', 'pickup')
    
    if quantity <= 0:
        return remove_from_cart()
    
    cart = session.get('cart', [])
    for item in cart:
        if (item['product_id'] == product_id and 
            item['start_date'] == start_date_str and 
            item['end_date'] == end_date_str and
            item.get('delivery_type') == delivery_type):
            item['quantity'] = quantity
            break
    
    session['cart'] = cart
    
    return jsonify({'success': True, 'message': 'Antal opdateret'})


@bp.route('/checkout')
def checkout():
    """Checkout page."""
    cart_items = session.get('cart', [])
    if not cart_items:
        flash('Din kurv er tom', 'warning')
        return redirect(url_for('shop.cart'))
    
    form = CheckoutForm()
    
    # Pre-populate form if user data exists in session
    if 'customer_email' in session:
        form.email.data = session['customer_email']
        form.customer_name.data = session.get('customer_name', '')
        form.phone.data = session.get('phone', '')
        form.address.data = session.get('address', '')
        form.zip_code.data = session.get('zip_code', '')
        form.city.data = session.get('city', '')
    
    return render_template('shop/checkout.html', form=form)


@bp.route('/process-checkout', methods=['POST'])
def process_checkout():
    """Process checkout and create Stripe session."""
    form = CheckoutForm()
    
    if not form.validate():
        return render_template('shop/checkout.html', form=form)
    
    cart_items = session.get('cart', [])
    if not cart_items:
        flash('Din kurv er tom', 'warning')
        return redirect(url_for('shop.cart'))
    
    # Validate availability one more time
    db_session = current_app.extensions['sqlalchemy'].session
    availability_service = AvailabilityService(db_session)
    
    for item in cart_items:
        try:
            start_date = datetime.strptime(item['start_date'], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
            end_date = datetime.strptime(item['end_date'], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
        except ValueError:
            flash('Ugyldig dato i kurv', 'error')
            return redirect(url_for('shop.cart'))
        
        if not availability_service.is_available(
            item['product_id'], start_date, end_date, item['quantity']
        ):
            product = Product.query.get(item['product_id'])
            flash(f'{product.name} er ikke længere tilgængelig for de valgte datoer', 'error')
            return redirect(url_for('shop.cart'))
    
    # Create booking
    booking = create_booking_from_cart(cart_items, form)
    
    if not booking:
        flash('Der opstod en fejl under oprettelse af booking', 'error')
        return redirect(url_for('shop.cart'))
    
    # Create Stripe checkout session
    try:
        checkout_session = create_stripe_session(booking)
        return redirect(checkout_session.url)
    except Exception as e:
        current_app.logger.error(f'Stripe error: {str(e)}')
        flash('Der opstod en fejl under betaling. Prøv igen.', 'error')
        return redirect(url_for('shop.checkout'))

def order_confirmation(booking_no):
    """Order confirmation page."""
    booking = Booking.query.filter_by(booking_no=booking_no).first_or_404()
    return render_template('shop/order_confirmation.html', booking=booking)


@bp.route('/order/<booking_no>/invoice')
def download_invoice(booking_no):
    """Download invoice PDF."""
    booking = Booking.query.filter_by(booking_no=booking_no).first_or_404()
    
    # Generate PDF invoice
    from app.utils.pdf import generate_invoice_pdf
    pdf_data = generate_invoice_pdf(booking)
    
    from flask import make_response
    response = make_response(pdf_data)
    response.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/pdf'
    response.headers['Content-Disposition'] = f'attachment; filename=faktura_{booking_no}.pdf'

def create_booking_from_cart(cart_items: List[Dict], form: CheckoutForm) -> Booking:
    """Create booking from cart items."""
    from app.models import db
    from app.utils.booking import generate_booking_number
    
    try:
        # Generate booking number
        booking_no = generate_booking_number()
        
        # Calculate pricing
        pricing_service = PricingService(db.session, current_app.config['VAT_PERCENT'])
        
        booking_items_dto = []
        for item in cart_items:
            product = Product.query.get(item['product_id'])
            if not product:
                continue
                
            start_date = datetime.strptime(item['start_date'], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
            end_date = datetime.strptime(item['end_date'], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
            delivery_type = DeliveryType.PICKUP if item.get('delivery_type') == 'pickup' else DeliveryType.DELIVERY
            
            booking_items_dto.append(BookingItemDTO(
                product_id=product.id,
                product_name=product.name,
                quantity=item['quantity'],
                start_date=start_date,
                end_date=end_date,
                delivery_type=delivery_type
            ))
        
        pricing = pricing_service.calculate_booking_pricing(
            booking_items_dto, 
            DeliveryType.PICKUP if form.delivery_type.data == 'pickup' else DeliveryType.DELIVERY
        )
        
        # Create booking
        booking = Booking(
            booking_no=booking_no,
            customer_name=form.customer_name.data,
            email=form.email.data,
            phone=form.phone.data,
            address=form.address.data,
            zip_code=form.zip_code.data,
            city=form.city.data,
            start_date=booking_items_dto[0].start_date,  # Use first item's dates
            end_date=booking_items_dto[0].end_date,
            subtotal_dkk=pricing.subtotal,
            vat_dkk=pricing.vat_amount,
            deposit_dkk=pricing.deposit_amount,
            delivery_fee_dkk=pricing.delivery_fee,
            total_dkk=pricing.total,
            status=BookingStatus.PENDING,
            notes=form.notes.data
        )
        
        db.session.add(booking)
        db.session.flush()  # Get booking ID
        
        # Create booking items
        for i, item_dto in enumerate(booking_items_dto):
            product = Product.query.get(item_dto.product_id)
            unit_price = pricing.line_items[i].unit_price if i < len(pricing.line_items) else product.daily_price_dkk
            
            booking_item = BookingItem(
                booking_id=booking.id,
                product_id=item_dto.product_id,
                quantity=item_dto.quantity,
                unit_price_dkk=unit_price,
                name_snapshot=item_dto.product_name
            )
            db.session.add(booking_item)
        
        db.session.commit()
        
        # Clear cart
        session.pop('cart', None)
        
        # Store customer info for future use
        session['customer_email'] = form.email.data
        session['customer_name'] = form.customer_name.data
        session['phone'] = form.phone.data
        session['address'] = form.address.data
        session['zip_code'] = form.zip_code.data
        session['city'] = form.city.data
        
        return booking
        
    except Exception as e:
        current_app.logger.error(f'Error creating booking: {str(e)}')
        db.session.rollback()
        return None


def create_stripe_session(booking: Booking):
    """Create Stripe checkout session."""
    if not stripe:
        raise Exception("Stripe is not available. Please install stripe package.")
    
    stripe.api_key = current_app.config['STRIPE_SECRET_KEY']
    
    # Create line items for Stripe
    line_items = []
    for item in booking.items:
        line_items.append({
            'price_data': {
                'currency': 'dkk',
                'product_data': {
                    'name': item.name_snapshot,
                },
                'unit_amount': int(item.unit_price_dkk * 100),  # Convert to øre
            },
            'quantity': item.quantity,
        })
    
    # Add delivery fee if applicable
    if booking.delivery_fee_dkk > 0:
        line_items.append({
            'price_data': {
                'currency': 'dkk',
                'product_data': {
                    'name': 'Levering',
                },
                'unit_amount': int(booking.delivery_fee_dkk * 100),
            },
            'quantity': 1,
        })
    
    # Add VAT
    if booking.vat_dkk > 0:
        line_items.append({
            'price_data': {
                'currency': 'dkk',
                'product_data': {
                    'name': f'Moms ({current_app.config["VAT_PERCENT"]}%)',
                },
                'unit_amount': int(booking.vat_dkk * 100),
            },
            'quantity': 1,
        })
    
    # Add deposit
    if booking.deposit_dkk > 0:
        line_items.append({
            'price_data': {
                'currency': 'dkk',
                'product_data': {
                    'name': 'Depositum (refunderbart)',
                },
                'unit_amount': int(booking.deposit_dkk * 100),
            },
            'quantity': 1,
        })
    
    checkout_session = stripe.checkout.Session.create(
        payment_method_types=['card'],
        line_items=line_items,
        mode='payment',
        success_url=url_for('shop.order_confirmation', booking_no=booking.booking_no, _external=True),
        cancel_url=url_for('shop.checkout', _external=True),
        customer_email=booking.email,
        metadata={
            'booking_id': str(booking.id),
            'booking_no': booking.booking_no
        }
    )
    
    # Update booking with Stripe session ID
    booking.stripe_session_id = checkout_session.id
    db.session.commit()
    
    return checkout_session
```

```python
"""Shop blueprint for booking and checkout functionality."""

from flask import Blueprint, render_template, request, jsonify, redirect, url_for, flash, session, current_app
from flask_wtf.csrf import validate_csrf
from werkzeug.exceptions import BadRequest
from datetime import datetime, date
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import List, Dict, Any

from app.models import Product, Booking, BookingItem, BookingStatus, DeliveryType
from app.services.availability import AvailabilityService
from app.services.pricing import PricingService, BookingItemDTO
from app.forms import CheckoutForm

try:
    import stripe
except ImportError:
    stripe = None

bp = Blueprint('shop', __name__)


@bp.route('/cart')
def cart():
    """Shopping cart/booking cart page."""
    cart_items = session.get('cart', [])
    
    # Get product details for cart items
    cart_products = []
    total_estimate = Decimal('0')
    
    for item in cart_items:
        product = Product.query.filter_by(id=item['product_id'], is_active=True).first()
        if product:
            # Calculate pricing for this item
            db_session = current_app.extensions['sqlalchemy'].session
            pricing_service = PricingService(db_session, current_app.config['VAT_PERCENT'])
            
            try:
                start_date = datetime.strptime(item['start_date'], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
                end_date = datetime.strptime(item['end_date'], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
                delivery_type = DeliveryType.PICKUP if item.get('delivery_type') == 'pickup' else DeliveryType.DELIVERY
                
                price_estimate = pricing_service.get_price_estimate(
                    product.id, start_date, end_date, item['quantity'], delivery_type
                )
                
                cart_products.append({
                    'product': product,
                    'quantity': item['quantity'],
                    'start_date': start_date,
                    'end_date': end_date,
                    'delivery_type': delivery_type,
                    'price_estimate': price_estimate
                })
                
                total_estimate += Decimal(str(price_estimate.get('total', 0)))
                
            except (ValueError, KeyError) as e:
                flash(f'Fejl i vare: {product.name}', 'error')
                continue
    
    return render_template('shop/cart.html', 
                         cart_products=cart_products,
                         total_estimate=total_estimate)


@bp.route('/add-to-cart', methods=['POST'])
def add_to_cart():
    """Add product to cart."""
    try:
        validate_csrf(request.form.get('csrf_token'))
    except BadRequest:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid CSRF token'}), 400
    
    product_id = request.form.get('product_id', type=int)
    quantity = request.form.get('quantity', 1, type=int)
    start_date_str = request.form.get('start_date')
    end_date_str = request.form.get('end_date')
    delivery_type = request.form.get('delivery_type', 'pickup')
    
    if not all([product_id, start_date_str, end_date_str]):
        return jsonify({'error': 'Missing required fields'}), 400
    
    try:
        start_date = datetime.strptime(start_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
        end_date = datetime.strptime(end_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
    except ValueError:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid date format'}), 400
    
    # Check availability
    db_session = current_app.extensions['sqlalchemy'].session
    availability_service = AvailabilityService(db_session)
    
    if not availability_service.is_available(product_id, start_date, end_date, quantity):
        return jsonify({'error': 'Produktet er ikke tilgængeligt for de valgte datoer'}), 400
    
    # Add to cart
    cart = session.get('cart', [])
    
    # Check if item already exists in cart
    for item in cart:
        if (item['product_id'] == product_id and 
            item['start_date'] == start_date_str and 
            item['end_date'] == end_date_str and
            item.get('delivery_type') == delivery_type):
            item['quantity'] += quantity
            break
    else:
        cart.append({
            'product_id': product_id,
            'quantity': quantity,
            'start_date': start_date_str,
            'end_date': end_date_str,
            'delivery_type': delivery_type
        })
    
    session['cart'] = cart
    
    # Calculate total quantity for cart count
    cart = session.get('cart', [])
    total_count = sum(item.get('quantity', 1) for item in cart)
    
    return jsonify({
        'success': True,
        'message': 'Vare tilføjet til kurv',
        'cart_count': total_count
    })


@bp.route('/cart-count', methods=['GET'])
def get_cart_count():
    """Get current cart item count."""
    cart = session.get('cart', [])
    # Calculate total quantity of all items in cart
    total_count = sum(item.get('quantity', 1) for item in cart)
    return jsonify({'cart_count': total_count})


@bp.route('/remove-from-cart', methods=['POST'])
def remove_from_cart():
    """Remove item from cart."""
    try:
        validate_csrf(request.form.get('csrf_token'))
    except BadRequest:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid CSRF token'}), 400
    
    product_id = request.form.get('product_id', type=int)
    start_date_str = request.form.get('start_date')
    end_date_str = request.form.get('end_date')
    delivery_type = request.form.get('delivery_type', 'pickup')
    
    cart = session.get('cart', [])
    cart = [item for item in cart if not (
        item['product_id'] == product_id and 
        item['start_date'] == start_date_str and 
        item['end_date'] == end_date_str and
        item.get('delivery_type') == delivery_type
    )]
    
    session['cart'] = cart
    
    return jsonify({'success': True, 'message': 'Vare fjernet fra kurv'})


@bp.route('/update-cart-quantity', methods=['POST'])
def update_cart_quantity():
    """Update quantity of item in cart."""
    try:
        validate_csrf(request.form.get('csrf_token'))
    except BadRequest:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid CSRF token'}), 400
    
    product_id = request.form.get('product_id', type=int)
    quantity = request.form.get('quantity', 1, type=int)
    start_date_str = request.form.get('start_date')
    end_date_str = request.form.get('end_date')
    delivery_type = request.form.get('delivery_type', 'pickup')
    
    if quantity <= 0:
        return remove_from_cart()
    
    cart = session.get('cart', [])
    for item in cart:
        if (item['product_id'] == product_id and 
            item['start_date'] == start_date_str and 
            item['end_date'] == end_date_str and
            item.get('delivery_type') == delivery_type):
            item['quantity'] = quantity
            break
    
    session['cart'] = cart
    
    return jsonify({'success': True, 'message': 'Antal opdateret'})
```

```html
                            700: '#0369a1',
                            800: '#075985',
                            900: '#0c4a6e',
                        },
                        accent: {
                            50: '#fdf4ff',
                            100: '#fae8ff',
                            200: '#f5d0fe',
                            300: '#f0abfc',
                            400: '#e879f9',
                            500: '#d946ef',
                            600: '#c026d3',
                            700: '#a21caf',
                            800: '#86198f',
                            900: '#701a75',
                        }
                    },
                    animation: {
                        'fade-in': 'fadeIn 0.5s ease-in-out',
                        'slide-up': 'slideUp 0.5s ease-out',
                        'bounce-gentle': 'bounceGentle 2s infinite',
                        'pulse-slow': 'pulse 3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite',
                    },
                    keyframes: {
                        fadeIn: {
                            '0%': { opacity: '0' },
                            '100%': { opacity: '1' },
                        },
                        slideUp: {
                            '0%': { transform: 'translateY(20px)', opacity: '0' },
                            '100%': { transform: 'translateY(0)', opacity: '1' },
                        },
                        bounceGentle: {
                            '0%, 100%': { transform: 'translateY(0)' },
                            '50%': { transform: 'translateY(-5px)' },
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    </script>
    
    <!-- HTMX -->
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@1.9.10"></script>
    
    <!-- Alpine.js -->
    <script defer src="https://unpkg.com/alpinejs@3.x.x/dist/cdn.min.js"></script>
    
    <!-- FullCalendar -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fullcalendar@6.1.10/index.global.min.js"></script>
    
    <!-- Custom CSS -->
    <style>
        [x-cloak] { display: none !important; }
        .htmx-indicator { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 200ms ease-in; }
        .htmx-request .htmx-indicator { opacity: 1; }
        .htmx-request.htmx-indicator { opacity: 1; }
        
        /* Custom scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #f1f5f9;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #cbd5e1;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #94a3b8;
        }
        
        /* Smooth transitions */
        * {
            transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke, opacity, box-shadow, transform, filter, backdrop-filter;
            transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            transition-duration: 150ms;
        }
        
        /* Glass morphism effect */
        .glass {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
        }
        
        /* Gradient text */
        .gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0ea5e9, #d946ef);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }
        
        /* Hover effects */
        .hover-lift {
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }
        .hover-lift:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 10px 10px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        }
        
        /* Loading animation */
        .loading-dots::after {
            content: '';
            animation: loading-dots 1.5s infinite;
        }
        
        @keyframes loading-dots {
            0%, 20% { content: ''; }
            40% { content: '.'; }
            60% { content: '..'; }
            80%, 100% { content: '...'; }
        }
    </style>
    
    {% block extra_head %}{% endblock %}
</head>

    <!-- JavaScript -->
    <script>
        // Initialize Alpine.js data
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('app', () => ({
                mobileMenuOpen: false,
                cartCount: 0,
                
                init() {
                    this.updateCartCount();
                    // Add scroll effect to navigation
                    this.handleScroll();
                },
                
                async updateCartCount() {
                    try {
                        const response = await fetch('/shop/cart-count');
                        if (response.ok) {
                            const data = await response.json();
                            this.cartCount = data.cart_count;
                            const cartCountEl = document.getElementById('cart-count');
                            const cartCountMobileEl = document.getElementById('cart-count-mobile');
                            if (cartCountEl) cartCountEl.textContent = this.cartCount;
                            if (cartCountMobileEl) cartCountMobileEl.textContent = this.cartCount;
                        }
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.log('Cart count update failed:', error);
                    }
                },
                
                handleScroll() {
                    let lastScrollY = window.scrollY;
                    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                        const nav = document.querySelector('nav');
                        if (window.scrollY > 100) {
                            nav.classList.add('bg-white/95', 'backdrop-blur-lg');
                            nav.classList.remove('bg-white/80', 'backdrop-blur-md');
                        } else {
                            nav.classList.add('bg-white/80', 'backdrop-blur-md');
                            nav.classList.remove('bg-white/95', 'backdrop-blur-lg');
                        }
                        lastScrollY = window.scrollY;
                    });
                }
            }));
        });
        
        // HTMX configuration
        document.body.addEventListener('htmx:afterRequest', function(evt) {
            // Update cart count after any request that might affect the cart
            if (evt.detail.xhr.status === 200) {
                const app = Alpine.$data(document.querySelector('[x-data]'));
                if (app && app.updateCartCount) {
                    app.updateCartCount();
                }
            }
        });
        
        // Update cart count when returning to the page (e.g., after visiting cart)
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
            if (!document.hidden) {
                const app = Alpine.$data(document.querySelector('[x-data]'));
                if (app && app.updateCartCount) {
                    app.updateCartCount();
                }
            }
        });
        
        // Update cart count on page focus
        window.addEventListener('focus', function() {
            const app = Alpine.$data(document.querySelector('[x-data]'));
            if (app && app.updateCartCount) {
                app.updateCartCount();
            }
        });
        
        // Add smooth scrolling for anchor links
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
            anchor.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
                if (target) {
                    target.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            });
        });
        
        // Add loading states for forms
        document.querySelectorAll('form').forEach(form => {
            form.addEventListener('submit', function() {
                const submitBtn = this.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
                if (submitBtn) {
                    submitBtn.classList.add('opacity-75', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                    submitBtn.disabled = true;
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
    
    {% block extra_js %}{% endblock %}
</body>
</html>
```

```html
    <!-- JavaScript -->
    <script>
        // Initialize Alpine.js data
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('app', () => ({
                mobileMenuOpen: false,
                cartCount: 0,
                
                init() {
                    this.updateCartCount();
                    // Add scroll effect to navigation
                    this.handleScroll();
                },
                
                async updateCartCount() {
                    try {
                        const response = await fetch('/shop/cart-count');
                        if (response.ok) {
                            const data = await response.json();
                            this.cartCount = data.cart_count;
                            const cartCountEl = document.getElementById('cart-count');
                            const cartCountMobileEl = document.getElementById('cart-count-mobile');
                            if (cartCountEl) cartCountEl.textContent = this.cartCount;
                            if (cartCountMobileEl) cartCountMobileEl.textContent = this.cartCount;
                        }
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.log('Cart count update failed:', error);
                    }
                },
                
                handleScroll() {
                    let lastScrollY = window.scrollY;
                    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                        const nav = document.querySelector('nav');
                        if (window.scrollY > 100) {
                            nav.classList.add('bg-white/95', 'backdrop-blur-lg');
                            nav.classList.remove('bg-white/80', 'backdrop-blur-md');
                        } else {
                            nav.classList.add('bg-white/80', 'backdrop-blur-md');
                            nav.classList.remove('bg-white/95', 'backdrop-blur-lg');
                        }
                        lastScrollY = window.scrollY;
                    });
                }
            }));
        });
        
        // HTMX configuration
        document.body.addEventListener('htmx:afterRequest', function(evt) {
            // Update cart count after any request that might affect the cart
            if (evt.detail.xhr.status === 200) {
                const app = Alpine.$data(document.querySelector('[x-data]'));
                if (app && app.updateCartCount) {
                    app.updateCartCount();
                }
            }
        });
        
        // Update cart count when returning to the page (e.g., after visiting cart)
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
            if (!document.hidden) {
                const app = Alpine.$data(document.querySelector('[x-data]'));
                if (app && app.updateCartCount) {
                    app.updateCartCount();
                }
            }
        });
        
        // Update cart count on page focus
        window.addEventListener('focus', function() {
            const app = Alpine.$data(document.querySelector('[x-data]'));
            if (app && app.updateCartCount) {
                app.updateCartCount();
            }
        });
        
        // Add smooth scrolling for anchor links
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
            anchor.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
                if (target) {
                    target.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            });
        });
        
        // Add loading states for forms
        document.querySelectorAll('form').forEach(form => {
            form.addEventListener('submit', function() {
                const submitBtn = this.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
                if (submitBtn) {
                    submitBtn.classList.add('opacity-75', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                    submitBtn.disabled = true;
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
    
    {% block extra_js %}{% endblock %}
</body>
</html>
```
